articles.title: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life

paras.en: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life
paras.zh: Carlisle 推出 EL121 盘式制动器，以提高性能和磨损寿命

paras.en: (MEDINA, OH, September 12, 2023) – Carlisle Brake & Friction is excited to announce the launch of EL121 Disc Brake Pads for mine haul truck applications. The new product series will be named Extended Life, or the EL Series, and EL121 will be the first friction formulation of the series to launch.
paras.zh: （俄亥俄州梅迪纳，2023 年 9 月 12 日）——Carlisle Brake & Friction 很高兴地宣布推出适用于矿用运输卡车应用的 EL121 盘式制动片。新产品系列将被命名为Extend Life，即EL系列，EL121将是该系列中首款推出的摩擦配方。

paras.en: Carlisle’s EL121 Series friction material nearly doubles the service life of front-axle, mine haul truck brake pads. The result is increased equipment uptime, and reduced maintenance costs when utilizing the OEM calipers and rotors.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔的 EL121 系列摩擦材料使前轴、矿用运输卡车刹车片的使用寿命几乎延长了一倍。使用 OEM 卡钳和转子时，可以增加设备的正常运行时间并降低维护成本。

paras.en: Autonomous haul trucks experience higher pad temperatures, which drive elevated pad wear from increased braking cycles as the retarder and the service brake are applied. EL121 features a highly wear-resistant friction material blend that provides extended brake pad life with consistent and fade-resistant braking performance. EL121 is the ideal solution for today’s autonomous mine haul trucks (may also be used in manned mine haul trucks for increased performance and longevity).
paras.zh: 自动运输卡车的刹车片温度较高，当使用缓速器和行车制动器时，制动周期的增加会导致刹车片磨损加剧。 EL121 采用高度耐磨的摩擦材料混合物，可延长刹车片的使用寿命，并具有一致且防褪色的制动性能。 EL121 是当今自动矿用运输卡车的理想解决方案（也可用于载人矿用运输卡车，以提高性能和使用寿命）。

paras.en: “We understand that mine operators need to keep their haul trucks on the job and not in the shop for brake service. Our latest innovation allows for up to double the service life of the front-axle mine haul truck brake pads and are a will-fit replacement to existing OEM pads. These were thoroughly lab tested as well as field tested on Komatsu 830E-1 trucks,” said Ron Ratell, Product Line Director Friction Products at Carlisle Brake & Friction.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司摩擦产品产品线总监 Ron Ratell 表示：“我们了解矿山运营商需要让运输卡车继续工作，而不是在车间进行制动维修。我们的最新创新技术可将前轴矿用运输卡车制动片的使用寿命延长一倍，并且是现有 OEM 制动片的理想替代品。这些制动片经过了彻底的实验室测试以及小松 830E-1 卡车的现场测试。”

paras.en: EL121 friction has been dyno tested to replicate the application and is proven to deliver an innovative, high-energy material to meet market needs. EL121 disc brake pads also feature an industry-proven mechanical retention system with backing plate technology designed for superior bonding and durability, capable of withstanding abusive conditions in even the harshest Off-Highway environments.
paras.zh: EL121 摩擦力经过测功机测试以复制应用，并被证明可以提供创新的高能材料来满足市场需求。 EL121 盘式刹车片还采用经过行业验证的机械固定系统，采用背板技术，旨在实现卓越的粘合性和耐用性，甚至能够承受最恶劣的非公路环境中的恶劣条件。

paras.en: Carlisle’s EL121 Series disc brake pads are available now through authorized Carlisle dealers and distributors. To learn more, visit https://www.carlislecbf.com/products/brake-friction/disc-brake-pads/off-highway-disc-brake-pads/el. To locate an authorized Carlisle dealer near you, search our online distributor listing https://www.carlislecbf.com/support/find-a-distributor.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔的EL121系列盘式刹车片现已通过卡莱尔授权经销商和分销商发售。如需了解更多信息，请访问https://www.carlislecbf.com/products/brake-friction/disc-brake-pads/off-highway-disc-brake-pads/el。要查找您附近的授权卡莱尔经销商，请搜索我们的在线经销商列表https://www.carlislecbf.com/support/find-a-distributor。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of Carlisle’s brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是全球公认的高度创新制动和摩擦系统解决方案开发和制造领域的领导者，为各种运动控制应用提供服务。卡莱尔制动系统专业知识的综合性包括液压控制产品、工业制动组件、用于制动、离合器和变速箱应用的湿式和干式摩擦材料以及售后替换产品。我们的全系统产品由具有行业经验的专家团队提供支持，为我们的客户提供制动系统解决方案，使他们在竞争中脱颖而出。 www.carlislecbf.com

articles.title: Carlisle Releases Video Highlighting Solutions for Ag

paras.en: Carlisle Releases Video Highlighting Solutions for Ag
paras.zh: Carlisle 发布 Ag 视频突出显示解决方案

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction launches a new product solutions video: Carlisle Solutions for Tractor Applications, to showcase all of the latest motion control technologies available for agriculture equipment, specifically tractor applications.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司推出了新产品解决方案视频：卡莱尔拖拉机应用解决方案，展示适用于农业设备（特别是拖拉机应用）的所有最新运动控制技术。

paras.en: From power valves, to disc brakes, to PTO and shuttle clutch friction options, this video breaks down all of the features and benefits of Carlisle’s newest brake system and powertrain solutions.
paras.zh: 从动力阀到盘式制动器，再到取力器和梭式离合器摩擦选项，该视频详细介绍了卡莱尔最新制动系统和动力总成解决方案的所有功能和优点。

paras.en: For improved visualization, the video features 3D animation and demonstrations of the product fitments within a standard tractor model.
paras.zh: 为了提高可视化效果，该视频采用 3D 动画和标准拖拉机模型中的产品配件演示。

articles.title: Carlisle Suzhou Achieves Caterpillar SER Certification

paras.en: Carlisle Suzhou Achieves Caterpillar SER Certification
paras.zh: 卡莱苏州获得卡特彼勒 SER 认证

paras.en: (MEDINA, January 25, 2024) – Carlisle Brake & Friction announced its Suzhou facility has won a Supplier Excellence Recognition (SER) Certification from Caterpillar Inc. The Caterpillar SER is a new supplier management system featuring "Certified" and "Excellent" levels. Caterpillar officially launched the program in 2022. Carlisle's Suzhou manufacturing facility achieved a "Certified" level of recognition and celebrated the achievement alongside the Caterpillar team with a ceremony at the Carlisle Suzhou plant.
paras.zh: （梅迪纳，2024 年 1 月 25 日）——卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司宣布其苏州工厂获得卡特彼勒公司颁发的供应商卓越认可 (SER) 认证。卡特彼勒 SER 是一种新的供应商管理体系，具有“认证”和“优秀”级别。卡特彼勒于 2022 年正式启动该计划。卡莱尔苏州制造工厂获得了“认证”级别的认可，并与卡特彼勒团队在卡莱尔苏州工厂举行了仪式，庆祝这一成就。

paras.en: Of 27,000 suppliers, 250 were among the selected companies awarded by Caterpillar. Carlisle, a leading global supplier of brake, clutch, and transmission friction products, is the only friction products manufacturer worldwide to win the coveted certification.
paras.zh: 在 27,000 家供应商中，有 250 家入选卡特彼勒授予的奖项。 Carlisle 是全球领先的制动器、离合器和变速箱摩擦产品供应商，也是全球唯一一家获得这一令人垂涎的认证的摩擦产品制造商。

paras.en: "We are honored to be recognized by Caterpillar as a Certified level supplier," said Doug Wagner, Global VP of Sales, Carlisle Brake & Friction. "This award recognizes the superior efforts and dedication of the entire Suzhou team that supports our global business."
paras.zh: “我们很荣幸被 Caterpillar 认可为认证级供应商，”Carlisle 制动与摩擦部全球销售副总裁 Doug Wagner 说道。 “该奖项是对支持我们全球业务的整个苏州团队的卓越努力和奉献精神的认可。”

paras.en: Carlisle earned SER Certification in recognition of the company's exemplary commitment to supporting Caterpillar's global growth strategy goals.
paras.zh: Carlisle 获得了 SER 认证，以表彰该公司对支持 Caterpillar 全球增长战略目标的模范承诺。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of Carlisle’s brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com

articles.title: BendPak Debuts MaxJax MAX7 Portable Two-Post Lift at SEMA Show
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: BendPak Inc. introduced the MaxJax MAX7 portable two-post lift at the SEMA Show. The MAX7 rises three inches higher than earlier models, providing more under-vehicle clearance and additional room to work. It’s also the first MaxJax model to integrate BendPak’s Automatic Swing Arm Restraint System (ASARS), engineered to help prevent unintended swing arm movement during vehicle lifting, lowering and service. Attendees can see the lift at BendPak’s outdoor interactive display in the Silver Lot, booth no. 80043, and at its second location in the Upper South Hall, booth no. 36129.
paras.zh: BendPak Inc. 在 SEMA 展会上推出了 MaxJax MAX7 便携式两柱移位机。 MAX7 比早期型号高出三英寸，提供了更多的车底间隙和额外的工作空间。它也是首款集成 BendPak 自动摆臂约束系统 (ASARS) 的 MaxJax 型号，该系统旨在帮助防止车辆举升、降低和维修过程中摆臂意外移动。与会者可以在 Silver Lot 的 BendPak 户外互动显示屏上看到电梯，展位号为 101。 80043，以及上南厅的第二个位置，展位号：80043。 36129。

paras.en: “Garage space is premium real estate, whether you’re running a busy shop or wrenching at home,” said Sean Price, director of quality control and product development for BendPak. “The MAX7 stands out for its versatility. It delivers commercial-grade lifting power for enthusiasts without permanently sacrificing parking space, while enabling professional shops to quickly increase service capacity during peak hours. The MaxJax MAX7 unlocks maximum utility without requiring a permanent footprint.”
paras.zh: BendPak 质量控制和产品开发总监肖恩·普莱斯 (Sean Price) 表示：“无论您是在经营繁忙的商店还是在家里忙碌，车库空间都是优质的房地产。” “MAX7 因其多功能性而脱颖而出。它为爱好者提供商业级起重能力，而无需永久牺牲停车空间，同时使专业商店能够在高峰时段快速增加服务能力。MaxJax MAX7 无需永久占地面积即可释放最大效用。”

paras.en: The MaxJax MAX7 offers a maximum lifting height of 50.25 inches, providing additional under-vehicle clearance while maintaining a compact profile for spaces with low ceilings. Its open design provides direct access to brakes, suspension, exhaust and other undercar components. A 7,000-lb. rated load capacity enables the MAX7 to lift a wide range of cars, trucks and SUVs.
paras.zh: MaxJax MAX7 的最大举升高度为 50.25 英寸，提供额外的车底间隙，同时保持天花板较低空间的紧凑外形。其开放式设计可直接接触制动器、悬架、排气管和其他车底部件。 7,000 磅。额定负载能力使 MAX7 能够举升各种汽车、卡车和 SUV。

paras.en: The MAX7 is the first MaxJax lift to incorporate BendPak’s patent-pending ASARS. More robust than traditional swing arm restraint mechanisms, ASARS provides a full 360-degree locking interface with 10 times the holding force to secure the lift arms in position under the vehicle. The MAX7 also features seven safety locking positions and an upgraded, easy-to-use lock release.
paras.zh: MAX7 是首款采用 BendPak 正在申请专利的 ASARS 的 MaxJax 移位机。 ASARS 比传统摇臂约束机构更坚固，提供完整的 360 度锁定接口，具有 10 倍的保持力，可将提升臂固定在车辆下方的适当位置。 MAX7 还具有七个安全锁定位置和一个升级的、易于使用的解锁装置。

paras.en: MaxJax is a patented, portable two-post lift. It combines the undercar access and lifting capability of a two-post lift with removable columns and power unit. During use, each column is bolted to floor anchors recessed permanently in the concrete floor, providing a stable foundation. When the job is complete, the columns can be unbolted and rolled away, leaving the floor clear.
paras.zh: MaxJax 是一款获得专利的便携式两柱移位机。它将两柱式举升机的车底通道和举升能力与可拆卸立柱和动力装置结合在一起。在使用过程中，每根柱子都用螺栓固定在永久嵌入混凝土地板中的地板锚栓上，提供稳定的基础。工作完成后，可以将柱子松开并滚走，使地板保持干净。

paras.en: Because customers frequently add adapters, rolling work seats and other accessories to their MaxJax lifts, BendPak offers four MAX7 packages:
paras.zh: 由于客户经常为其 MaxJax 移位机添加适配器、滚动工作座椅和其他配件，因此 BendPak 提供四种 MAX7 套件：

paras.en: - The standard package includes the MAX7 (lift assembly, power unit with tow-cart and standard anchor bolt kit), round lift pads and medium adapters.
paras.zh: - 标准套件包括 MAX7（升降组件、带拖车的动力装置和标准锚栓套件）、圆形升降垫和中型适配器。

paras.en: - The deluxe package adds a rolling work seat and portable oil drain.
paras.zh: - 豪华套装增加了滚动工作座椅和便携式排油管。

paras.en: - The supreme package features everything in the deluxe package, plus frame cradle pads and tall adapters.
paras.zh: - 至尊套装包含豪华套装中的所有物品，以及框架支架垫和高适配器。

paras.en: - The ultimate package replaces the standard rolling work seat in the supreme package with the MaxJax Ergonomic Height-Adjustable Creeper Seat.
paras.zh: - 终极套件用 MaxJax 人体工学高度可调爬行座椅取代了至尊套件中的标准滚动工作座椅。

paras.en: An optional MaxJax motorcycle and ATV adapter kit adds powersports service capability to the MAX7 car lift.
paras.zh: 可选的 MaxJax 摩托车和 ATV 适配器套件为 MAX7 汽车举升机增加了动力运动服务能力。

paras.en: Learn more at bendpak.com/maxjax or visit BendPak at the SEMA Show in Silver Lot booth no. 80043.
paras.zh: 了解更多信息，请访问bendpak.com/maxjax，或参观SEMA展会上的BendPak Silver Lot展位。 80043。

articles.title: I-CAR Honors Award Winners at 2026 SEMA Show
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: I-CAR recognized Justin Lewis of Accurate Auto Body in Redmond, Wash., and Victor Auto Body Works of Middletown, Conn., with its annual industry achievement awards at the 2026 SEMA Show in Las Vegas.
paras.zh: I-CAR 在 2026 年拉斯维加斯 SEMA 展会上向华盛顿州雷蒙德 Accurate Auto Body 工厂的 Justin Lewis 和康涅狄格州米德尔敦 Victor Auto Body Works 颁发了年度行业成就奖。

paras.en: Lewis received the Jeff Silver Memorial Award for Platinum Individuals, and Tyler Rook, owner of Victor Auto Body Works, accepted the Russ Verona Memorial Award for Gold Class Shops. These awards honor achievements during the 2025 performance year that reflect a shared commitment to ongoing education, industry leadership and complete, safe and quality repairs.
paras.zh: 刘易斯获得了杰夫·西尔弗白金个人纪念奖，维克多汽车车身厂老板泰勒·鲁克接受了拉斯·维罗纳金级商店纪念奖。这些奖项旨在表彰 2025 业绩年度取得的成就，反映了对持续教育、行业领导力以及完整、安全和优质维修的共同承诺。

paras.en: Jeff Silver Memorial Award: Justin Lewis, Accurate Auto Body
paras.zh: 杰夫·西尔弗纪念奖：贾斯汀·刘易斯，《精确的车身》

paras.en: The Jeff Silver Memorial Award recognizes an individual who champions I-CAR’s Platinum designation, its highest recognition for individuals. At Accurate Auto Body, Lewis mentors technicians, helps customers understand the importance of proper repair procedures and reinforces the role of current training and manufacturer repair information.
paras.zh: Jeff Silver 纪念奖旨在表彰支持 I-CAR 白金称号的个人，这是对个人的最高认可。在 Accurate Auto Body，刘易斯指导技术人员，帮助客户了解正确维修程序的重要性，并强化当前培训和制造商维修信息的作用。

paras.en: Lewis extends his commitment to bettering the collision repair community as president of the Washington Independent Collision Repairer’s Association and through his work with Lake Washington Tech’s collision advisory board.
paras.zh: 作为华盛顿独立碰撞维修协会主席，刘易斯通过与华盛顿湖理工学院碰撞咨询委员会的合作，致力于改善碰撞维修社区。

paras.en: Russ Verona Memorial Award: Victor Auto Body Works
paras.zh: 拉斯维罗纳纪念奖：Victor Auto Body Works

paras.en: The Russ Verona Memorial Award recognizes a Gold Class collision repair business that demonstrates a long-standing commitment to training, professionalism and customer care.
paras.zh: 拉斯维罗纳纪念奖旨在表彰金级碰撞修复企业，该企业表现出对培训、专业精神和客户服务的长期承诺。

paras.en: Family-owned and operating in Middletown since 1953, Victor Auto Body Works celebrated 30 years of I-CAR Gold Class status this year. Victor Auto Body Works also develops partnerships with local vocational programs to introduce future technicians to collision repair careers in its community.
paras.zh: Victor Auto Body Works 是一家家族企业，自 1953 年以来一直在米德尔敦经营，今年庆祝了 I-CAR 黄金级地位 30 周年。 Victor Auto Body Works 还与当地职业项目建立合作伙伴关系，向未来的技术人员介绍其社区的碰撞修复职业。

paras.en: For more information on I-CAR, visit i-car.com.
paras.zh: 有关 I-CAR 的更多信息，请访问 i-car.com。

articles.title: Tennessee denies Scout Motors direct sales dealer license application
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: The Tennessee Motor Vehicle Commission denied Scout Motors a direct-to-customer dealer license last week, citing the company’s ownership structure as violating state law that prohibits competition with an OEM’s franchise dealers.
paras.zh: 田纳西州机动车辆委员会上周拒绝向 Scout Motors 颁发直接面向客户的经销商许可证，称该公司的所有权结构违反了禁止与 OEM 特许经销商竞争的州法律。

paras.en: According to the commission, multiple Volkswagen dealers in Tennessee oppose Scout selling its vehicles in the state because they contend Volkswagen owns the company, which already sells its vehicles there.
paras.zh: 据该委员会称，田纳西州的多家大众汽车经销商反对 Scout 在该州销售其汽车，因为他们认为大众汽车公司拥有该公司，而该公司已经在那里销售其汽车。

paras.en: The commission asked Scout representatives about ownership, who said Volkswagen AG is an investor, but Scout is its own manufacturer. Sara Ash, Scout’s litigation associate general counsel, said the automaker is “funded 100% by Volkswagen AG.”
paras.zh: 该委员会询问了 Scout 代表有关所有权的问题，他们表示大众汽车公司是投资者，但 Scout 是自己的制造商。 Scout 诉讼副总法律顾问萨拉·阿什 (Sara Ash) 表示，该汽车制造商“100% 由大众汽车公司提供资金”。

paras.en: Sym Singh, Scout’s state government affairs director, said Volkswagen AG is a publicly traded German company while Volkswagen Group of America is a U.S.-licensed manufacturer and distributor of Volkswagen vehicles. Singh said Scout doesn’t have ties to the latter.
paras.zh: 斯考特州政府事务总监西姆·辛格(Sym Singh)表示，大众汽车公司是一家德国上市公司，而美国大众集团是一家获得美国许可的大众汽车制造商和经销商。辛格表示，斯考特与后者没有任何关系。

paras.en: “We have ties to the folks who are publicly traded in Germany who have invested in us,” he said. “We have designed, engineered, and we are building our vehicles separate from any other Volkswagen entity… We have designed these models. We have built them. We have the IP [intellectual property] for them. We have the technology for them. They are our vehicles, and Audi of America and Volkswagen of America, they do not have rights to those vehicles.”
paras.zh: “我们与投资我们的德国上市公司有联系，”他说。 “我们设计、制造并制造我们的车辆，与任何其他大众实体分开……我们设计了这些车型。我们制造了它们。我们拥有它们的IP（知识产权）。我们拥有它们的技术。它们是我们的车辆，美国奥迪和美国大众，他们对这些车辆没有权利。”

paras.en: Singh argued that Tennessee law prohibits a manufacturer from competing with an existing dealer of the same line make in the relevant market area; however, “there are no Scout dealers in Tennessee, not one,” he said.
paras.zh: 辛格辩称，田纳西州法律禁止制造商与相关市场区域内同类产品的现有经销商竞争；然而，“田纳西州没有童子军经销商，一个也没有，”他说。

paras.en: “Scout is a distinct automotive brand,” he said. “Volkswagen dealerships don’t sell Scout vehicles. Audi dealerships don’t sell Scout vehicles. And corporate affiliation does not somehow transform those dealerships into Scout dealerships.”
paras.zh: “Scout 是一个独特的汽车品牌，”他说。 “大众汽车经销店不销售 Scout 车辆。奥迪经销店也不销售 Scout 车辆。企业隶属关系并不会以某种方式将这些经销店转变为 Scout 经销店。”

paras.en: Scout is building a $2 billion production center in South Carolina, which Singh said is almost complete. He told the commission the center is slated for full production by the end of 2027, with vehicle delivery to customers planned for 2028.
paras.zh: Scout 正在南卡罗来纳州建造一个耗资 20 亿美元的生产中心，Singh 表示该中心已基本完工。他告诉委员会，该中心计划于 2027 年底全面投产，并计划于 2028 年向客户交付车辆。

paras.en: Before the commission voted, Singh said Scout applied for a Tennessee dealer license in March, ahead of when its vehicles would hit the road so it could connect with potential Tennessee customers.
paras.zh: 辛格表示，在委员会投票之前，Scout 在 3 月份申请了田纳西州经销商许可证，随后其车辆将上路，以便与潜在的田纳西州客户建立联系。

paras.en: “We are starting our build-out and our licensure in states around the country now so that consumers have that known place that they can take their vehicle once they purchase it,” Singh said.
paras.zh: 辛格说：“我们现在正在全国各州开始扩建和发放许可证，以便消费者在购买车辆后可以在一个已知的地方取车。”

paras.en: He added that once licensed in a state, potential customers can get information from Scout about its vehicles, including cost.
paras.zh: 他补充说，一旦在某个州获得许可，潜在客户就可以从 Scout 获得有关其车辆的信息，包括成本。

paras.en: “In states that we’re not licensed in, and we’re not allowed to sell in, we’re not sometimes allowed to talk about those things,” Singh said. “We have consumers in those states that really would like us to be able to engage with them… Consumers are demanding, and they should be. They should hold us accountable, and they should want more from us.”
paras.zh: 辛格说：“在我们没有获得许可、不允许销售的州，我们有时不被允许谈论这些事情。” “这些州的消费者确实希望我们能够与他们互动……消费者的要求很高，他们应该这样做。他们应该让我们承担责任，他们应该希望我们提供更多。”

paras.en: Nick Bader, an attorney who spoke on behalf of Volkswagen dealers in Tennessee, told the commission, “By being asked to grant Scout Motor Sales a dealer license, you are faced with a key question: can a car manufacturer that already sells through Tennessee dealers open its own dealership just by putting the store in the name of a subsidiary? The answer is no. Nothing about this application changes that. Scout is Volkswagen. They’re not part of a new entrant to the automotive space.”
paras.zh: 代表田纳西州大众汽车经销商发言的律师尼克·巴德 (Nick Bader) 告诉委员会，“当您被要求向 Scout Motor Sales 授予经销商许可证时，您将面临一个关键问题：已经通过田纳西州经销商进行销售的汽车制造商是否可以仅通过将商店以子公司的名义开设自己的经销店？答案是否定的。此应用程序不会改变这一点。Scout 是大众汽车。他们不是汽车领域新进入者的一部分。”

paras.en: Singh argued that the commission previously approved dealer applications involving manufacturing-affiliated sales entities, including Tesla and Rivian, “both of whom have automotive investment from companies that many of you are dealers of.”
paras.zh: 辛格辩称，该委员会此前批准了涉及制造附属销售实体的经销商申请，包括特斯拉和 Rivian，“这两家公司都拥有来自你们许多人都是其经销商的公司的汽车投资。”

paras.en: “We are asking for the same fair and consistent application of Tennessee’s licensing standards, the law that’s on the books,” he said.
paras.zh: “我们要求同样公平和一致地应用田纳西州的许可标准，即书面法律，”他说。

paras.en: Scout also faced opposition in Colorado over its direct sales model, and was ultimately granted a dealer license.
paras.zh: Scout 的直销模式在科罗拉多州也面临反对，但最终获得了经销商许可证。

paras.en: Featured image: The Scout Terra (Provided by Scout Motors)
paras.zh: 特色图片：Scout Terra（由 Scout Motors 提供）

articles.title: Toyota Kentucky gave $1.4 million in educational and workforce grants this year
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Toyota Kentucky has awarded $1.4 million in educational and workforce training grants this year to nonprofit organizations across Central Kentucky, according to a press release.
paras.zh: 据一份新闻稿称，丰田肯塔基州今年已向肯塔基州中部的非营利组织提供 140 万美元的教育和劳动力培训补助金。

paras.en: The grants support hands-on STEM education, mentoring, workforce training and career placement programs, the release adds. Toyota Kentucky says the programs help to equip students and job seekers with the skills, experience and opportunities they need to succeed.
paras.zh: 新闻稿补充说，这些赠款支持实践 STEM 教育、指导、劳动力培训和职业安置计划。丰田肯塔基州表示，这些项目有助于为学生和求职者提供成功所需的技能、经验和机会。

paras.en: “When students can see a future for themselves, incredible things happen,” said David Fernandes, Toyota Kentucky president. “We’ve seen young people progress from robotics competitions and mentoring programs to college classrooms and on to rewarding careers. That’s the kind of long-term impact these investments create.”
paras.zh: “当学生们能够看到自己的未来时，不可思议的事情就会发生，”丰田肯塔基州总裁戴维·费尔南德斯 (David Fernandes) 说道。 “我们看到年轻人从机器人竞赛和辅导项目到大学课堂，再到有价值的职业。这就是这些投资所产生的长期影响。”

paras.en: The automaker says that in celebration of its largest plant’s 40th anniversary, it has recognized four organizations with special $40,000 grants.
paras.zh: 该汽车制造商表示，为了庆祝其最大工厂成立 40 周年，它向四家组织提供了 4 万美元的特别赠款。

paras.en: “Big Brothers Big Sisters of the Bluegrass helps empower young people through transformative mentoring relationships.
paras.zh: “蓝草大兄弟大姐妹通过变革性的指导关系帮助年轻人增强能力。

paras.en: “AMEN House addresses food insecurity and helps students and families navigate times of need.
paras.zh: “AMEN House 解决粮食不安全问题，帮助学生和家庭度过困难时期。

paras.en: “Jubilee Jobs of Lexington connects people with meaningful employment through workforce training and career support.
paras.zh: “列克星敦的 Jubilee Jobs 通过劳动力培训和职业支持为人们提供有意义的就业机会。

paras.en: “Kentucky FIRST Robotics prepares students for future careers through hands-on STEM and robotics experiences.”
paras.zh: “肯塔基州 FIRST Robotics 通过实践 STEM 和机器人技术经验，为学生未来的职业生涯做好准备。”

paras.en: The organizations help young people build confidence, support families through challenging times and connect Kentuckians with educational and career opportunities that strengthen the region’s workforce, the release states.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称，这些组织帮助年轻人建立信心，支持家庭度过充满挑战的时期，并为肯塔基州人提供教育和职业机会，以增强该地区的劳动力。

paras.en: “Every student deserves the opportunity to see themselves as an innovator and leader,” said Kelli Gowan, KY FIRST Robotics executive director, in the release. “Toyota Kentucky’s support helps open doors for young people across Kentucky by giving them hands-on experiences that build the technical and teamwork skills that they need for the future.”
paras.zh: KY FIRST Robotics 执行董事 Kelli Gowan 在新闻稿中表示：“每个学生都应该有机会将自己视为创新者和领导者。” “丰田肯塔基州的支持为肯塔基州的年轻人打开了大门，为他们提供实践经验，培养他们未来所需的技术和团队合作技能。”

paras.en: Toyota Kentucky has invested more than $166 million in the state since it was created in 1986, according to the release.
paras.zh: 据新闻稿称，自 1986 年创建以来，丰田肯塔基州已在该州投资超过 1.66 亿美元。

articles.title: TechForce CEO warns collision industry risks being left behind in skilled trades workforce push
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: The pendulum is swinging, and major corporations with deep pockets are discussing the skilled workforce shortage, but that also means competition for a seat at the table will intensify, Jennifer Maher, TechForce Foundation CEO, told Repairer Driven News.
paras.zh: TechForce 基金会首席执行官 Jennifer Maher 告诉 Repairer Driven News，钟摆正在摆动，财力雄厚的大公司正在讨论熟练劳动力短缺问题，但这也意味着争夺席位的竞争将会加剧。

paras.en: “I worry that I don’t hear that same momentum in the collision industry,” Maher said.
paras.zh: “我担心我在碰撞行业中没有听到同样的势头，”马赫说。

paras.en: The U.S.Bureau of Labor has identified 47 different technician jobs using its standard occupational classification (SOC) system, Maher said. She said this includes everything from wind turbine techs to elevator technicians.
paras.zh: 马赫表示，美国劳工局利用其标准职业分类 (SOC) 系统确定了 47 种不同的技术人员职位。她说，这包括从风力涡轮机技术到电梯技术人员的一切。

paras.en: “We’re all competing for the same person,” Maher said. “The person who is curious, likes to problem solve, takes it apart and puts it back together, gets a thrill out of making things work.”
paras.zh: “我们都在为同一个人竞争，”马赫说。 “充满好奇心的人喜欢解决问题，将问题拆开再组装起来，并从让事情顺利进行中获得兴奋感。”

paras.en: The collision industry competes with all of these different technician sectors, she said. The industry is also competing with all of the skilled trades, which include electricians, construction workers and plumbers.
paras.zh: 她说，碰撞行业与所有​​这些不同的技术部门竞争。该行业还与所有技术行业竞争，包括电工、建筑工人和水管工。

paras.en: “You can’t just look at how to build collision techs in the collision program,” Maher said. “You have to cast your net really wide. We’re competing with all of those sectors.”
paras.zh: “你不能只关注如何在碰撞程序中构建碰撞技术，”马赫说。 “你必须把你的网撒得很广。我们正在与所有这些领域竞争。”

paras.en: Technicians are often overlooked in the conversation, she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说，技术人员在谈话中经常被忽视。

paras.en: “I call them our hidden heroes because we all need technicians and we need to recognize and start talking about the importance of those service and maintenance technicians,” Maher said.
paras.zh: “我称他们为隐藏的英雄，因为我们都需要技术人员，我们需要认识到并开始谈论这些服务和维护技术人员的重要性，”马赫说。

paras.en: As the pendulum swings, the conversation is heavily focused on construction jobs.
paras.zh: 随着钟摆的摆动，谈话主要集中在建筑工作上。

paras.en: “I appreciate the need to bring back manufacturing and build more plants, build more housing, and build more data centers. That’s exciting and great, but in my world, I’m asking how do we keep what we have moving?”
paras.zh: “我意识到有必要恢复制造业，建造更多工厂，建造更多住房，建造更多数据中心。这令人兴奋且伟大，但在我的世界里，我问的是我们如何保持我们现有的运转？”

paras.en: If technicians get lost in the conversation, then people will find themselves waiting on the tarmac because of a shortage of airplane technicians or waiting two months for their vehicle to be repaired because of a shortage of auto technicians, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，如果技术人员在谈话中迷失了方向，那么人们会发现自己因为飞机技术人员短缺而在停机坪上等待，或者因为汽车技术人员短缺而等待两个月才能修理车辆。

paras.en: “Techs are important and we need to be at the table,” Maher said. “That’s the bottom line, technicians need to be in the headlines and they need to be part of the excitement around the skilled trades.”
paras.zh: “技术很重要，我们需要参与其中，”马赫说。 “这是底线，技术人员需要成为头条新闻，他们需要成为技术行业令人兴奋的一部分。”

paras.en: The top 10 technician fields identified by the U.S. Bureau of Labor adds up to a workforce of 7 million people, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，美国劳工局确定的十大技术领域的劳动力总数为 700 万人。

paras.en: “Collectively they are a huge force but they are buried, hidden and not talked about,” Maher said.
paras.zh: 马赫说：“总的来说，他们是一股巨大的力量，但他们被埋葬、隐藏起来，没有被谈论。”

paras.en: Even under the Bureau of Labor’s classification system, technicians are scattered throughout different industries including transportation, energy, industrial manufacturing and construction, she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说，即使根据劳工局的分类制度，技术人员也分散在不同行业，包括交通、能源、工业制造和建筑。

paras.en: TechForce’s “Technician Supply, Demand & Opportunity Report.” found the U.S. economy is short roughly 140,000 skilled technicians a year, and the gap is widening, with 73,354 new collision repair entrant technicians needed by 2029.
paras.zh: TechForce 的“技术人员供应、需求和机会报告”。研究发现，美国经济每年大约短缺 14 万名熟练技术人员，而且缺口还在扩大，到 2029 年需要 73,354 名新的碰撞维修技术人员。

paras.en: It found that the collision repair sector sees the highest turnover of the 10 analyzed at 60.7%.
paras.zh: 调查发现，在分析的 10 个行业中，碰撞维修行业的营业额最高，达到 60.7%。

paras.en: Maher said TechForce Foundation continuously polls its 125,000 aspiring working techs to see which industries excite them.
paras.zh: Maher 表示，TechForce 基金会不断对其 125,000 名有抱负的技术人员进行民意调查，看看哪些行业让他们感兴趣。

paras.en: “I am worried about the collision industry because it does not resonate above the fold,” Maher said. “It is way down, way down on the list.”
paras.zh: “我对碰撞行业感到担忧，因为它不会引起大众的共鸣，”马赫说。 “它在名单上排名靠后，非常靠后。”

paras.en: That is going to be a recruiting challenge for the collision industry, she adds.
paras.zh: 她补充道，这对于碰撞行业来说将是一个招聘挑战。

paras.en: “It is a supply and demand economy,” Maher said. “When you look at wages, it’s not at the top. If it’s the same type of person and they start to learn their options, thanks to AI now, they can just ask. In the past, they didn’t know how to compare and they weren’t going to do that much research.”
paras.zh: “这是一个供需经济，”马赫说。 “当你看工资时，你会发现它并不是最高的。如果是同一类型的人，他们开始了解自己的选择，感谢现在的人工智能，他们只需询问即可。过去，他们不知道如何比较，也不会做那么多研究。”

paras.en: For every 10 collision techs needed, schools are only producing four, Maher states.
paras.zh: 马赫表示，每需要 10 名碰撞技术人员，学校只能培养 4 名。

paras.en: “That leaves us more than 8,000 techs short every year, and what scares me most is that 6 in 10 leave their job every year,” Maher says. “Retention is just as big of an issue as recruitment.”
paras.zh: “这使得我们每年短缺 8,000 多名技术人员，最让我害怕的是每年有十分之六的人离职，”马赫说。 “留住人才和招聘一样都是一个大问题。”

paras.en: Ford is one catalyst swinging the pendulum and auto and collision technicians have been a part of that conversation.
paras.zh: 福特是推动这一趋势的催化剂之一，汽车和碰撞技术人员也参与了这场对话。

paras.en: CEO Jim Farley launched the ACCELERATE The Essential Economy event last year to start the conversation. It was held again last month.
paras.zh: 首席执行官吉姆·法利（Jim Farley）去年发起了“加速基本经济”活动来开启对话。上个月再次举行。

paras.en: Through the event, the Alliance for America’s Skilled Trades was started and the State of America’s Skilled Trades: A National Report was funded.
paras.zh: 通过该活动，美国技术行业联盟成立，并为《美国技术行业状况：国家报告》提供了资金。

paras.en: The Alliance has brought together major companies such as BlackRock, Google, Carhartt, NVIDIA, Microsoft and Milwaukee Tool to fund initiatives focused on the shortage.
paras.zh: 该联盟汇集了 BlackRock、Google、Carhartt、NVIDIA、Microsoft 和 Milwaukee Tool 等主要公司，为针对短缺问题的举措提供资金。

paras.en: The State of America’s Skilled Trades report found the employment growth rate for automotive body and related repair to be 0.6% between 2019 and 2025.
paras.zh: 美国技术行业报告发现，2019 年至 2025 年间，汽车车身及相关维修行业的就业增长率为 0.6%。

paras.en: It also found that Auto body and other related repairers rank 118 out of 525 other occupations facing national shortage pressure.
paras.zh: 调查还发现，汽车车身及其他相关维修工在全国面临短缺压力的525个其他职业中排名第118位。

paras.en: “Ford is looking at industrial manufacturing, who is repairing the conveyor belt, the robotic techs. And Ford dealerships are all over the country,” Maher said. “They know their product and their consumer and the challenges when it comes to hiring boots on the ground. Which is why they’re investing in solutions”
paras.zh: “福特正在关注工业制造，谁正在修理传送带和机器人技术。福特经销商遍布全国，”马赫说。 “他们了解自己的产品、消费者，以及在现场招聘员工时面临的挑战。这就是他们投资解决方案的原因”

paras.en: Ford Motor Company and Ford Philanthropy make up TechForce’s largest donor at $4.5 million.
paras.zh: 福特汽车公司和福特慈善机构是 TechForce 的最大捐助者，捐赠金额达 450 万美元。

paras.en: “They support scholarships for people to become auto tech with no strings attached, “ Maher said. “It’s not like you have to go and work for Ford.”
paras.zh: “他们支持为人们提供奖学金，让他们成为无附加条件的汽车技术人员，”马赫说。 “这并不是说你必须去福特工作。”

paras.en: Ford has been at the forefront of having a strategy and a plan for the shortage, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，福特一直处于制定短缺战略和计划的最前沿。

paras.en: This includes Ford addressing the transportation issues that make a student dropout through a partnership with Lyft.
paras.zh: 其中包括福特通过与 Lyft 合作解决导致学生辍学的交通问题。

paras.en: Other OEMs are also working on the issue but everybody needs to invest to get students to the finish line, she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说，其他原始设备制造商也在解决这个问题，但每个人都需要投资才能让学生到达终点线。

paras.en: “It is not just enough to change or enhance curriculum; people want faster, shorter ways to earn the credentials or training and get to work,” Maher said. “How do we accelerate that learning? How do we have more apprenticeships because retention continues to be a hurdle, especially in the collision industry?”
paras.zh: “仅仅改变或加强课程是不够的；人们希望以更快、更短的方式获得证书或培训并开始工作，”马赫说。 “我们如何加速学习？我们如何拥有更多的学徒，因为保留仍然是一个障碍，特别是在碰撞行业？”

paras.en: TechForce believes students need to understand what the job really entails and that is through job shadowing, apprenticeships and a day in the life content.
paras.zh: TechForce 认为，学生需要了解这份工作的真正含义，即通过工作见习、学徒期和一天的生活内容。

paras.en: The organization is working on building AI tools for Gen Z so they can receive the information in a way that they want it.
paras.zh: 该组织正在致力于为 Z 世代构建人工智能工具，以便他们能够以自己想要的方式接收信息。

paras.en: “We also have to help students throughout the workforce journey, through that funnel,” Maher said. “It’s not enough for TechForce to give them a scholarship and wish them well. There are so many other challenges: transportation, childcare, food insecurity. Life happens.”
paras.zh: 马赫说：“我们还必须通过这个渠道，在整个劳动力旅程中帮助学生。” “TechForce 仅仅为他们提供奖学金并祝愿他们一切顺利是不够的。还有很多其他挑战：交通、儿童保育、粮食不安全。生活会发生。”

paras.en: Five-hundred dollars is the difference between keeping them in school or them getting derailed, Maher adds.
paras.zh: 马赫补充道，五百美元是让他们留在学校还是出轨的区别。

paras.en: During the ACCELERATE event, Farley also pointed to data from the new report that shows high-quality apprenticeships that include apprentice support are more likely to lead more workers into the economy.
paras.zh: 在加速活动期间，法利还指出了新报告中的数据，该数据显示包括学徒支持在内的高质量学徒制更有可能引导更多工人进入经济领域。

paras.en: The report found traditional training methods had only about a 50% completion rate. It also found that high-quality apprenticeship programs have a completion rate of more than 90%.
paras.zh: 报告发现，传统培训方法的完成率只有 50% 左右。调查还发现，高质量学徒计划的完成率超过 90%。

paras.en: ”We need the social programs to help and support, and we need the programs to be accredited and we need employers to be connected to these apprenticeships so that the people have a job,” Farley said.
paras.zh: 法利说：“我们需要社会计划来帮助和支持，我们需要这些计划得到认可，我们需要雇主与这些学徒计划建立联系，以便人们找到工作。”

paras.en: This is one way that collision shops can be a part of the solution, Maher said. A $500 donation could help one more student make their way through the program.
paras.zh: 马赫说，这是碰撞车间成为解决方案一部分的一种方式。捐款 500 美元可以帮助多一名学生完成该计划。

paras.en: “I truly believe if everybody isn’t a part of the solution, then they’re going to be part of the problem,” Maher said. “I have attended conferences and tried to let the collision industry know that TechForce is here and what we do. Yet, after three years, we have only two donors: LKQ and OEM Collision Roundtable.”
paras.zh: 马赫说：“我坚信，如果每个人都不是解决方案的一部分，那么他们就会成为问题的一部分。” “我参加过会议，并试图让碰撞行业知道 TechForce 在这里以及我们在做什么。然而，三年后，我们只有两个捐助者：LKQ 和 OEM Collision Roundtable。”

paras.en: Maher says that the collision industry is very generous to other educational programs that don’t provide scholarships to students or help them learn durable skills or get jobs.
paras.zh: 马赫表示，碰撞行业对其他不向学生提供奖学金或帮助他们学习持久技能或找到工作的教育项目非常慷慨。

paras.en: “They don’t get the students through the funnel and into industry careers,” Maher said.
paras.zh: “他们没有让学生通过渠道进入行业职业生涯，”马赫说。

paras.en: The industry needs to diversify its contributions for the best result, she adds.
paras.zh: 她补充说，该行业需要多样化贡献才能获得最佳结果。

paras.en: “That would be my challenge to the industry. Ford and others are looking at multiple ways to solve the problem and it is not a one-hit wonder,” Maher said.
paras.zh: “这将是我对整个行业的挑战。福特和其他公司正在寻找多种方法来解决这个问题，这并不是一击即成的奇迹，”马赫说。

paras.en: During the ACCELERATE event, Maher told the crowd that the organization has 125,000 students in its network who want to become professional skilled technicians.
paras.zh: 在 ACCELERATE 活动期间，Maher 告诉人群，该组织的网络中有 125,000 名希望成为专业技术人员的学生。

paras.en: “I used to award 1 in every 6 scholarships; the demand is rising now to 1 in every 10,” Maher
paras.zh: “我过去每 6 份奖学金中就有 1 份获得奖学金；现在需求上升到每 10 份就有 1 份，”马赫

paras.en: said. “The people want to do the work, but they need some support for that one year or so to get trained so that you can hire them or find that you exist. The fact is that TechForce has more demand from aspiring technicians than we have money to support. That is an investment worth
paras.zh: 说。 “人们想做这项工作，但他们需要一年左右的支持来接受培训，以便你可以雇用他们或发现你的存在。事实是，TechForce 对有抱负的技术人员的需求比我们有资金支持的要多。这是一项值得投资的投资

paras.en: making. They are already here; help us get them to you.”
paras.zh: 制作。他们已经在这里了；帮助我们把它们交给你。”

paras.en: Collision shops can individually be a part of the solution by contributing in a few ways, Maher said.
paras.zh: 马赫说，碰撞车间可以通过多种方式单独成为解决方案的一部分。

paras.en: A $1,200 a year donation supports a Boys and Girls Club of America dinner. This allows shops to say they are a TechForce champion and allows them to go into area schools that have the program, she said.
paras.zh: 每年捐款 1,200 美元支持美国男孩女孩俱乐部的晚宴。她说，这让商店可以说他们是 TechForce 的冠军，并允许他们进入有该项目的地区学校。

paras.en: A $12,500 donation can fund a named scholarship in your community, Maher adds. Shops are able to see tuition scholarships go to aspiring techs at their area schools and volunteer locally, she said. You can meet your awardees, and promote their success through local papers with the help of TechForce.
paras.zh: Maher 补充道，12,500 美元的捐款可以资助您所在社区的一项指定奖学金。她说，商店可以看到学费奖学金发放给当地学校有抱负的技术人员和当地志愿者。您可以与获奖者见面，并在 TechForce 的帮助下通过当地报纸宣传他们的成功。

paras.en: The scholarship can also be promoted through local papers with the help of TechForce.
paras.zh: 该奖学金还可以在 TechForce 的帮助下通过当地报纸进行推广。

paras.en: To help recruit technicians, shops should also look at their culture.
paras.zh: 为了帮助招聘技术人员，商店还应该看看他们的文化。

paras.en: Gen Z is a gaming generation, Maher said. They need a plan to level up.
paras.zh: 马赫表示，Z 世代是游戏一代。他们需要一个升级计划。

paras.en: ”Have a career path mapped out for people,” Maher said. “We have an entry-level position. We make sure you can perfect A, B, and C. When we see you can accomplish and master those skills, we move you to level B.”
paras.zh: “为人们制定职业道路，”马赫说。 “我们有一个入门级职位。我们确保您能够完善 A、B 和 C。当我们看到您能够完成并掌握这些技能时，我们会将您提升到 B 级。”

paras.en: Shops should also look at their atmosphere.
paras.zh: 商店还应该看看他们的气氛。

paras.en: “It’s a supply and demand economy,” Maher said. “They can pick and choose. So what’s your pay? Do you have air conditioning or not? Do you make women wear boxy male uniforms?”
paras.zh: “这是一个供需经济，”马赫说。 “他们可以挑选。那你的工资是多少？有空调吗？你让女人穿四四方方的男制服吗？”

paras.en: Maher said another culture change would be to actively welcome women.
paras.zh: 马赫表示，另一种文化变革是积极欢迎女性。

paras.en: “Women are less than 4% of technicians across the trades,” Maher said. “If you want to solve a shortage, welcome to 50% of the population.”
paras.zh: “在各行业的技术人员中，女性所占比例不到 4%，”马赫说道。 “如果你想解决短缺问题，欢迎50%的人口加入。”

paras.en: Women are more likely to graduate college than men but men are more likely to graduate trade school, Maher added.
paras.zh: 马赫补充说，女性比男性更有可能从大学毕业，但男性更有可能从贸易学校毕业。

paras.en: “Why?” Maher said. “It’s called self-doubt. When you are the only female in the classroom and you are getting harassed, you’re like, ‘I’m out of here. I don’t belong.’ Create a sense of belonging. Ensure they feel supported. Have a female tech be part of the interview, then women would see themselves in the industry.”
paras.zh: “为什么？”马赫说。 “这就是自我怀疑。当你是教室里唯一的女性并且受到骚扰时，你会想，‘我离开这里了。我不属于这里。’创造一种归属感。确保他们感到支持。让一位女性技术人员参与面试，然后女性就会在这个行业中看到自己。”

paras.en: The industry should also tap into what makes it unique, Maher said.
paras.zh: 马赫表示，该行业还应该挖掘其独特之处。

paras.en: She explained how TechForce did a public service announcement for the collision industry a couple years ago, interviewing collision students for the script. The word students continued to use was “art.”
paras.zh: 她解释了 TechForce 几年前如何为碰撞行业发布公益公告，采访碰撞学生以撰写剧本。学生们继续使用的词是“艺术”。

paras.en: Students said they loved that they took a crashed vehicle and put it back together.
paras.zh: 学生们表示，他们喜欢将一辆撞毁的车辆重新组装起来。

paras.en: ”There is pride in that work,” Maher said.
paras.zh: “这项工作让人感到自豪，”马赫说。

paras.en: The video is free for any collision shop to download and share to promote the profession, she adds.
paras.zh: 她补充说，该视频可供任何碰撞商店免费下载和分享，以宣传该行业。

paras.en: Shops overall may feel helpless because they haven’t seen a return on investment when donating to workforce causes.
paras.zh: 总体而言，商店可能会感到无助，因为他们在为劳动力事业捐款时没有看到投资回报。

paras.en: “I encourage them to look at multiple solutions–various organizations– because it is really not a one-hit wonder,” Maher said. “A lot of us have to do different pieces to make a dent.”
paras.zh: “我鼓励他们考虑多种解决方案——不同的组织——因为这确实不是一击即成的奇迹，”马赫说。 “我们很多人都必须做不同的事情才能有所作为。”

paras.zh: TechForce 基金会首席执行官 Jennifer Maher 在 ACCELERATE 上的特写图片由 TechForce 基金会提供。

articles.title: Vehicle Interior Stain and Odor Removal
articles.author: Tomorrow's Technician Staff

paras.en: For aspiring automotive technicians, detailing offers more than a way to keep vehicles looking their best. It can be a lucrative career path for those who develop the right skills, understand cleaning chemistry and take pride in delivering professional results. From removing stubborn stains to eliminating lingering odors, successful detailers know that proper diagnosis is just as important as the products they use. This article, originally published in our sister publication, Professional Carwashing & Detailing, explores the techniques and knowledge that help detailers tackle tough interior cleaning challenges and build customer trust.
paras.zh: 对于有抱负的汽车技术人员来说，细节设计不仅仅是让车辆保持最佳状态的一种方法。对于那些培养正确技能、了解清洁化学并以提供专业成果为荣的人来说，这可能是一条利润丰厚的职业道路。从去除顽固污渍到消除挥之不去的气味，成功的美容师知道正确的诊断与他们使用的产品同样重要。本文最初发表在我们的姊妹出版物《专业洗车和细节》上，探讨了帮助细节人员应对严峻的内饰清洁挑战并建立客户信任的技术和知识。

paras.en: A vehicle interior can look clean and still send a customer straight back to the counter a week later, complaining about a smell that never fully went away. Interior stain and odor removal only works when a technician identifies what caused the problem before reaching for a product, because the wrong chemistry can leave a stain looking gone while the source of the smell keeps growing underneath it.
paras.zh: 车辆内部可能看起来很干净，但一周后仍然会让顾客直接回到柜台，抱怨气味从未完全消失。只有当技术人员在使用产品之前找出导致问题的原因时，内部污渍和异味去除才有效，因为错误的化学物质可能会使污渍看起来消失，而气味源却在其下面不断生长。

paras.en: Nearly every interior stain falls into one of two buckets: organic or inorganic. Organic stains come from anything that was once alive or contains proteins and sugars, such as blood, vomit, food or drink spills. Inorganic stains come from mineral or petroleum-based sources, including ink, tar, grease and fuel. Knowing which category a stain belongs to determines which product actually breaks it down, because a cleaner built for mineral deposits won’t touch a protein-based stain, and the reverse is just as true.
paras.zh: 几乎所有的内部污渍都属于两个类别之一：有机污渍或无机污渍。有机污渍来自任何曾经存在过的东西或含有蛋白质和糖的东西，例如血液、呕吐物、食物或饮料溢出物。无机污渍来自矿物或石油来源，包括墨水、焦油、油脂和燃料。了解污渍属于哪一类就决定了哪种产品能够真正分解它，因为专为矿物质沉积而设计的清洁剂不会接触基于蛋白质的污渍，反之亦然。

paras.en: Blood is a useful example of why this matters. As a protein-based stain, blood responds to an enzyme approach that breaks down the protein structure rather than a harsh solvent that might set the stain further into the fabric. Using the wrong product on a protein stain is one of the more common mistakes new technicians make, usually because the stain looks similar to other marks on the surface without any obvious clue about its origin.
paras.zh: 血液是一个很好的例子，说明了这一点为何如此重要。作为一种基于蛋白质的污渍，血液会对分解蛋白质结构的酶方法产生反应，而不是可能使污渍进一步渗入织物中的刺激性溶剂。在蛋白质污渍上使用错误的产品是新技术人员最常犯的错误之一，通常是因为污渍看起来与表面上的其他标记相似，而没有任何关于其来源的明显线索。

paras.en: Coffee and wine deserve a special mention here, since both contain tannins, a naturally occurring compound that stains fabric differently than a straightforward organic spill. A cup of black coffee behaves one way on fabric, while the same cup with creamer added introduces a protein element that changes the cleaning approach entirely. A technician who treats every beverage stain the same way will eventually run into one that doesn’t respond as expected.
paras.zh: 这里值得特别提及咖啡和葡萄酒，因为两者都含有单宁酸，这是一种天然存在的化合物，对织物的染色与直接有机溢出物的染色方式不同。一杯黑咖啡在织物上的表现是一种方式，而同一杯添加了奶精的咖啡则引入了一种蛋白质元素，完全改变了清洁方法。以相同方式处理每种饮料污渍的技术人员最终会遇到无法按预期响应的污渍。

paras.en: Odor removal fails most often because a technician masks a smell instead of eliminating what’s causing it. Spraying a fragrance over a lingering odor covers the problem for a day or two at best, and the smell always returns because the bacteria or contamination that produced it is still sitting in the fabric, carpet padding or seams.
paras.zh: 除味失败最常见的原因是技术人员掩盖了气味，而不是消除了产生气味的原因。在挥之不去的气味上喷洒香水最多可以解决一两天的问题，而且气味总是会再次出现，因为产生气味的细菌或污染物仍然存在于织物、地毯衬垫或接缝中。

paras.en: A fuel spill in a trunk illustrates the point well. Gasoline soaked into carpet or trunk lining leaves behind a source that keeps producing odor until every trace of the contamination is broken down and removed, not just covered up. Skipping that step means a customer drives away satisfied, then calls back a week later just as frustrated as before. That repeat complaint costs far more time than doing the job right the first time.
paras.zh: 后备箱中的燃油泄漏很好地说明了这一点。浸入地毯或行李箱衬里的汽油会留下一个不断产生气味的来源，直到所有污染物的痕迹都被分解和清除，而不是仅仅被掩盖。跳过这一步意味着客户满意地离开，然后一周后再次打电话，就像以前一样沮丧。重复的抱怨比第一次就把工作做好要花费更多的时间。

paras.en: Enzyme cleaners on organic contamination
paras.zh: 针对有机污染的酶清洁剂

paras.en: Enzyme-based cleaners are one of the most effective — and most underused — tools for organic stains and odors. An enzyme cleaner activates once mixed with water and introduces a bacterium that targets and consumes the organic material causing a smell, whether that’s a blood stain, a food spill or bacterial growth. The process takes a little patience. Spraying the affected area, letting the product dwell for roughly 30 minutes and repeating the application on a stubborn case allows the enzyme time to fully work through the contamination rather than just sit on the surface.
paras.zh: 酶清洁剂是去除有机污渍和异味的最有效且最未被充分利用的工具之一。酶清洁剂一旦与水混合就会激活，并引入一种细菌，该细菌瞄准并消耗产生气味的有机物质，无论是血迹、食物溢出还是细菌生长。这个过程需要一点耐心。喷洒受影响的区域，让产品停留大约 30 分钟，然后在顽固的病例上重复涂抹，让酶有时间充分发挥作用，而不是仅仅停留在表面。

paras.en: A moldy interior compartment shows how this plays out on a tough job. Heavy mold growth typically needs an actual mold remover first to break down the surface growth and degrease the area, followed by an enzyme treatment to address the bacteria left behind. One application often improves the smell noticeably, and a second application on the same spot can eliminate it completely. Enzyme cleaners are also gentle enough for regular use around fabric and upholstery, making them a safer everyday option than harsher alternatives.
paras.zh: 发霉的内部隔层显示了这是如何在一项艰巨的工作中发挥作用的。严重霉菌生长通常需要首先使用实际的霉菌去除剂来分解表面生长并对该区域进行脱脂，然后进行酶处理以消除残留的细菌。一次涂抹通常会显着改善气味，在同一位置涂抹第二次可以完全消除气味。酶清洁剂也足够温和，适合经常在织物和室内装饰周围使用，这使得它们比更刺激的替代品更安全的日常选择。

paras.en: Inorganic contamination calls for a different approach entirely. Citrus-based cleaners, built on natural solvents distilled from orange peels, cut through tar, grease, adhesive residue and general grime without being as aggressive on surfaces as a heavier solvent, such as lacquer thinner. These products work well in cracks, crevices and other tight spots where inorganic buildup tends to collect, and they hold up as reliable all-purpose options across a shop.
paras.zh: 无机污染需要完全不同的方法。柑橘类清洁剂采用从橙皮中蒸馏出来的天然溶剂制成，可去除焦油、油脂、粘合剂残留物和一般污垢，而不会像清漆稀释剂等较重的溶剂那样对表面具有侵蚀性。这些产品在无机堆积物容易聚集的裂缝、缝隙和其他狭窄部位效果很好，并且它们是整个商店可靠的多用途选择。

paras.en: Reaching for a citrus or solvent-based product on an organic stain, or an enzyme cleaner on a mineral or fuel-based stain, wastes time and product without solving the underlying problem. Matching the chemistry to the contamination type the first time keeps a job efficient instead of turning into a guessing game of trying one product after another.
paras.zh: 在有机污渍上使用柑橘或溶剂型产品，或者在矿物或燃料基污渍上使用酶清洁剂，会浪费时间和产品，而无法解决根本问题。第一次将化学成分与污染类型相匹配可以保持工作效率，而不是变成一个又一个尝试产品的猜谜游戏。

paras.en: Interior stain and odor removal often means working in an enclosed vehicle cabin with limited airflow, and some of the products best suited for tough organic contamination carry real fumes. An N95 mask, gloves and eye protection belong in the kit for any deep interior job, particularly mold remediation or heavy odor cases that require extended dwell time in a closed space.
paras.zh: 去除内部污渍和异味通常意味着在气流有限的封闭车厢内工作，而一些最适合顽固有机污染物的产品会携带真正的烟雾。套件中包含 N95 口罩、手套和护目镜，适用于任何深层室内作业，特别是需要在封闭空间中延长停留时间的霉菌修复或重味情况。

paras.en: Comfort matters too. Gloves protect hands from repeated exposure to degreasers and enzyme concentrates over the course of a shift, preventing the cracked skin and irritation that come from skipping protection on jobs that seem routine.
paras.zh: 舒适度也很重要。手套可以保护双手在轮班过程中避免反复接触脱脂剂和酶浓缩物，从而防止因在看似例行公事的工作中跳过防护措施而导致皮肤破裂和刺激。

paras.en: Before treating any interior stain or odor, a quick assessment pays off. Find out what caused it, how long it has been there and whether the source is organic or inorganic. That 30-second habit shapes every decision that follows, from which product to grab to how long a treatment needs to dwell before rinsing or extracting.
paras.zh: 在处理任何内部污渍或异味之前，快速评估会有所帮助。找出造成这种情况的原因、存在的时间以及来源是有机的还是无机的。这个 30 秒的习惯决定了接下来的每一个决定，从选择哪种产品到在冲洗或提取之前需要进行治疗多长时间。

paras.en: Shops that train technicians to diagnose before they clean spend less time on redos and callbacks. Customers rarely understand the chemistry behind a properly cleaned interior, but they notice immediately when a smell comes back, and a shop that consistently solves the problem the first time builds the kind of trust that keeps customers coming back for more than just a wash.
paras.zh: 培训技术人员在清洁前进行诊断的商店可以减少重做和回调的时间。顾客很少了解经过适当清洁的内饰背后的化学成分，但当气味再次出现时，他们会立即注意到，而一家始终如一地在第一时间解决问题的商店会建立起一种信任，让顾客再次光顾，而不仅仅是清洗。

paras.en: This article was originally contributed by Stinger Chemical. For more information on Stinger Chemical, visit www.stingerchemicals.com.
paras.zh: 本文最初由 Stinger Chemical 贡献。有关 Stinger Chemical 的更多信息，请访问 www.stingerchemicals.com。

articles.title: AkzoNobel Launches Modern Vintage Refinish Line
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: AkzoNobel has announced the launch of Modern Vintage, a groundbreaking refinish product line that gives vehicle owners, professional builders, restoration shops and refinish professionals access to an extensive library of authentic OEM colors spanning more than 140 years of automotive history — all recreated using proven, premium Sikkens refinish technology.
paras.zh: 阿克苏诺贝尔宣布推出 Modern Vintage，这是一条突破性的修补漆产品线，让车主、专业制造商、修复店和修补漆专业人士能够访问涵盖 140 多年汽车历史的丰富的正宗 OEM 颜色库，所有颜色均采用经过验证的优质新肯修补漆技术重新打造。

paras.en: Developed in partnership with renowned custom vehicle builder and television personality Dave Kindig of Kindig-it Design, Modern Vintage bridges the gap between automotive color heritage and the performance demands of today’s refinish market. The full product line is available exclusively through TCP Global, whose Auto Color Library supplies the historic color reference behind every formula and whose color lab mixes, fills and ships each order direct to the customer’s door.
paras.zh: Modern Vintage 是与著名的定制汽车制造商和 Kindig-it Design 的电视名人 Dave Kindig 合作开发的，它弥合了汽车色彩传统与当今修补漆市场的性能需求之间的差距。完整的产品线仅通过 TCP Global 提供，其自动颜色库提供每个配方背后的历史颜色参考，其颜色实验室混合、填充每个订单并将其直接运送到客户家门口。

paras.en: Modern Vintage gives restorers and builders the ability to search by year, make, model and OEM paint code to find and recreate the precise factory color of virtually any vehicle — from legendary American classics to rare international models.
paras.zh: Modern Vintage 使修复者和建造者能够按年份、制造商、型号和 OEM 油漆代码进行搜索，以查找和重新创建几乎所有车辆的精确出厂颜色 - 从传奇的美国经典到稀有的国际车型。

paras.en: TCP Global’s Auto Color Library, the largest online automotive paint color reference library in the world, holds OEM chips and formulas reaching back to the early 1900s, and its color lab is equipped to mix, fill and ship those colors to order.
paras.zh: TCP Global 的汽车颜色库是世界上最大的在线汽车油漆颜色参考库，拥有可追溯到 1900 年代初期的 OEM 芯片和配方，其颜色实验室配备了混合、填充和按订单运输这些颜色的能力。

paras.en: While the colors are historic, the paint technology is anything but. Sikkens, founded in 1792 and one of the world’s most respected refinish brands, underpins every Modern Vintage formulation — delivering the modern performance, durability and finish quality expected from a premium paint system.
paras.zh: 虽然颜色具有历史意义，但油漆技术却绝非如此。 Sikkens 成立于 1792 年，是世界上最受尊敬的修补漆品牌之一，为每一种 Modern Vintage 配方提供支撑 — 提供优质油漆系统所期望的现代性能、耐用性和漆面质量。

paras.en: Dave Kindig brings authentic credibility to Modern Vintage. As the founder of Kindig-It Design and a leading voice in the custom and vintage vehicle world, Kindig’s passion for period-correct color and craftsmanship aligns directly with the product’s mission. Modern Vintage also connects naturally with the established Modern Classikk color collection, giving customers a complete ecosystem for both vintage restoration and custom builds.
paras.zh: Dave Kindig 为现代复古带来了真正的可信度。作为 Kindig-It Design 的创始人以及定制和古董车领域的领军人物，Kindig 对符合时代色彩和工艺的热情与产品的使命直接一致。 Modern Vintage 还与成熟的 Modern Classikk 色彩系列自然地联系在一起，为客户提供了一个完整的复古修复和定制生态系统。

paras.en: “We’re bringing exciting announcements to our customers at SEMA,” said Maximilien Schréder, commercial director, AkzoNobel North American Automotive & Specialty Coatings. “Modern Vintage completes our portfolio of Sikkens refinish technology for custom and OEM matching colors to distributors, shops and restorers.”
paras.zh: 阿克苏诺贝尔北美汽车和特种涂料业务总监 Maximilien Schréder 表示：“我们在 SEMA 上向客户发布了令人兴奋的消息。” “Modern Vintage 完善了我们的新劲修补漆技术组合，为经销商、商店和修复商提供定制和 OEM 匹配颜色。”

paras.en: “I’ve always believed every great build starts with the right color,” said Dave Kindig, founder and creative director, Kindig-It Design. “Modern Vintage brings the right color, every time, with state-of-the-art Sikkens paint technology.”
paras.zh: “我始终相信，每一个伟大的建筑都始于正确的颜色，”Kindig-It Design 创始人兼创意总监 Dave Kindig 说道。 “Modern Vintage 凭借最先进的新劲油漆技术，每次都能带来正确的色彩。”

paras.en: “Restorers don’t want a modern interpretation of an old color — they want the color that was on the car when it left the production line,” said Dean Faucett, president, TCP Global. “We have spent decades building an archive that can answer that question, and pairing it with Sikkens technology and Dave’s eye is the first time the history and the performance have come together in one product.”
paras.zh: TCP Global 总裁 Dean Faucett 表示：“修复者不希望对旧颜色进行现代诠释，他们想要的是汽车离开生产线时的颜色。” “我们花了几十年的时间建立了一个可以回答这个问题的档案，并将其与新肯技术和戴夫的眼睛相结合，这是历史和性能第一次在一个产品中结合在一起。”

paras.en: - 140+ years of OEM color history — domestic and international makes and models
paras.zh: - 140 多年的 OEM 色彩历史 — 国内和国际品牌和型号

paras.en: - Search by year, make, model and OEM paint code for precise color matching
paras.zh: - 按年份、品牌、型号和 OEM 油漆代码搜索，以实现精确的颜色匹配

paras.en: - Premium Sikkens refinish technology for modern performance and finish quality
paras.zh: - 高级新肯修补漆技术，实现现代性能和饰面质量

paras.en: - Available through TCP Global with fast direct-to-door shipping
paras.zh: - 通过 TCP Global 提供快速直接送货上门服务

paras.en: - Backed by Dave Kindig — trusted builder, restorer and automotive creative authority
paras.zh: - 由值得信赖的建造者、修复者和汽车创意权威 Dave Kindig 提供支持

paras.en: Modern Vintage is available now through TCP Global at https://tcpglobal.com, where customers can search by year, make, model and OEM code and order paint mixed to that code. For professional inquiries, existing Sikkens customers and refinish facilities can contact their local Sikkens representative or visit sikkensvr.com/en-us. More details on Modern Vintage are available at modernvintagepaint.com.
paras.zh: Modern Vintage 现已通过 TCP Global（网址为 https://tcpglobal.com）提供，客户可以按年份、品牌、型号和 OEM 代码进行搜索，并订购与该代码混合的油漆。对于专业咨询，现有的新肯斯客户和修补漆工厂可以联系当地的新肯斯代表或访问 sikkensvr.com/en-us。有关现代复古的更多详细信息，请访问modernvintagepaint.com。

paras.en: For more information on AkzoNobel’s Vehicle Refinish business, visit akzonobel.com.
paras.zh: 有关阿克苏诺贝尔车辆修补漆业务的更多信息，请访问 akzonobel.com。

articles.title: Niterra President and CEO Mike Schwab on ‘Delivering Trusted Solutions’
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: This episode of DriveTime features Mike Schwab, president and CEO of Niterra North America, Inc.
paras.zh: 本期 DriveTime 的主角是 Niterra North America, Inc. 的总裁兼首席执行官 Mike Schwab。

paras.en: Schwab said Niterra has evolved well beyond its roots as an ignition specialist while maintaining the quality and reliability associated with its NGK brand. Today, Niterra’s automotive portfolio extends beyond spark plugs to include ignition coils, wire sets, NTK oxygen and technical sensors and rotating electrical products such as starters and alternators.
paras.zh: Schwab 表示，Niterra 已经远远超越了其作为点火专家的根源，同时保持了 NGK 品牌相关的质量和可靠性。如今，Niterra 的汽车产品组合已不仅仅局限于火花塞，还包括点火线圈、电线组、NTK 氧气和技术传感器以及起动机和交流发电机等旋转电气产品。

paras.en: Schwab emphasized that quality, integrity, teamwork and consistent execution remain fundamental to Niterra’s business strategy, even as the industry evolves. These principles, he says, guide how the company serves customers, from delivering dependable products and maintaining transparency to strengthening partnerships and addressing customer challenges. Schwab emphasized that execution means consistently delivering on commitments involving product availability, customer service and new product introductions. While technology and product offerings will continue to change, he believes trust, reliability and strong customer relationships will remain essential to the company’s long-term success.
paras.zh: Schwab 强调，即使行业不断发展，质量、诚信、团队合作和一致执行仍然是 Niterra 业务战略的基础。他说，这些原则指导公司如何服务客户，从提供可靠的产品和保持透明度到加强合作伙伴关系和应对客户挑战。施瓦布强调，执行意味着始终如一地兑现涉及产品可用性、客户服务和新产品推出的承诺。尽管技术和产品供应将不断变化，但他相信信任、可靠性和强大的客户关系对于公司的长期成功仍然至关重要。

paras.en: Looking ahead, Schwab said the transition from NGK Spark Plug to Niterra represents a broader transformation rather than simply a name change. While continuing to strengthen its automotive business, the company is pursuing growth in new products, technologies and markets that build on its engineering capabilities. Opportunities in advanced mobility, electric vehicles and other emerging technologies are part of that strategy. Schwab said the Niterra name, derived from Latin words meaning “to shine” and “Earth,” reflects the company’s ambition to contribute to a more sustainable future.
paras.zh: 展望未来，Schwab 表示，从 NGK Spark Plug 到 Niterra 的转变代表着更广泛的转变，而不仅仅是名称更改。在继续加强汽车业务的同时，该公司正在以其工程能力为基础，寻求新产品、技术和市场的增长。先进移动、电动汽车和其他新兴技术的机会是该战略的一部分。施瓦布表示，Niterra 这个名字源自拉丁语，意思是“闪耀”和“地球”，反映了该公司为更加可持续的未来做出贡献的雄心。

paras.en: To hear more of Schwab’s insights, be sure to watch the above video.
paras.zh: 要了解更多施瓦布的见解，请务必观看上面的视频。

paras.en: - How Niterra is expanding beyond spark plugs with a broader portfolio of ignition, sensor and rotating electrical products. (4:49)
paras.zh: - Niterra 如何通过更广泛的点火、传感器和旋转电气产品组合扩展到火花塞之外。 （4:49）

paras.en: - Quality, integrity, teamwork and execution remain fundamental to Niterra’s business strategy and help strengthen customer relationships and deliver value. (6:17)
paras.zh: - 质量、诚信、团队合作和执行仍然是 Niterra 业务战略的基础，有助于加强客户关系并创造价值。 （6:17）

paras.en: - Niterra emphasizes a people-first approach to serving the industry and what that commitment looks like in practice for customers, employees and partners. (9:14)
paras.zh: - Niterra 强调以人为本的方法来服务行业，以及这种承诺在实践中对客户、员工和合作伙伴的影响。 （9:14）

paras.en: - How the Niterra name reflects the company’s evolution and future growth opportunities in advanced mobility and new technologies. (11:06)

articles.title: TrakMotive Earns Global TÜV Certification
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: TrakMotive announced that its global CV axle product range has achieved TÜV certification.
paras.zh: TrakMotive宣布其全球CV车桥产品系列已获得TÜV认证。

paras.en: The certification covers more than 9,700 CV axle SKUs across Europe, the United States and Mexico. The certified range includes:
paras.zh: 该认证涵盖欧洲、美国和墨西哥的 9,700 多个 CV 车轴 SKU。认证范围包括：

paras.en: - More than 3,700 SKUs for the United States
paras.zh: - 超过 3,700 个美国 SKU

paras.en: TÜV certification is recognized globally as an independent verification of product quality, testing, and manufacturing processes. TÜV-certified products are widely used across industries including automotive, electronics, industrial equipment, and medical devices.
paras.zh: TÜV 认证是全球公认的产品质量、测试和制造工艺的独立验证。 TÜV 认证的产品广泛应用于汽车、电子、工业设备和医疗器械等行业。

paras.en: TÜV conducted extensive product validation and manufacturing audits to confirm compliance with established quality and performance standards. The certification also includes ongoing annual surveillance audits and periodic product testing to maintain compliance.
paras.zh: TÜV 进行了广泛的产品验证和制造审核，以确认符合既定的质量和性能标准。该认证还包括持续的年度监督审核和定期产品测试，以保持合规性。

paras.en: “This certification represents a significant milestone for our global CV Axle program,” said Robert Zhu, TrakMotive’s Global CEO. “Achieving TÜV certification across such a broad product range demonstrates our long-term commitment to delivering dependable, high-quality products to customers worldwide.”
paras.zh: TrakMotive 全球首席执行官 Robert Zhu 表示：“这项认证代表了我们全球 CV 车桥计划的一个重要里程碑。” “在如此广泛的产品范围内获得 TÜV 认证，体现了我们为全球客户提供可靠、高质量产品的长期承诺。”

paras.en: TrakMotive says it plans to incorporate the TÜV certification mark and QR verification system across various customer touchpoints, including catalogs, digital platforms, packaging, labels, and select product markings, in accordance with TÜV usage guidelines.
paras.zh: TrakMotive 表示，计划根据 TÜV 使用指南，将 TÜV 认证标志和 QR 验证系统纳入各个客户接触点，包括目录、数字平台、包装、标签和精选产品标记。

articles.title: NASA's destroyed Swift Observatory took one of the best-ever photos of bright Andromeda
articles.author: Brandon Specktor

paras.en: Early Wednesday (Nov. 4), NASA's Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory fell out of space, burning up in the sky over Sumatra. It was a fitting, fiery end for a telescope that spent 22 years studying the most powerful explosions in the universe — and, even with Swift gone, its observations will continue to feed scientific curiosity for years to come.
paras.zh: 周三（11 月 4 日）早些时候，美国国家航空航天局 (NASA) 尼尔·格雷尔斯·斯威夫特天文台从太空坠落，在苏门答腊岛上空燃烧。对于这台花了 22 年时间研究宇宙中最强大爆炸的望远镜来说，这是一个恰如其分的、炽热的结局——而且，即使斯威夫特号消失了，它的观测结果仍将在未来几年继续满足科学好奇心。

paras.en: Swift's most important contributions to astronomy are not exactly eye candy. Designed to swivel toward deep-space explosions at a moment's notice, Swift excelled at capturing bright, fleeting and faraway specks of light. The multiwavelength observatory was equipped with optical, ultraviolet (UV) and X-ray instruments, allowing it to catch cosmic bursts of energy across the electromagnetic spectrum, zeroing in on flares of light that other telescopes might miss.
paras.zh: 斯威夫特对天文学最重要的贡献并不完全是华而不实的。斯威夫特的设计目的是在瞬间转向深空爆炸，它擅长捕捉明亮、短暂和遥远的光点。该多波长天文台配备了光学、紫外线 (UV) 和 X 射线仪器，使其能够捕捉整个电磁频谱的宇宙能量爆发，瞄准其他望远镜可能错过的耀斑。

paras.en: One of its most significant detections was a gamma-ray burst — an incredibly bright blast, likely emitted by a giant star as it exploded in a supernova before collapsing into a black hole. Swift's famous image of GRB 221009A, or the BOAT — short for "brightest of all time" — looks like a speckled orange bull's-eye, caused by waves from the explosion rippling across space.
paras.zh: 它最重要的探测结果之一是伽马射线爆发——一种极其明亮的爆炸，可能是一颗巨星在超新星中爆炸然后塌陷成黑洞时发出的。斯威夫特著名的 GRB 221009A 图像，即“BOAT”（“有史以来最亮的”的缩写），看起来像一个有斑点的橙色靶心，是由爆炸产生的波在太空中荡漾而形成的。

paras.en: But Swift also took millions of observations of the nearby universe, including galaxies in our backyard. One of its most jaw-dropping images is this 24-hour exposure of the Andromeda galaxy (M31), located about 2.5 million light-years from Earth.
paras.zh: 但斯威夫特还对附近的宇宙进行了数百万次观测，包括我们后院的星系。最令人瞠目结舌的图像之一是这张 24 小时曝光的仙女座星系 (M31)，距离地球约 250 万光年。

paras.en: Andromeda is the closest major galaxy to ours, and it may be destined for a shared fate. Scientists suspect that Andromeda and the Milky Way are drawing closer together and might eventually collide. The merger would add Andromeda's roughly 1 trillion stars to our sky, though there probably wouldn't be any life left on Earth to appreciate it.
paras.zh: 仙女座星系是距离我们最近的主要星系，它可能注定有着共同的命运。科学家怀疑仙女座星系和银河系正在靠近，最终可能会发生碰撞。这次合并将使仙女座星系的大约 1 万亿颗恒星进入我们的天空，尽管地球上可能不会有任何生命能够欣赏它。

paras.en: In Swift's view of our encroaching neighbor, captured with the observatory's ultraviolet instrument, tens of thousands of Andromeda's stars shine like sapphires set in a sparkling ring.
paras.zh: 在斯威夫特用天文台紫外线仪器拍摄的我们正在入侵的邻居的视野中，数以万计的仙女座恒星像镶嵌在闪闪发光的戒指中的蓝宝石一样闪闪发光。

paras.en: According to NASA, the observatory detected some 20,000 ultraviolet light sources in this image, captured over two months from May to July 2008. These sources include thousands of dense, hot star clusters scattered across Andromeda's 150,000-light-year-wide ring, as well as the distant galaxy M32 (seen as a bright orb of light to the bottom right of Andromeda's center).
paras.zh: 据 NASA 称，天文台在这张 2008 年 5 月至 7 月两个月内拍摄的图像中检测到了约 20,000 个紫外线光源。这些光源包括散布在仙女座星系 150,000 光年宽的环上的数千个致密炽热星团，以及遥远的星系 M32（在仙女座星系中心右下角可见一个明亮的光球）。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: In visible-light images of Andromeda taken with ground-based telescopes, the galaxy's bright center bleaches out many of the fiery young stars that emerge in Swift's view. While Swift likely won't be remembered best for shimmering starscapes like this one, it's a powerful reminder that looking at familiar structures in a new light can change everything.
paras.zh: 在用地面望远镜拍摄的仙女座星系的可见光图像中，星系明亮的中心漂白了斯威夫特视野中出现的许多炽热的年轻恒星。虽然斯威夫特可能不会因为像这样闪闪发光的星空而被人们记住，但它有力地提醒我们，以新的眼光看待熟悉的结构可以改变一切。

paras.en: Brandon is the space / physics editor at Live Science. With more than 20 years of editorial experience, his writing has appeared in The Washington Post, Reader's Digest, CBS.com, the Richard Dawkins Foundation website and other outlets. He holds a bachelor's degree in creative writing from the University of Arizona, with minors in journalism and media arts. His interests include black holes, asteroids and comets, and the search for extraterrestrial life.
paras.zh: 布兰登是《Live Science》的空间/物理编辑。凭借 20 多年的编辑经验，他的文章曾发表在《华盛顿邮报》、《读者文摘》、CBS.com、理查德·道金斯基金会网站和其他媒体上。他拥有亚利桑那大学创意写作学士学位，辅修新闻学和媒体艺术。他的兴趣包括黑洞、小行星和彗星，以及寻找外星生命。

articles.title: Rare fifth-century burials of Germanic chieftains with dazzling weapons and warhorses discovered in France
articles.author: Kristina Killgrove

paras.en: Archaeologists excavating in northeastern France have unearthed a small fifth-century cemetery containing the graves of two Germanic chieftains and two warhorses. The burial ground is providing new information about the transitional period after the fall of the Roman Empire.
paras.zh: 考古学家在法国东​​北部挖掘出一个五世纪的小墓地，里面埋葬着两位日耳曼酋长和两匹战马。该墓地提供了有关罗马帝国灭亡后过渡时期的新信息。

paras.en: The burial complex was discovered near the city of Colmar, just a few miles from the Rhine River, which forms the border between France and Germany. This area had a Gallo-Roman village from the first to the third centuries, and archaeologists found several ancient houses, hearths, wells and craft areas, according to a Nov. 6 translated statement from the French National Institute for Preventive Archaeological Research (Inrap).
paras.zh: 该墓葬群是在科尔马市附近发现的，距离法国和德国边界的莱茵河仅几英里。根据法国国家预防考古研究所 (Inrap) 11 月 6 日翻译的声明，该地区从一世纪到三世纪就有一个高卢罗马村庄，考古学家发现了几处古老的房屋、壁炉、水井和手工艺区。

paras.en: Archaeologists also uncovered a rare fifth-century cemetery at the site, which was used from about A.D. 450 to 500, a critical time period in Western Europe because of the collapse of the Roman Empire. While scholars have debated for centuries about why the empire fell, one key issue was the repeated occupation of Rome in the fifth century by Germanic tribes known as the Goths and the Vandals.
paras.zh: 考古学家还在该遗址发现了一座罕见的五世纪墓地，该墓地的使用时间约为公元 450 年至 500 年，这是罗马帝国崩溃后西欧的一个关键时期。尽管学者们对帝国衰落的原因争论了几个世纪，但一个关键问题是五世纪时被称为哥特人和汪达尔人的日耳曼部落反复占领罗马。

paras.en: Archaeologists discovered 11 adult graves, three graves of children and two horse burials at the site, according to the statement. In two of the female burials, archaeologists found silver bird-shaped brooches, glass bead necklaces and a bone comb, suggesting that these may have been high-status women.
paras.zh: 声明称，考古学家在现场发现了11座成人坟墓、3座儿童坟墓和两座马墓。在两处女性墓葬中，考古学家发现了银质鸟形胸针、玻璃珠项链和骨梳，表明这些墓葬可能是地位较高的女性。

paras.en: But two of the male burials, in particular, stood out because of their high-quality grave goods, including a sword with a partially preserved wooden scabbard, a shield, a javelin and a scramasax, a type of Germanic short sword, which was decorated with a gold-and-garnet accessory. The weapons are characteristic of the burials of Germanic chieftains or mercenaries, according to the archaeologists, and two horses were buried nearby with their harnesses.
paras.zh: 但其中两座男性墓葬因其高品质的随葬品而引人注目，其中包括一把部分保存有木质刀鞘的剑、一面盾牌、一把标枪和一把双刃斧（一种日耳曼短剑，上面装饰着黄金和石榴石配件）。据考古学家称，这些武器是日耳曼酋长或雇佣兵墓葬的特征，附近埋有两匹马和他们的挽具。

paras.en: In addition to the weapons and warhorses, archaeologists noticed evidence on the men's bones that hinted that the individuals were likely warriors. Two people suffered stab wounds that showed no signs of healing, which suggests they died quickly and violently, according to the statement. And another man's right knee bones had completely fused together, which would have prevented him from bending it. This condition, called ankylosis, commonly results from an improperly healed injury.
paras.zh: 除了武器和战马之外，考古学家还注意到这些人骨头上的证据，这些证据表明这些人可能是战士。声明称，有两人被刺伤，没有愈合的迹象，这表明他们死得迅速而暴力。而另一个人的右膝骨已经完全融合在一起，根本无法弯曲。这种情况称为强直，通常是由于损伤愈合不当造成的。

paras.en: The archaeologists believe the warrior's grave goods weren't just for show, but further study of the skeletons is planned to confirm whether the injuries seen during the excavation could have been sustained in a conflict.
paras.zh: 考古学家认为，这位战士的随葬品不仅仅是为了展示，而且计划对骨骼进行进一步研究，以确认挖掘过程中看到的伤害是否可能是在冲突中造成的。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Few Germanic settlements and cemeteries from the fifth century have been found, so the newly excavated site should provide important information about the upheavals linked to the fall of the Western Roman Empire and how that political collapse affected communities on the edge of the empire.
paras.zh: 几乎没有发现五世纪的日耳曼定居点和墓地，因此新发掘的遗址应该提供有关与西罗马帝国衰落相关的动乱以及政治崩溃如何影响帝国边缘社区的重要信息。

paras.en: Can you identify these historical objects of war? Test your smarts with our weapons of the world quiz!
paras.zh: 你能认出这些战争历史文物吗？用我们的世界武器测验来测试你的智慧！

paras.en: Kristina Killgrove is a staff writer at Live Science with a focus on archaeology and paleoanthropology news. Her articles have also appeared in venues such as Forbes, Smithsonian, and Mental Floss. Kristina holds a Ph.D. in biological anthropology and an M.A. in classical archaeology from the University of North Carolina, as well as a B.A. in Latin from the University of Virginia, and she was formerly a university professor and researcher. She has received awards from the Society for American Archaeology and the American Anthropological Association for her science writing.
paras.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·基尔格罗夫 (Kristina Killgrove) 是《Live Science》的特约撰稿人，专注于考古学和古人类学新闻。她的文章还发表在《福布斯》、《史密森尼》和《Mental Floss》等杂志上。克里斯蒂娜拥有博士学位。北卡罗来纳大学生物人类学学士学位和古典考古学硕士学位，以及北卡罗来纳大学古典考古学学士学位。她拥有弗吉尼亚大学拉丁语学位，曾任大学教授和研究员。她因其科学写作而获得美国考古学会和美国人类学协会颁发的奖项。

articles.title: Would you learn to lucid dream if you could?
articles.author: Nicoletta Lanese

paras.en: During dreams, bizarre scenes you encounter can seem as tangible as reality; you feel as though you're really flying through the sky or being chased through a jungle of bright-purple trees. But in special cases, people realize they're in the midst of a dream as it's unfolding.
paras.zh: 在梦中，你遇到的奇异场景就像现实一样真实；你感觉自己好像真的在天空中飞翔，或者在一片亮紫色树木的丛林中被追赶。但在特殊情况下，人们会意识到自己正处于梦境之中。

paras.en: Called lucid dreaming, this phenomenon occurs when we suddenly regain our capacity for metacognition, or thinking about our own thoughts, in the middle of a dream. Lucid dreamers can sometimes even control the content or trajectory of their dreams. Now, researchers claim that they've found a way to "train" people to lucid dream by having them meditate and complete virtual-reality-augmented exercises while they're awake.
paras.zh: 这种现象被称为清醒梦，当我们在梦中突然恢复元认知能力或思考自己的想法时，就会发生这种现象。清醒梦者有时甚至可以控制梦的内容或轨迹。现在，研究人员声称他们已经找到了一种方法，通过让人们在清醒时进行冥想和完成虚拟现实增强练习来“训练”人们进入清醒梦。

paras.en: In a study involving a few dozen participants, the scientists found that repeating this training twice a week for a month significantly increased how often participants experienced lucid dreaming. They say the approach could have practical applications as an intervention for people with nightmares, anxiety or post-traumatic stress disorder — but those applications are theoretical, for now.
paras.zh: 在一项涉及数十名参与者的研究中，科学家们发现，每周重复两次这种训练，持续一个月，参与者经历清醒梦的频率显着增加。他们表示，这种方法可以作为对噩梦、焦虑或创伤后应激障碍患者的干预措施而具有实际应用，但目前这些应用还只是理论上的。

paras.en: If you could learn how to lucid dream, would you? Let us know in the poll below, and add your thoughts in the comments.
paras.zh: 如果你能学会如何做清醒梦，你会吗？请在下面的投票中告诉我们，并在评论中添加您的想法。

paras.en: Nicoletta Lanese is the health channel editor at Live Science and was previously a news editor and staff writer at the site. She is a recipient of the 2026 AHCJ International Health Study Fellowship, with a project focused on antibiotic stewardship practices in Japan and the U.S. They hold a graduate certificate in science communication from UC Santa Cruz and degrees in neuroscience and dance from the University of Florida. Beyond Live Science, Lanese's work has appeared in The Scientist, Science News, the Mercury News, Mongabay and Stanford Medicine Magazine, among other outlets. Based in NYC, she also remains involved in dance and performs in local choreographers' work.
paras.zh: Nicoletta Lanese 是 Live Science 的健康频道编辑，此前曾担任该网站的新闻编辑和特约撰稿人。她是 2026 年 AHCJ 国际健康研究奖学金的获得者，该项目的重点是日本和美国的抗生素管理实践。他们拥有加州大学圣克鲁斯分校的科学传播研究生证书以及佛罗里达大学的神经科学和舞蹈学位。除了《Live Science》之外，Lanese 的作品还出现在《科学家》、《科学新闻》、《水星新闻》、《Mongabay》和《斯坦福医学杂志》等媒体上。她以纽约为基地，仍然参与舞蹈并在当地编舞家的工作中表演。

articles.title: Archaeologists Found a 3,300-Year-Old Sword at the Bottom of a Volcanic Lake in Italy—and It's Still Sharp

paras.en: Archaeologists have pulled a 3,300-year-old sword from a lake in Italy—and it’s still sharp.
paras.zh: 考古学家从意大利的一个湖中取出了一把有 3,300 年历史的剑，它仍然锋利。

paras.en: The bronze weapon was discovered at the bottom of Lake Mezzano, a small volcanic lake in central Italy, roughly 60 miles northwest of Rome.
paras.zh: 这件青铜武器是在梅扎诺湖 (Lake Mezzano) 的底部发现的，梅扎诺湖是意大利中部的一个小火山湖，距离罗马西北约 60 英里。

paras.en: It’s the third sword discovered in the lake since the 1970s, according to an announcement from Italy’s Superintendence of Archaeology, Fine Arts and Landscape for the Province of Viterbo and Southern Etruria.
paras.zh: 根据意大利维泰博省和南伊特鲁里亚考古、美术和景观管理局的公告，这是自 20 世纪 70 年代以来在湖中发现的第三把剑。

paras.en: Archaeologists think that between 1700 and 1150 B.C.E. the lake was home to a Bronze Age pile-dwelling village, a community lofted above the water on stilts.
paras.zh: 考古学家认为公元前 1700 年至 1150 年之间这个湖是一个青铜时代的木桩村的所在地，这是一个用高跷高高耸立在水面上的社区。

paras.en: The sword is thought to date to the 13th century B.C.E., which corresponds with the Late Bronze Age. At that time, the people living in central Italy maintained trade and connections with communities throughout the peninsula and across the Mediterranean. In that context, the researchers say, weapons were more than just combat tools—they were also symbols of prestige, identity and power.
paras.zh: 这把剑被认为可以追溯到公元前 13 世纪，相当于青铜时代晚期。当时，居住在意大利中部的人们与整个半岛和地中海地区的社区保持着贸易和联系。研究人员表示，在这种背景下，武器不仅仅是战斗工具，它们还是威望、身份和权力的象征。

paras.en: Archaeologists found the sword while excavating a largely unexplored area on the lake’s southern shore. During the same expedition, they found intact vases and numerous bronze artifacts, including axes, arrowheads, daggers, spearheads, pins and a razor. They found the sword and the razor lying near each other, which suggests they may have once belonged to the same person, possibly a high-status individual or an elite warrior.
paras.zh: 考古学家在湖南岸挖掘一片未开发的区域时发现了这把剑。在同一次探险中，他们发现了完整的花瓶和大量青铜器，包括斧头、箭头、匕首、矛头、别针和剃刀。他们发现剑和剃刀彼此靠近，这表明它们可能曾经属于同一个人，可能是一位地位很高的人，也可能是一位精英战士。

paras.en: Similar discoveries across Europe suggest that ancient people sometimes deliberately deposited weapons and other metal objects in lakes, possibly as part of religious rituals or offerings. According to Live Science’s Kristina Killgrove, the sword may have been tossed in the lake as an offering to a god.
paras.zh: 欧洲各地的类似发现表明，古人有时会故意将武器和其他金属物品放入湖泊中，这可能是宗教仪式或祭品的一部分。根据《Live Science》的克里斯蒂娜·基尔格罗夫的说法，这把剑可能被扔进湖里作为献给神的祭品。

paras.en: Geologist Lamberto Ferri Ricchi first discovered the now-submerged village in 1971, when he found the remains of three prehistoric pile-dwellings submerged between nine and 30 feet deep. He returned several years later at the request of regional archaeology officials and uncovered roughly 50 vases, three bronze axes, skeletal remains, wooden planks, millstones and other artifacts.
paras.zh: 地质学家 Lamberto Ferri Ricchi 于 1971 年首次发现了这个现已被淹没的村庄，当时他在 9 至 30 英尺深的水下发现了三座史前木桩住宅的遗迹。几年后，他应地区考古官员的要求返回，发现了大约 50 个花瓶、三把青铜斧、骨骼遗骸、木板、磨石和其他文物。

paras.en: Excavations continued into the mid-1990s, then came to a halt for nearly three decades until funding became available again. Last year, archaeologists returned to the site and mapped more than 600 wooden posts they believe once held up the Bronze Age settlement. The posts were embedded into the clay lakebed at various depths, ranging from eight feet to more than 32 feet deep. Researchers suspect the newly discovered posts represent roughly a third of the entire settlement.
paras.zh: 挖掘工作一直持续到 20 世纪 90 年代中期，然后暂停了近三十年，直到资金再次到位。去年，考古学家返回该地点，绘制了 600 多根木柱的地图，他们认为这些木柱曾经支撑着青铜时代的定居点。这些柱子嵌入粘土湖床的不同深度，从八英尺到超过 32 英尺深。研究人员怀疑新发现的柱子大约占整个定居点的三分之一。

paras.en: Across Europe, similar discoveries have been made in bodies of water, including a 1,000-year-old Viking sword in an English river, an Iron Age sword in a Swedish lake and rust-covered medieval sword in Poland’s Vistula River.
paras.zh: 在整个欧洲，人们也在水体中发现了类似的发现，包括英国河流中的一把具有 1000 年历史的维京剑、瑞典湖中的铁器时代剑以及波兰维斯瓦河中锈迹斑斑的中世纪剑。

paras.en: During the 2025 expedition, they also recovered numerous artifacts, including axes, spearheads, brooches, rings, a pin and a sickle. They also found bronze ingots that may have been used in casting, suggesting that residents were producing metal objects within the village.
paras.zh: 在 2025 年的探险中，他们还发现了许多文物，包括斧头、矛头、胸针、戒指、别针和镰刀。他们还发现了可能用于铸造的青铜锭，这表明居民正在村内生产金属物品。

paras.en: Researchers are still trying to interpret the findings of their latest expedition. In the meantime, they say they plan to display the newly discovered artifacts during an upcoming exhibition, per the statement. They also hope to continue their research in Lake Mezzano to gain an even deeper understanding of the people who once lived there.
paras.zh: 研究人员仍在试图解释他们最新探险的发现。与此同时，根据声明，他们表示计划在即将举行的展览中展示新发现的文物。他们还希望继续对梅扎诺湖的研究，以更深入地了解曾经居住在那里的人们。

articles.title: Strange Gas in Mars' Atmosphere Hints the Red Planet Is Still Volcanically Active—and Points to Places to Search for Alien Life

paras.en: Volcanic activity shaped the Red Planet for hundreds of millions of years. But today, researchers aren’t sure whether our neighbor has retained some of that volcanic feistiness or if it is truly dead inside.
paras.zh: 数亿年来，火山活动塑造了这颗红色星球。但今天，研究人员不确定我们的邻居是否还保留着火山爆发的活力，或者它是否真的已经死在里面了。

paras.en: In a study published November 4 in the journal Science Advances, scientists suggest that magma is, indeed, still on the move beneath the surface of Mars. Their evidence comes from unexpected gas detection in the planet’s atmosphere, which may have been spewed from fresh cracks on its Alba Mons volcano. If confirmed, their findings could shape how researchers search for signs of extraterrestrial life on Mars.
