paras.en: Third, because borrowers can't afford to borrow as much money, this puts downward pressure on the prices of assets like housing, which in turn makes the owners of these assets including mortgage holders, but also those who own their homes outright, feel less rich and less likely to spend.
paras.zh: 第三，由于借款人借不起那么多钱，这给住房等资产的价格带来了下行压力，这反过来又使这些资产的所有者（包括抵押贷款持有人和那些完全拥有房屋的人）感到自己不那么富有，也不太愿意花钱。

paras.en: Finally, and most obviously, of course, higher interest rates directly sap the spending power of households with variable interest rate mortgages. Some of this impact is offset by the higher return paid out to deposit holders, who tend to be older and richer, but Australian households overall borrow more money than they hold on deposit, so the "net effect" is to withdraw cash out of household pockets.
paras.zh: 最后，当然也是最明显的是，较高的利率直接削弱了可变利率抵押贷款家庭的消费能力。这种影响在一定程度上被支付给存款持有人的较高回报所抵消，存款持有人往往年龄更大、更富有，但澳大利亚家庭总体借入的钱多于存款，因此“净效应”是从家庭口袋中提取现金。

paras.en: Overall, higher interest rates cool demand and activity across the economy, making buyers less willing and able to pay the higher prices that business might otherwise try to charge.
paras.zh: 总体而言，较高的利率冷却了整个经济的需求和活动，使买家不太愿意也没有能力支付企业可能试图收取的更高价格。

paras.en: The upside of interest rate hikes is that they can be decided and implemented quite quickly. The downside is they take time to kick in with full force, typically 12 to 18 months. Balancing an economy, a collection of millions of individuals and businesses making spending decisions every second of every day, is not a precise science.
paras.zh: 加息的好处是可以很快地决定和实施。缺点是它们需要时间才能充分发挥作用，通常需要 12 至 18 个月。平衡经济，即每天每秒做出支出决策的数以百万计的个人和企业的集合，并不是一门精确的科学。

paras.en: It's hard for the Reserve Bank to know if they've done enough. The risk is they do too much and risk tipping the economy into a job-destroying recession.
paras.zh: 储备银行很难知道他们是否做得足够。风险在于他们做得太多，有可能使经济陷入破坏就业的衰退。

paras.en: So, what other tools might we have at our disposal to curb the runaway cost of living?
paras.zh: 那么，我们还有哪些其他工具可以用来遏制失控的生活成本呢？

paras.en: Fiscal policy, the collective tax and spending decisions of governments, can also impact demand, and therefore prices, in the economy.
paras.zh: 财政政策、政府的集体税收和支出决策也会影响经济中的需求，从而影响价格。

paras.en: Spending cuts, in certain areas, can take demand out of the economy. So, too, can tax increases.
paras.zh: 在某些领域，削减支出可能会降低经济需求。增税也是如此。

paras.en: What determines whether a government's budget settings are "stimulatory" (inflation promoting) to the economy or "contractionary" (inflation fighting) is whether the annual deficit is getting bigger (or a surplus smaller), as a percentage of the economy, from year to year.
paras.zh: 决定政府预算设置对经济是“刺激”（促进通货膨胀）还是“紧缩”（对抗通货膨胀）的因素是年度赤字占经济的百分比是否逐年变大（或盈余变小）。

paras.en: At present, over the federal budget's four-year outlook, annual deficits are running at a fairly consistent 1 per cent of gross domestic product (GDP) and as such, are not imparting a large stimulus to the economy.
paras.zh: 目前，在联邦预算的四年展望中，年度赤字相当稳定地占国内生产总值 (GDP) 的 1%，因此不会对经济产生巨大的刺激。

paras.en: Unlike monetary policy, fiscal policy decisions also come with significant moral and ethical dimensions.
paras.zh: 与货币政策不同，财政政策决策也具有重要的道德和伦理维度。

paras.en: Government must take into account what health and education services the community wants, what level of safety net is desirable for the unemployed, what public infrastructure will best serve the nation, how best to ensure our national security, and so forth.
paras.zh: 政府必须考虑社区需要什么健康和教育服务、失业者需要什么水平的安全网、什么公共基础设施最能服务于国家、如何最好地确保我们的国家安全等等。

paras.en: As such, the consensus among most senior economic policy makers today remains that responsibility for managing the economic cycle should be left to the independent Reserve Bank board, while fiscal policy should focus on longer term questions about how to raise taxes efficiently and spend revenue in ways the community finds agreeable.
paras.zh: 因此，当今大多数高级经济政策制定者的共识仍然是，管理经济周期的责任应留给独立的储备银行董事会，而财政政策应关注如何有效提高税收和以社会认可的方式支出收入的长期问题。

paras.en: Which is not to say governments can't and haven't helped to boost the economy in the face of external shocks, such as the global financial crisis (GFC) and COVID pandemic. It's more that it's unclear how helpful politicians will ever be at strategically taking money out of voter's pockets to cool demand in a timely way.
paras.zh: 这并不是说，面对全球金融危机 (GFC) 和新冠疫情等外部冲击，政府不能也没有帮助提振经济。更重要的是，目前还不清楚政客们在战略性地从选民口袋​​里掏钱以及时冷却需求方面能提供多大帮助。

paras.en: What about an independent fiscal body to raise and lower taxes?
paras.zh: 独立的财政机构来提高和降低税收怎么样？

paras.en: It's an idea mooted by some. Pick a tax, such as the Medicare levy or the GST, and appoint an independent board to increase it to manage inflationary pressures, or to cut it to stimulate the economy.
paras.zh: 这是一些人提出的想法。选择一种税收，例如医疗保险税或商品及服务税，并任命一个独立委员会来增加税收以管理通胀压力，或削减税收以刺激经济。

paras.en: The idea of using a temporary tax is not completely without precedent. Most of former prime minister Tony Abbott and his treasurer Joe Hockey's 2014 "slash and burn" budget was destined for the cutting room floor, but a "temporary budget repair levy" was collected for two years at a rate of 2 per cent from individuals earning more than $180,000. Still, it required legislation and it hasn't been attempted since.
paras.zh: 使用临时税的想法并非完全没有先例。前总理托尼·阿博特（Tony Abbott）和他的财务主管乔·霍基（Joe Hockey）2014年的“刀耕火种”预算大部分都被削减，但对收入超过18万澳元的个人征收了为期两年的“临时预算修复税”，税率为2%。尽管如此，它仍然需要立法，但此后一直没有尝试过。

paras.en: No independent fiscal policy-setting body exists anywhere in the world today, and one suspects the coercive power of government to raise taxes needs ultimately to be offset by the democratic power of citizens to oppose and reject it, from time to time.
paras.zh: 当今世界上不存在独立的财政政策制定机构，人们怀疑政府提高税收的强制力最终需要被公民不时反对和拒绝的民主力量所抵消。

paras.en: What about forcing people to put money into super?
paras.zh: 强迫人们把钱存入养老金怎么样？

paras.en: In addition to taxes, of course, all employees also have 12 per cent of their pay packet whisked away to a superannuation fund for their retirement.
paras.zh: 当然，除了税收之外，所有员工还将工资的 12% 存入退休金基金以供退休之用。

paras.en: What if, instead of squeezing only borrowers, we squeezed the cash flow of all workers by adjusting up the super guarantee so the money would be temporarily diverted into nest eggs, not the banking system?
paras.zh: 如果我们不是只压榨借款人，而是通过调整超级担保来压榨所有工人的现金流，这样钱就会暂时转移到储蓄中，而不是银行系统呢？

paras.en: One way we got inflation down in the 1980s was when the Hawke-Keating government made an accord with unions and business to trade-off wage rises for a boost to workers' super. Could we do it again, but instead have a continuous mechanism to increase or decrease contributions as a tool for managing demand in the economy?
paras.zh: 我们在 20 世纪 80 年代降低通货膨胀的一种方法是霍克-基廷政府与工会和企业达成协议，以提高工资来换取增加工人养老金。我们是否可以再做一次，而是建立一个连续的机制来增加或减少捐款，作为管理经济需求的工具？

paras.en: It's an elegant thought in theory, but would require more investigation, particularly into the impact on long-term returns of increasing and decreasing contributions in line with the economic cycle.
paras.zh: 从理论上讲，这是一个优雅的想法，但需要更多的研究，特别是根据经济周期增加和减少贡献对长期回报的影响。

paras.en: What about boosting the economy's supply capacity instead?
paras.zh: 相反，提高经济的供给能力又如何呢？

paras.en: What if, instead of trying to reduce demand to cool price pressures, we instead focused on boosting supply to constrain price rises?
paras.zh: 如果我们不是试图通过减少需求来缓解价格压力，而是专注于增加供应以抑制价格上涨，结果会怎样呢？

paras.en: Obviously, there's not much we can do about wars causing supply shortages of key consumer goods, like fuel.
paras.zh: 显然，对于战争导致燃料等关键消费品供应短缺，我们无能为力。

paras.en: But total supply in the economy includes not just goods, but also workers, equipment and capital. The efficiency with which we combine all these ingredients together determines our economy's productive potential.
paras.zh: 但经济中的总供给不仅包括商品，还包括工人、设备和资本。我们将所有这些要素结合在一起的效率决定了我们经济的生产潜力。

paras.en: Lifting the supply side of the economy by upskilling workers, building better infrastructure and reviewing settings so that large firms can't put up barriers to new competitors entering the market would all help boost supply and balance out price pressures.
paras.zh: 通过提高工人技能、建设更好的基础设施和审查环境来提升经济的供给侧，使大企业无法对新竞争者进入市场设置障碍，这些都有助于增加供给并平衡价格压力。

paras.en: Unfortunately, some of those things come with large taxpayer price tags which, whatever long-term supply expanding impact they may have down the track, only add to demand in the short-term.
paras.zh: 不幸的是，其中一些东西的价格标签是纳税人的大笔费用，无论它们可能对长期供应扩张产生什么影响，都只会在短期内增加需求。

paras.en: Heavily indebted borrowers hoping to find a sharper or fairer tool than interest rate rises to curb inflation may ultimately be disappointed.
paras.zh: 负债累累的借款人希望找到比加息更严厉或更公平的工具来抑制通胀，最终可能会失望。

paras.en: Interest rate hikes are a terribly crude way to control inflation in the economy — until, that is, you consider every other alternative available.
paras.zh: 加息是控制经济通胀的一种极其粗暴的方式——除非你考虑所有其他可用的选择。

paras.en: It might not be the most equitable tool we could design to relieve all Australians from the excessive burden of rapid inflation.
paras.zh: 这可能不是我们能够设计的最公平的工具，可以帮助所有澳大利亚人摆脱快速通货膨胀的过度负担。

paras.en: And the history of inflation targeting suggests in the long run, no matter how painful it ends up being for mortgage holders and, in part, precisely because of that pain, it does work.
paras.zh: 通胀目标制的历史表明，从长远来看，无论它最终给抵押贷款持有者带来多么痛苦，而且部分正是因为这种痛苦，它确实有效。

articles.title: It could be a matter of when, not if Andrew Hastie becomes opposition leader
articles.author: Patricia Karvelas

paras.en: Federal Labor is now actively preparing for an election contest against Andrew Hastie as opposition leader, as it considers how to frame the next diabolical year.
paras.zh: 联邦工党目前正在积极准备与安德鲁·哈斯蒂（Andrew Hastie）作为反对党领袖进行竞选，因为它正在考虑如何规划下一个灾难性的一年。

paras.en: Senior Labor sources have told this column that they believe it's not a matter of if, but when Hastie takes over from Angus Taylor as opposition leader, and they think he will be harder to defeat.
paras.zh: 工党高级消息人士告诉本专栏，他们认为这不是是否会发生的问题，但当哈斯蒂接替安格斯·泰勒成为反对党领袖时，他们认为他将更难被击败。

paras.en: Some Liberals are considering the New South Wales election in March as the clearest trigger for change, if Taylor can't improve the party's dire standing.
paras.zh: 一些自由党人士认为，如果泰勒不能改善该党严峻的地位，三月份的新南威尔士州选举将是最明显的变革触发因素。

paras.en: If that were to occur, Labor would have to readjust its political strategy. It would also set up an almighty contest between the Liberals under Hastie and conservative juggernaut Pauline Hanson.
paras.zh: 如果这种情况发生，工党将不得不重新调整其政治策略。这也将在哈斯蒂领导下的自由党和保守派巨头保琳·汉森之间展开一场激烈的竞争。

paras.en: Last month, Hastie delivered a speech urging politicians to "do better" and avoid the personal attacks of the "MAGA" movement during parliament's tribute to Member for Indi, Helen Haines.
paras.zh: 上个月，哈斯蒂在议会向印度议员海伦·海恩斯致敬期间发表讲话，敦促政客“做得更好”，避免“MAGA”运动的人身攻击。

paras.en: He was drawing a line against the style of politics he has accused One Nation of importing.
paras.zh: 他正在与他指责一国党引进的政治风格划清界限。

paras.en: Donald Trump's political brand has taken a battering at the US midterms, and that gives Hastie a vantage of being able to reject its politics from the right. He has the opportunity to nail Hanson to the MAGA brand at a time when being synonymous with Trump is a liability.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普的政治品牌在美国中期选举中遭受重创，这使哈斯蒂有能力拒绝其右翼政治。当汉森成为特朗普的代名词是一种负担时，他有机会将汉森钉在 MAGA 品牌上。

paras.en: "Let's play the ball, not the person, and leave the nasty personal politics of MAGA in the United States."
paras.zh: “让我们以球为重，而不是以人为本，让美国再次伟大的个人政治不再令人讨厌。”

paras.en: They were Hastie's words just weeks ago.
paras.zh: 这是哈斯蒂几周前说的话。

paras.en: The Greens have detected an opportunity, too. Leader David Shoebridge slammed Prime Minister Anthony Albanese for giving Trump a "bear hug" while reposting selfies of the two.
paras.zh: 绿党也发现了一个机会。领导人大卫·舒布里奇(David Shoebridge)抨击总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞(Anthony Albanese)在转发两人自拍照的同时给了特朗普“熊抱”。

paras.en: Shoebridge also attacked Labor's support for the war in Iran, describing it as illegal and linking Australia's involvement to domestic cost-of-living pressures.
paras.zh: 舒布里奇还攻击工党对伊朗战争的支持，称其为非法，并将澳大利亚的参与与国内生活成本压力联系起来。

paras.en: Treasurer Jim Chalmers spent the week distancing the Albanese government from the war and sought to pin the blame for cost-of-living pressures on decisions made in DC. But Shoebridge wants voters to remember Albanese was straight out of the blocks supporting the strikes.
paras.zh: 财政部长吉姆·查尔默斯花了一周时间让阿尔巴尼亚政府远离战争，并试图将生活成本压力归咎于华盛顿特区的决策。但舒布里奇希望选民记住，阿尔巴尼斯是直接支持罢工的。

paras.en: Labor clearly wants the war to end, but it can't escape the fact that it was one of the first governments in the world to publicly back the military action in February.
paras.zh: 工党显然希望战争结束，但它无法回避这样一个事实：工党是世界上最早公开支持二月份军事行动的政府之一。

paras.en: Speaking to the ABC on Sunday, Nationals leader Matt Canavan, said he had been "concerned from the get-go" that the reasoning for the action was "muddy and unclear".
paras.zh: 国家党领袖马特·卡纳万 (Matt Canavan) 周日在接受美国广播公司 (ABC) 采访时表示，他“从一开始就担心”这一行动的理由“模糊且不清楚”。

paras.en: "The lesson of our generation, of all generations, is when you have very unclear war aims it gets very, very messy," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们这一代人和所有几代人的教训是，当战争目标非常不明确时，事情就会变得非常非常混乱。”

paras.en: "So, I just think we need to, as a friend of the US, engage and ask to make sure these aims are clear."
paras.zh: “所以，我只是认为，作为美国的朋友，我们需要参与并要求确保这些目标明确。”

paras.en: Canavan questioning the war exposes a divide in a Coalition still struggling to agree on what it stands for.
paras.zh: 卡纳万对战争的质疑暴露了联盟党内部的分歧，该党仍在努力就其主张达成一致。

paras.en: It exposes Taylor's difficulty in delivering what he said when he rolled Sussan Ley for the leadership in February.
paras.zh: 这暴露了泰勒在二月份推举苏珊·莱伊(Sussan Ley)担任领导职务时很难兑现他所说的话。

paras.en: "It is clear we are running out of time. I won't mince words. The Liberal Party is in the worst position that it has been since it was founded in 1944," he said.
paras.zh: “很明显，我们的时间不多了。我不会拐弯抹角。自由党正处于自 1944 年成立以来最糟糕的境地，”他说。

paras.en: He blamed the party's predicament on choosing "the politics of convenience rather than focusing on the politics of conviction".
paras.zh: 他将党的困境归咎于选择“便利政治而不是专注于信念政治”。

paras.en: "Change or die," he said, "and I choose change".
paras.zh: “改变或死亡，”他说，“我选择改变”。

paras.en: Nine months later, the latest poll has the Coalition's primary vote at 21 per cent, seven points behind One Nation.
paras.zh: 九个月后，最新民调显示联盟党的初选得票率为 21%，落后一国党 7 个百分点。

paras.en: Taylor promised change, but some of his colleagues have privately said he has spent much of his leadership reacting to One Nation's agenda, rather than setting his own.
paras.zh: 泰勒承诺做出改变，但他的一些同事私下表示，他领导层的大部分时间都是对一国党的议程做出反应，而不是制定自己的议程。

paras.en: When Hanson called for an end to multiculturalism, Taylor was asked five times whether he supported it, yet he couldn't give a straight answer.
paras.zh: 当汉森呼吁结束多元文化主义时，泰勒五次被问到是否支持，但他无法给出直接答案。

paras.en: The next day, he said he supported "a version of multiculturalism".
paras.zh: 第二天，他表示他支持“某种形式的多元文化主义”。

paras.en: Under Hastie, there would be a forced reckoning for conservatives over whether they take Hanson on or keep chasing her shadow.
paras.zh: 在哈斯蒂的领导下，保守派将被迫反思是接受汉森还是继续追赶她的影子。

paras.en: Hastie is a prominent conservative, with staunch views on immigration and social issues. He has been outspoken on the need for Australia to revive local manufacturing and build sovereign capability, rather than relying so heavily on the US.
paras.zh: 哈斯蒂是一位著名的保守派人士，在移民和社会问题上有着坚定的观点。他直言不讳地表示澳大利亚需要重振本地制造业并建立主权能力，而不是如此严重依赖美国。

paras.en: He has also been more willing than Taylor to take Hanson head-on. And this hasn't just been a contest over the future of the political right.
paras.zh: 他也比泰勒更愿意正面迎战汉森。这不仅仅是一场关于政治右翼未来的较量。

paras.en: Hanson has been going after Hastie, with a cartoon posted on her social media branding him a traitor over his evidence in the Ben Roberts-Smith defamation trial. Hastie has been clear he gave that evidence under subpoena.
paras.zh: 汉森一直在追捕哈斯蒂，她的社交媒体上发布了一张漫画，因其在本·罗伯茨-史密斯诽谤案审判中提供的证据而将他标记为叛徒。哈斯蒂明确表示，他是根据传票提供的证据。

paras.en: In what looks like an effort to turn this issue into a referendum on patriotism, Hanson is also targeting Hastie's West Australian seat of Canning.
paras.zh: 汉森似乎试图将这一问题转变为爱国主义公投，他还瞄准了哈斯蒂在西澳大利亚坎宁的选区。

paras.en: In a by-election in August, One Nation beat Labor to claim the state seat of Secret Harbour, which sits largely within Canning.
paras.zh: 在八月的补选中，一国党击败工党，夺得秘密港州议席，该议席主要位于坎宁市内。

paras.en: A strong result for the Liberals in Victoria's election later this month could give Taylor a fillip; it would be the sort of brand bounce the party desperately needs. Watch Taylor try to get into every press conference and photo op if that happens.
paras.zh: 本月晚些时候，自由党在维多利亚州选举中取得强劲结果可能会给泰勒带来提振。这将是该党迫切需要的品牌反弹。如果发生这种情况，看看泰勒试图参加每一次新闻发布会和拍照。

paras.en: But if the Coalition goes through summer without any uptick in its numbers after a potential Victorian win, followed by the possibility of a shocker in Taylor's home state of NSW, nerves and self-preservation will seize the party room. A challenge will start to feel inevitable.
paras.zh: 但如果联盟党在维多利亚州可能获胜后整个夏天的支持率都没有任何上升，那么泰勒的家乡新南威尔士州可能会出现令人震惊的情况，那么紧张和自我保护将占据党内空间。挑战将开始变得不可避免。

paras.en: But that's not the only problem NSW presents. Some NSW Liberal MPs privately expect they might need to form an alliance with One Nation if the Nationals are hammered and the Coalition falls short, despite their leader Kellie Sloane ruling out such a deal.
paras.zh: 但这并不是新南威尔士州面临的唯一问题。一些新南威尔士州自由党议员私下预计，如果国家党受到重创而联盟党未能实现目标，他们可能需要与一国党结盟，尽管他们的领导人凯莉·斯隆排除了这样的协议。

paras.en: That would leave Hastie staring down Hanson, while parts of his own party are off to the side considering a deal with her.
paras.zh: 这会让哈斯蒂盯着汉森，而他自己政党的部分人则站在一边考虑与她达成协议。

paras.en: Labor might think the Coalition destroying itself is entertaining, but the sideshow is no lifeline.
paras.zh: 工党可能认为联盟党自我毁灭很有趣，但余兴节目并不是生命线。

paras.en: While Taylor might not be getting much cut-through, voters are still marking down Labor.
paras.zh: 尽管泰勒可能不会获得太多支持，但选民仍然对工党表示不满。

paras.en: As a sea of Democratic blue flooded the US, the sharper ministers in the Albanese government didn't view it as a progressive fever dream, but as a warning shot of what visceral anger towards incumbents looks like when life costs too much.
paras.zh: 当一片民主蓝色的海洋淹没美国时，阿尔巴尼亚政府中更敏锐的部长们并不认为这是一个进步的狂热梦想，而是一个警告，表明当生命成本过高时，对现任者的本能愤怒会是什么样子。

paras.en: The notion that Trumpism was a form of religion for Americans has taken a beating, and the biggest message it sends here is that voters are prepared to swing, and swing hard, if they believe their material interests are being ignored.
paras.zh: “特朗普主义是美国人的一种宗教形式”的观念受到了打击，它在这里发出的最大信息是，如果选民认为自己的物质利益被忽视，他们就准备好摇摆不定，而且是强烈摇摆。

paras.en: Even One Nation heard the midterm message, despite Hanson enthusiastically endorsing Trump, including arguing in June she shared the same policy positions as the US president.
paras.zh: 尽管汉森热情支持特朗普，包括在六月表示她与美国总统有着相同的政策立场，但连一国党也听到了中期信息。

paras.en: As the dust settles on the American reckoning, One Nation coincidentally removed a section of its website that was headlined: "Want Trump's action and style, then it's One Nation you need."
paras.zh: 随着美国的清算尘埃落定，一国党巧合地删除了其网站上的一个标题为“想要特朗普的行动和风格，那么这就是你需要的一国党”的部分。

paras.en: Democrats won Senate seats in Texas, South Carolina and Kansas, states that have been reliably Republican for decades.
paras.zh: 民主党赢得了德克萨斯州、南卡罗来纳州和堪萨斯州的参议院席位，这些州几十年来一直是共和党的可靠代表。

paras.en: One senior Labor insider said that if deep red Republican states can swing that hard towards Democratic candidates, the opposite can occur here.
paras.zh: 一位资深工党内部人士表示，如果深红色共和党州能够如此强烈地支持民主党候选人，那么这里可能会出现相反的情况。

paras.en: Deep red Labor heartland can just as easily swing hard. Just how hard depends on the solutions Labor provides over the next 12 months.
paras.zh: 深红色的工党中心地带也可以轻易地摇摆不定。到底有多困难取决于工党在未来 12 个月内提供的解决方案。

paras.en: The year ahead could prove the hardest the Albanese government has faced in its two terms of government.
paras.zh: 未来的一年可能是阿尔巴尼亚政府两届任期内面临的最困难的一年。

paras.en: Patricia Karvelas is host of ABC News Afternoon Briefing at 4pm weekdays on ABC News Channel, co-host of the weekly Party Room podcast with Fran Kelly and host of politics and news podcast Politics Now.
paras.zh: 帕特里夏·卡维拉斯 (Patricia Karvelas) 是 ABC 新闻频道工作日下午 4 点的 ABC 新闻下午简报主持人，与 Fran Kelly 共同主持每周 Party Room 播客，以及政治和新闻播客 Politics Now 的主持人。

articles.title: Abbott says Gillard's misogyny speech an 'unjustified attack'
articles.author: Georgia Hitch

paras.en: Tony Abbott has described Julia Gillard's seething misogyny speech as "pretty over the top", conceding he did not expect it to become the "iconic moment" it has.
paras.zh: 托尼·阿博特将朱莉娅·吉拉德激烈的厌女症演讲描述为“相当过分”，并承认他没想到它会成为“标志性时刻”。

paras.en: Speaking to ABC iview's I Was Actually There, Mr Abbott said he had known Ms Gillard for a long time before the speech and regarded her as a "formidable politician", with the pair sharing mutual respect for one another.
paras.zh: 阿博特在接受美国广播公司 iview 节目《我其实就在那里》时表示，他在演讲前就认识吉拉德女士很长时间了，并认为她是一位“令人敬畏的政治家”，两人相互尊重。

paras.en: But he acknowledged that respect was "fraying" ahead of the now-historic moment 14 years ago.
paras.zh: 但他承认，在 14 年前这一历史性时刻到来之前，尊重正在“磨损”。

paras.en: "I thought it was a pretty over the top and unjustified attack,"
paras.zh: “我认为这是一次相当过分且毫无道理的攻击，”

paras.en: "Given that, I say, I am not conscious of ever treating women differently simply by virtue of them being women, I certainly am not conscious of ever having treated women in a lesser way."
paras.zh: “我想说的是，我并没有意识到仅仅因为女性是女性而对她们进行区别对待，我当然也没有意识到曾经以较轻的方式对待女性。”

paras.en: "I thought when Julia started that speech, she really is going over the top."
paras.zh: “我认为当朱莉娅开始演讲时，她确实有点过分了。”

paras.en: "I felt calm in the moment. And I felt the reaction to it showed that I was dominating that environment."
paras.zh: “那一刻我感到平静。我觉得对此的反应表明我正在主宰那个环境。”

paras.en: Of the speech, Mr Abbott said he thought most of Ms Gillard's accusations against him were "over the top".
paras.zh: 在演讲中，阿博特表示，他认为吉拉德女士对他的大部分指控“有些过分”。

paras.en: "Gillard trotted out a whole lot of things where I was regarded as having acted in, I guess, an old-fashioned, ham-fisted, insensitive way," he said.
paras.zh: “吉拉德提出了很多我认为我的行事方式是老式的、笨拙的、麻木不仁的做法，”他说。

paras.en: "But again, I think most of those accusations were either over the top or slightly unfair."
paras.zh: “但我再说一遍，我认为大多数指控要么过分，要么有点不公平。”

paras.en: Ms Gillard said she knew she was going to be targeted in parliament that day over a controversy embroiling Labor's hand-picked speaker, Peter Slipper.
paras.zh: 吉拉德女士表示，她知道当天她将成为议会的攻击目标，因为工党精心挑选的议长彼得·斯利珀(Peter Slipper)引发了一场争议。

paras.en: While Ms Gillard said the speech was delivered off the cuff, she had asked her team to compile a list of Mr Abbott's "most sexist quotes" for her to refer to.
paras.zh: 虽然吉拉德女士表示演讲是即兴发表的，但她已要求她的团队编制一份艾伯特先生“最具性别歧视言论”的清单，供她参考。

paras.en: "What was completely ironic about this attack, is Tony Abbott was almost, you know, rent-a-gaffe about sexism issues," she told I Was Actually There.
paras.zh: “这次袭击的讽刺之处在于，托尼·阿博特几乎在性别歧视问题上失态了，”她告诉《我真的在那里》。

paras.en: "It's almost like a game of cards, 'I'll not only see you, I'll raise you because you definitely said this'."
paras.zh: “这几乎就像一场纸牌游戏，‘我不仅会见到你，我还会抚养你，因为你肯定这么说过’。”

paras.en: Ms Gillard rose to her feet that day in response to a motion from Mr Abbott accusing the government of sexism and misogyny because of its decision to install, and later not remove, the Speaker of the House, Peter Slipper.
paras.zh: 吉拉德女士当天站了起来，回应了阿博特先生的一项动议，该动议指责政府因决定任命众议院议长彼得·斯利珀(Peter Slipper)而存在性别歧视和厌女症，但后来又没有罢免。

paras.en: Slipper, a Liberal MP, had been convinced to take up the role to help Labor maintain its own numbers in the House of Representatives, given it was already a minority government.
paras.zh: 自由党议员斯利珀被说服担任这一角色，以帮助工党维持自己在众议院的席位，因为工党已经是少数派政府了。

paras.en: There were calls for Labor to remove him from his position after he was accused of sexual harassment by his former staffer James Ashby.
paras.zh: 在他被前工作人员詹姆斯·阿什比指控性骚扰后，有人呼吁工党将他免职。

paras.en: It was also revealed that slipper sent a number of highly offensive and sexist text messages to Ashby about female genitalia.
paras.zh: 据透露，拖鞋向阿什比发送了一些有关女性生殖器的极具攻击性和性别歧视的短信。

paras.en: Despite this, Ms Gillard and the government refused to remove him from his role — prompting criticisms of double standards when it came to sexism.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，吉拉德女士和政府拒绝解除他的职务，这引发了对性别歧视双重标准的批评。

paras.en: "She was putting into practice the old doctrine that attack is the best form of defence."
paras.zh: “她正在实践进攻是最好的防御形式这一古老的学说。”

paras.en: "I did have this sense of unfairness, resentment, anger, that having lived through so many gendered critiques … that now I was going to be the one who was skewered on the sexism critique."
paras.zh: “我确实有一种不公平、怨恨、愤怒的感觉，经历了如此多的性别批评……现在我将成为那个被性别歧视批评所刺痛的人。”

paras.en: "Obviously, the prime minister had made what was a highly theatrical, politically powerful piece of drama," Mr Abbott said.
paras.zh: “显然，总理创作了一部极具戏剧性、政治影响力的戏剧，”阿博特先生说。

paras.en: "But the fact that by the end of the day the Speaker had resigned, I thought was a complete vindication of everything that I'd said in the parliament."
paras.zh: “但事实上，议长最终辞职，我认为这完全证明了我在议会所说的一切。”

paras.en: Mr Abbott also described a comment he made just before the speech that the Labor government should "already have died of shame" as "a bit of a niggle".
paras.zh: 阿博特还称，他在演讲前发表的评论称工党政府应该“已经羞愧而死”，称其为“有点小问题”。

paras.en: The quote was a repeat of controversial remarks made by radio host Alan Jones in the wake of the death of Ms Gillard's father.
paras.zh: 这句话是电台主持人艾伦·琼斯在吉拉德女士父亲去世后发表的有争议的言论的重复。

paras.en: "I thought the government had let itself down badly … so I think it was reasonable of me to say that it was a government that should be a little bit ashamed of itself."
paras.zh: “我认为政府让自己很失望……所以我认为我说这是一个应该为自己感到羞耻的政府是合理的。”

paras.en: "I remember hearing those lines and being amazed. I would say I felt a kind of cool anger."
paras.zh: “我记得听到这些台词并感到惊讶。我想说我感到一种冷静的愤怒。”

paras.en: It was those words that spurred Gillard to respond.
paras.zh: 这句话让吉拉德做出了回应。

paras.en: "She was playing the sexism card, which to her credit, Gillard had up until that time, almost never done."
paras.zh: “她正在打性别歧视牌，值得赞扬的是，吉拉德在那之前几乎从未这样做过。”

paras.en: "I [was] conscious that having made the decision early on that we wouldn't be shining a light on the gender stuff … that this did mark a transition point.
paras.zh: “我意识到，我们很早就做出了决定，我们不会关注性别问题……这确实标志着一个转变点。

paras.en: "And curiously, this day, which was really about skewering me on sexism, gave me the moment."
paras.zh: “奇怪的是，这一天实际上是在性别歧视问题上对我进行攻击，却给了我这个机会。”

paras.en: At the time, the press gallery's reaction to the speech was similar to Mr Abbott's; that Ms Gillard had attempted to redirect criticism of her and her government's handling of the Slipper affair.
paras.zh: 当时，新闻媒体对这次演讲的反应与阿博特先生的反应类似。吉拉德女士试图转移对她和她的政府处理拖鞋事件的批评。

paras.en: But as the speech travelled around the world, it soon became clear it had struck a different nerve.
paras.zh: 但随着这篇演讲传遍世界各地，人们很快就发现它触动了不同的神经。

paras.en: While Mr Abbott didn't realise what the speech would become, he acknowledges the life it's taken on since.
paras.zh: 虽然阿博特先生没有意识到演讲会变成什么样子，但他承认演讲自那以后所发生的事情。

paras.en: "It was an effective parliamentary tactic on the day, but I had no real reason to think that it would become some iconic feminist moment," he said.
paras.zh: “这在当天是一种有效的议会策略，但我没有真正的理由认为这会成为某个标志性的女权主义时刻，”他说。

paras.en: "I dare say for some people this is, if you like, the rhetorical version of Helen Reddy's great song, I Am Woman, Hear Me Roar."
paras.zh: “我敢说，对于某些人来说，如果你愿意的话，这就是海伦·雷迪伟大歌曲《我是女人，听我咆哮》的修辞版本。”

paras.en: As for Ms Gillard, the speech is still raised with her often, both at home and abroad.
paras.zh: 至于吉拉德女士，无论是在国内外，她的演讲仍然经常被提起。

paras.en: But unlike the millions of viewers online, she revealed she has never watched the speech back.
paras.zh: 但与网上数以百万计的观众不同，她透露自己从未看过演讲。

paras.en: "I've always wanted my memories of that day not to be coloured in by watching the film of it, the video," she said.
paras.zh: “我一直希望我对那一天的记忆不要因为观看电影、视频而受到影响，”她说。

paras.en: "I wanted to just feel it and remember it the way it was. That's my memory and I want it to stay that way."
paras.zh: “我只想感受它并记住它原来的样子。那是我的记忆，我希望它保持这种状态。”

paras.en: We've got a story for you. Stream I Was Actually There free on ABC iview or watch Mondays at 8pm on ABC TV.
paras.zh: 我们有一个故事给你听。在 ABC iview 上免费观看《我在那儿》，或每周一晚上 8 点在 ABC TV 上观看。

articles.title: As Europe prepares for the worst, Britons get schooled in preparedness
articles.author: Anna Cunningham

paras.en: As Europe prepares for the worst, Britons get schooled in preparedness
paras.zh: 当欧洲为最坏的情况做准备时，英国人接受了防备教育

paras.en: In Britain the culture of being ready to face a crisis needs gentle and convincing persuasion
paras.zh: 在英国，准备面对危机的文化需要温和而令人信服的说服

paras.en: The last time any British government launched a national public preparedness campaign was at the peak of the Cold War in 1980.
paras.zh: 英国政府上一次发起全国公共防备运动是在 1980 年冷战高峰期。

paras.en: The “Protect and Survive” message was delivered in short, eerie-looking public information broadcasts and booklets, meant to advise people on how to prepare for a nuclear attack. The campaign — whose guidance included hiding under a heavy table or tips about how to store a dead body in the house for five days — backfired and was ridiculed. Brits realized little would protect them from a thermonuclear strike, leaving them feeling that preparation was pointless as survival would be futile.
paras.zh: “保护和生存”的信息是通过简短、看起来怪异的公共信息广播和小册子传达的，旨在建议人们如何为核攻击做好准备。这项运动的指导内容包括躲在一张沉重的桌子下或如何将尸体在房子里存放五天的建议，但结果适得其反并遭到嘲笑。英国人意识到几乎没有什么可以保护他们免受热核袭击，让他们觉得准备毫无意义，因为生存是徒劳的。

paras.en: Nearly 50 years on, the head of the British Army, Gen. Sir Roland Walker, addressed some 700 soldiers last month at Britain's biggest garrison in northern England. The "business of soldiering" had returned to the national psyche, he told members of the light, high-readiness global response force, adding that anyone following world affairs will realize there is “extreme jeopardy."
paras.zh: 近 50 年后，英国陆军总司令罗兰·沃克爵士上个月在英格兰北部英国最大的驻军向大约 700 名士兵发表讲话。他告诉轻型、高度戒备的全球反应部队成员，“当兵的事情”已经回归国民精神，并补充说，任何关注世界事务的人都会意识到存在“极端危险”。

paras.en: “The political leaders of this country,” he said, “will start to have a frank conversation with the citizens of this country about just what is going on, and where the risk lies, and what the nation ... must need to be prepared to do.”
paras.zh: 他说：“这个国家的政治领导人将开始与这个国家的公民进行坦诚对话，讨论正在发生的事情、风险在哪里，以及国家......必须准备做什么。”

paras.en: Exactly one week later, Britain’s “Be Ready” campaign was unveiled, a guide on preparing for 72 hours of self-sufficiency in the event of an emergency, be it a climate crisis, cyber disruptions or threats by hostile states.
paras.zh: 整整一周后，英国推出了“做好准备”运动，这是一份关于在紧急情况下做好 72 小时自给自足准备的指南，无论是气候危机、网络中断还是敌对国家的威胁。

paras.en: “It’s something that emergency planners have been wanting for a very long time,” said Lucy Easthope, a global disaster recovery specialist. Easthope has advised in emergencies from the Novichok poisonings in Salisbury, England, to the 2004 Indian Ocean Tsunami and 9/11.
paras.zh: 全球灾难恢复专家露西·伊斯特霍普 (Lucy Easthope) 表示：“这是应急计划人员长期以来一直想要的东西。” Easthope 曾为英国索尔兹伯里诺维乔克中毒事件、2004 年印度洋海啸和 9/11 等紧急事件提供咨询。

paras.en: Easthope says what the public wants is reassurance — not negative and depressing messaging.
paras.zh: 伊斯特霍普表示，公众想要的是安心，而不是负面和令人沮丧的信息。

paras.en: “Ancient DNA, by that I mean 30 years ago, is being reawoken,” she told CBC News. “This is reawakening the idea that it's perfectly survivable.
paras.zh: “我指的是 30 年前的古代 DNA，正在被重新唤醒，”她告诉 CBC 新闻。 “这重新唤醒了人们的观念：它是完全可以生存的。

paras.en: “I’m really pleased in the U.K. we haven’t resorted to fear messaging.”
paras.zh: “我很高兴在英国我们没有诉诸恐惧信息。”

paras.en: Other European nations have also recently introduced or updated their emergency guidance, including France, Ireland, Sweden, Norway, Germany and Poland.
paras.zh: 其他欧洲国家最近也推出或更新了紧急指南，包括法国、爱尔兰、瑞典、挪威、德国和波兰。

paras.en: Ottawa, too, has reiterated its longstanding advice. But unlike Canada with its emergency preparedness week — an annual event since 1996 — Britain faces a cultural hurdle, with the word "preparedness" not even being in most Brits' vocabulary. The U.K. has largely relied on community resilience to short-term disruptions, rather than self sufficiency. Now, it faces the challenge of convincing people that they must be prepared for the worst — without sending them into a panic.
paras.zh: 渥太华也重申了其长期以来的建议。但与加拿大自 1996 年以来每年举办一次的应急准备周不同的是，英国面临着文化障碍，大多数英国人的词汇中甚至没有“准备”一词。英国在很大程度上依赖于社区对短期干扰的恢复能力，而不是自给自足。现在，它面临的挑战是说服人们必须为最坏的情况做好准备，同时又不能让他们陷入恐慌。

paras.en: In Hertfordshire, north of London, family physician Nyari Matebwe says her first reaction was to roll her eyes and ignore it.
paras.zh: 在伦敦北部的赫特福德郡，家庭医生尼亚里·马特布韦（Nyari Matebwe）说，她的第一反应是翻白眼并忽略它。

paras.en: “I feel like it’s scaremonger-y, or the skeptic in me thinks maybe they’re hiding something from us … another distraction from the real issues,” she said.
paras.zh: “我觉得这是危言耸听，或者我内心的怀疑论者认为他们可能向我们隐瞒了一些事情......这是对真正问题的另一种干扰，”她说。

paras.en: The recent suspected hacking attacks on supermarket freezers in multiple European countries and attempts to raise temperatures in French medical fridges containing critical blood donation stocks have made her question her own skepticism.
paras.zh: 最近，欧洲多个国家的超市冰柜涉嫌遭到黑客攻击，以及试图提高装有重要献血库存的法国医用冰箱的温度，这让她对自己的怀疑产生了质疑。

paras.en: “After the recent airplane bomb hoaxes, I did start to think about it a bit more,” said Matebwe, whose teenage daughter is pushing her to take the prepping message seriously.
paras.zh: “在最近的飞机炸弹骗局之后，我确实开始更多地思考这个问题，”马特布韦说，她十几岁的女儿正在敦促她认真对待准备信息。

paras.en: Sweden is advising seven days, Germany up to 10, but the U.K., like Canada, has settled on three days' survival off-grid.
paras.zh: 瑞典建议停电 7 天，德国建议停电 10 天，但英国和加拿大一样，已决定在离网状态下生存 3 天。

paras.en: School parents’ WhatsApp groups are lighting up with conversations
paras.zh: 学校家长的 WhatsApp 群组里的对话热闹非凡

paras.en: “I want to stockpile but I’m in a state of inertia,” one parent wrote. “My husband is totally unbothered.”
paras.zh: “我想囤货，但我处于惰性状态，”一位家长写道。 “我丈夫完全不受影响。”

paras.en: Another asked, “How will we cook if there’s no gas or electricity?” while one raised concern about rising crime rates and the risk of keeping cash at home.
paras.zh: 另一个人问：“如果没有煤气或电，我们怎么做饭？”其中一位人士对犯罪率上升以及将现金留在家里的风险表示担忧。

paras.en: Richard Horne, the head of the U.K.’s National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC), which is part of the government’s signals agency GCHQ and the Five Eyes intelligence sharing group that includes Canada, told CBC News: “This is a moment of urgency.”
paras.zh: 英国国家网络安全中心 (NCSC) 负责人理查德·霍恩 (Richard Horne) 告诉 CBC 新闻：“这是一个紧急时刻。该中心是政府信号机构 GCHQ 和包括加拿大在内的五眼情报共享组织的一部分。”

paras.en: - Russia continues its attacks on power facilities in Kyiv as temperatures drop ahead of winter
paras.zh: - 随着冬季来临，气温下降，俄罗斯继续袭击基辅的电力设施

paras.en: - The age of AI warfare has dawned. Is Canada ready?
paras.zh: - 人工智能战争时代已经到来。加拿大准备好了吗？

paras.en: The NCSC says AI-powered malicious software is “highly likely” to be used in hacking attacks against the power stations, airports and hospitals in the U.K. within two years.
paras.zh: NCSC 表示，人工智能驱动的恶意软件“极有可能”在两年内用于针对英国发电站、机场和医院的黑客攻击。

paras.en: In Horne’s annual state of the cyber nation address, he said “military networks are subjected to sustained and persistent, widespread attempts to penetrate our systems."
paras.zh: 霍恩在年度网络国家状况演讲中表示，“军事网络受到持续、持续、广泛的渗透我们系统的尝试。”

paras.en: That included Russian hybrid warfare campaigns, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，其中包括俄罗斯的混合战争行动。

paras.en: “All countries need to be taking this moment seriously," he told CBC News. “There are loads of vulnerabilities that do not need to be there,” which he said the country's adversaries are exploiting.
paras.zh: “所有国家都需要认真对待这一时刻，”他告诉加拿大广播公司新闻。他说，“存在大量不必要的漏洞”，该国的对手正在利用这些漏洞。

paras.en: Outside the need for companies to keep their technology safe, Horne said at home it is a case of keeping devices up to date and using passkeys.
paras.zh: 霍恩表示，除了公司需要确保其技术安全之外，在国内还需要保持设备最新并使用密钥。

paras.en: “You do need to be thinking about, 'do I need to be having the levels of connectivity of devices across my house, apartment' … not unnecessarily introducing potential vulnerabilities.”
paras.zh: “你确实需要考虑，‘我的房子、公寓中的设备是否需要具有一定的连接水平’……而不是不必要地引入潜在的漏洞。”

paras.en: There are some who see the “Be Ready” messaging as another example of the "nanny state," or the government telling them how to live.
paras.zh: 有些人将“做好准备”的信息视为“保姆国家”的另一个例子，或者政府告诉他们如何生活。

paras.en: Others think cultural attitudes play a part.
paras.zh: 其他人则认为文化态度起了一定作用。

paras.en: Luis Martinez Arnal, an IT professional from Spain now based in London, says his Mexican wife automatically prepares for emergencies, having grown up in a country prone to earthquakes.
paras.zh: 来自西班牙、现居伦敦的 IT 专业人士路易斯·马丁内斯·阿纳尔 (Luis Martinez Arnal) 表示，他的墨西哥妻子在一个地震频发的国家长大，自然而然就会为紧急情况做好准备。

paras.en: “But in the U.K.,” Arnal said, “hard times have been forgotten.”
paras.zh: “但在英国，”阿纳尔说，“人们已经忘记了艰难的时光。”

paras.en: The accessibility of everything, he added, “psychologically is making us feel more comfortable.”
paras.zh: 他补充说，一切的便利性“在心理上让我们感觉更舒服。”

paras.en: The recent cyberattacks have created a heightened sense of anxiety across Europe, and as people grow more reliant on the internet, questions are being asked how anyone can prepare to stay connected if it went down. Those haven't been easily answered — especially as Britain has long planned to switch all copper-wire landline phones to internet use-only from the end of January 2027.
paras.zh: 最近的网络攻击在整个欧洲引发了高度的焦虑感，随着人们对互联网的依赖程度越来越高，人们开始提出这样的问题：如果互联网出现故障，人们如何准备保持联系。这些问题还没有轻易得到解答——尤其是英国长期以来一直计划从 2027 年 1 月底开始将所有铜线固定电话改为仅互联网使用。

paras.en: “Call me crazy, but following the new guidelines, I do feel a bit nervous,” said one London mother, Amee Doshi, pointing to talk about the potential for a world war.
paras.zh: “你可以说我疯了，但按照新的指导方针，我确实感到有点紧张，”伦敦一位母亲阿米·多西 (Amee Doshi) 指着正在谈论世界大战可能性的话题说道。

paras.en: A Tesco grocery delivery vehicle is seen stopped at a police roadblock on Sept. 27, in Fairford, U.K. Police declared a major incident after evacuating residents from their homes in Whelford, a village about 1.6 kilometres from RAF Fairford, a military base that hosts U.S. Air Force bombers involved in the Iran conflict. (David Bown/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 9 月 27 日，英国费尔福德，一辆特易购杂货送货车被拦在警察路障前。韦尔福德是一个村庄，距离英国皇家空军费尔福德军事基地约 1.6 公里，参与伊朗冲突的美国空军轰炸机驻扎在那里，警方在疏散居民后宣布发生重大事件。 （大卫·鲍恩/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: Others appear to be taking to it like true preppers.
paras.zh: 其他人似乎像真正的末日准备者一样接受它。

paras.en: “We bulk-buy,” said Preyal Shah, a working mother from Harrow in northwest London.
paras.zh: “我们批量购买，”来自伦敦西北部哈罗公学的职业母亲普雷亚尔·沙阿 (Preyal Shah) 说。

paras.en: “I even now have 10 kilograms of rice, five kilograms of pasta … multiple cases of tinned food, each type being 12 tins.”
paras.zh: “我现在还有10公斤大米、5公斤面食……多箱罐头，每箱12罐。”

paras.en: Preyal said she is also stockpiling newspapers to light a coal-burning stove: “Back to basics.”
paras.zh: 普雷亚尔说，她还储备报纸来点燃燃煤炉：“回到基础。”

paras.en: In October, British Defence Secretary Wes Streeting warned that the country needs to be “ready for war in 1,000 days," flagging the potential of Russian aggression.
paras.zh: 10 月，英国国防部长韦斯·斯特里廷警告说，英国需要“在 1000 天内做好战争准备”，并指出了俄罗斯侵略的可能性。

paras.en: “To prevent the worst, we have to prepare for it,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“为了防止最坏的情况发生，我们必须做好准备。”

paras.en: “We’ve just got so many competing crises at the moment … and war in Europe,” said Reena Patel, a lawyer from north London, referring to Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine.
paras.zh: “目前我们面临如此多的相互竞争的危机……以及欧洲的战争，”伦敦北部的律师雷娜·帕特尔(Reena Patel)在谈到俄罗斯对乌克兰的全面入侵时说道。

paras.en: “It’s not necessarily that I’m thinking war is coming but…” she said, listing off all she wants to buy, from a wind-up radio to water purification filters.
paras.zh: “我不一定认为战争即将来临，但是……”她说，列出了她想买的所有东西，从发条收音机到净水过滤器。

paras.en: “The only thing I have in my control is to try to be a little bit prepared.”
paras.zh: “我唯一能控制的就是尽量做好一点准备。”

articles.title: Poland in mourning after deadly mass shooting in Krakow

paras.en: Poland in mourning after deadly mass shooting in Krakow
paras.zh: 波兰在克拉科夫发生大规模枪击事件后哀悼

paras.en: The attack happened in city's bustling Main Square at the heart of the city's Old Town
paras.zh: 袭击发生在该市老城区中心繁华的主广场

paras.en: Poland began two days of national mourning on Sunday, after authorities say a 24-year-old man with far-right views drove into a busy central square in Krakow and opened fire, killing six people and wounding 15 others before police shot and wounded him.
paras.zh: 波兰周日开始为期两天的全国哀悼，当局表示，一名持有极右观点的 24 岁男子驾车驶入克拉科夫一个繁忙的中心广场并开枪，造成 6 人死亡、15 人受伤，随后警方开枪打伤了他。

paras.en: The attack, which Poland’s defence minister described as an "act of terror," happened on Saturday in Main Square in the heart of Krakow’s Old Town. The area is a major tourist hub in the country’s second-largest city.
paras.zh: 波兰国防部长称此次袭击为“恐怖行为”，袭击发生在周六克拉科夫老城区中心的主广场。该地区是该国第二大城市的主要旅游中心。

paras.en: By evening, mourners had left candles in memory of the victims. The square remained partially closed on Sunday morning as authorities continued their investigation.
paras.zh: 到了晚上，哀悼者留下了蜡烛以纪念遇难者。周日上午，随着当局继续调查，该广场仍部分关闭。

paras.en: Marie-Ange Collaer wrote on Facebook that she and her family survived the shooting during a trip to Krakow from Brussels.
paras.zh: 玛丽-安吉·科拉尔在脸书上写道，她和她的家人在从布鲁塞尔前往克拉科夫的途中遭遇了枪击事件。

paras.en: "We literally ran for our lives and managed to hide from the bullets flying around," she wrote. "Lying on the floor in a shop like in a bad police movie whilst you hear bullets everywhere."
paras.zh: 她写道：“我们确实是在逃命，并设法躲避飞来的子弹。” “躺在商店的地板上，就像一部糟糕的警察电影中一样，你会听到到处都是子弹。”

paras.en: Collaer said her family was "quite in shock" after returning to their hotel but everyone was grateful to be alive.
paras.zh: 科拉尔说，她的家人回到酒店后“非常震惊”，但每个人都很庆幸自己还活着。

paras.en: "We saw a few that did not make it, true horror," she wrote.
paras.zh: “我们看到了一些没有成功的人，真正的恐怖，”她写道。

paras.en: St. Mary’s Trumpet Call, a traditional five-note melody played every hour from the highest tower of St. Mary’s Basilica on the Main Square, was paused overnight in tribute to the victims. It is the first time the call has been missed since the Second World War.
paras.zh: 圣玛丽号角是一种传统的五音旋律，每小时从主广场的圣玛丽大教堂最高塔楼播放一次，该曲在夜间暂停，以悼念遇难者。这是二战以来第一次错过电话。

paras.en: Attacker’s sister and parents found dead
paras.zh: 袭击者的妹妹和父母被发现死亡

paras.en: Four women and two men were killed in the Main Square shooting. Three of the women and one of the men were Polish, Krzysztof Jan Klęczar, the Malopolska regional governor, said on Sunday. A man from the U.K. and a woman from an unidentified foreign country were also among the dead.
paras.zh: 四名妇女和两名男子在主广场枪击事件中丧生。小波兰地区州长克日什托夫·扬·克勒恰 (Krzysztof Jan Klęczar) 周日表示，其中三名女性和一名男性是波兰人。死者中还有一名来自英国的男子和一名来自不明国家的女子。

paras.en: The two police officers who stopped the attacker remain in hospital. One of them is still in a coma while the other woke up from a coma, Klęczar said. Officials launched an appeal for blood donations for the benefit of the most seriously wounded policeman.
paras.zh: 阻止袭击者的两名警察仍在医院。克勒查尔说，其中一人仍处于昏迷状态，另一人已从昏迷中醒来。官员们呼吁为受伤最重的警察献血。

paras.en: Cordoned-off areas at Krakow's Main Market Square following Saturday's mass shooting. (Jakub Porzycki/Reuters)
paras.zh: 周六大规模枪击事件后，克拉科夫主市场广场被封锁。 （雅库布·波尔兹茨基/路透社）

paras.en: "If it weren’t for the efficient and selfless intervention of these two young men, the number of victims could have been significantly higher," Klęczar said.
paras.zh: 克勒查尔说：“如果没有这两名年轻人的高效和无私的干预，受害者人数可能会大大增加。”

paras.en: Five non-Poles are among the wounded. They come from the U.K., Portugal, Russia, Germany and Austria.
paras.zh: 伤者中有五名非波兰人。他们来自英国、葡萄牙、俄罗斯、德国和奥地利。

paras.en: The suspect is also in a critical state, having been operated on multiple times.
paras.zh: 嫌疑人也曾多次接受手术，情况危急。

paras.en: There was confusion on Saturday about the shooter’s age, with authorities first saying 24 and later 25. On Sunday they confirmed that he is 24.
paras.zh: 周六，枪手的年龄出现了混乱，当局先说是 24 岁，后来又说是 25 岁。周日，他们确认枪手年龄是 24 岁。

paras.en: The prosecutors said on Sunday they started an investigation for murder and attempted murder of numerous people, including police officers, with the act "constituting a terrorist offence."
paras.zh: 检察官周日表示，他们开始对包括警察在内的多人谋杀和谋杀未遂事件展开调查，该行为“构成恐怖主义犯罪”。

paras.en: Authorities say they also found three dead bodies at the man’s family home in Ostrowiec Świętokrzyski, a city about 150 kilometers northeast of Krakow. The police said on Sunday they were the bodies of the attacker’s sister, mother and father.
paras.zh: 当局表示，他们还在该男子位于克拉科夫东北约 150 公里处的奥斯特罗维茨维托克日斯基 (Ostrowiec Świętokrzyski) 的家中发现了三具尸体。警方周日表示，这些尸体是袭击者的姐姐、母亲和父亲的尸体。

paras.en: The family members likely died from gunshot wounds, the police said.
paras.zh: 警方称，这家人很可能死于枪伤。

paras.en: The mass killing marks a grim first for Poland
paras.zh: 大规模杀戮标志着波兰第一次严峻的屠杀

paras.en: Interior Minister Marcin Kierwiński said the attacker holds "very radical" and "ultranationalistic" views.
paras.zh: 内政部长马尔钦·基尔温斯基表示，袭击者持有“非常激进”和“极端民族主义”的观点。

paras.en: "Everything indicates that he was fascinated by far-right ideologies," Kierwiński said at a news conference.
paras.zh: “一切都表明他对极右意识形态着迷，”基尔温斯基在新闻发布会上说。

paras.en: Videos posted on social media by witnesses show people running away from the square to take cover on small streets nearby, as well as first responders trying to resuscitate victims. In one video, a police officer is seen repeatedly shooting the attacker, who is lying on the street, only to later slowly collapse to the ground himself.
paras.zh: 目击者在社交媒体上发布的视频显示，人们逃离广场，躲到附近的小街道上，急救人员也试图对受害者进行复苏。在一段视频中，可以看到一名警察多次向躺在街上的袭击者开枪，后来他自己慢慢倒在地上。

paras.en: People stand near candles and flowers left near the Main Market Square in tribute for victims after Saturday's mass shooting. (Jakub Porzycki/Reuters)
paras.zh: 人们站在主市场广场附近留下的蜡烛和鲜花旁，悼念周六大规模枪击事件后的受害者。 （雅库布·波尔兹茨基/路透社）

paras.en: Klęczar said the attacker’s father owned over 10 guns legally and that the attacker also owned guns. Local officials in Ostrowiec Świętokrzyski said they seized seven weapons from the family home, bringing the total number recovered to 11, including four found in the possession of the attacker in Krakow or in his car.
paras.zh: Klęczar 表示，袭击者的父亲合法拥有 10 多支枪支，袭击者也拥有枪支。奥斯特罗维茨·斯维托克日斯基 (Ostrowiec Świętokrzyski) 当地官员表示，他们从家里查获了 7 件武器，使查获的武器总数达到 11 件，其中在克拉科夫袭击者或其车内发现了 4 件武器。

paras.en: Around 411,000 people hold gun permits in Poland, which has a population of 37 million, and interest in gun ownership has been rising, particularly because of Russia's invasion of Ukraine and fear of instability in the region.
paras.zh: 在拥有 3700 万人口的波兰，约有 411,000 人持有枪支许可证，人们对拥有枪支的兴趣一直在上升，特别是因为俄罗斯入侵乌克兰以及对该地区不稳定的担忧。

paras.en: Mass shootings are uncommon in Poland. However, in mid-October three attacks at schools in the central province of Mazovia took place within four days, leaving one person dead and many wounded, including children. The young attackers used knives or other sharp objects.
paras.zh: 大规模枪击事件在波兰并不常见。然而，10月中旬，中部马佐维亚省的学校在四天内发生了三起袭击事件，造成一人死亡、多人受伤，其中包括儿童。年轻的袭击者使用刀或其他锋利的物体。

paras.en: The Krakow attacker’s military gear, guns and overall look were similar to those of other "extreme-right lone actors" committing attacks around Europe, said Kacper Rekawek, a senior researcher at the International Center for Counterterrorism in The Hague.
paras.zh: 海牙国际反恐中心高级研究员卡茨珀·雷卡维克表示，克拉科夫袭击者的军事装备、枪支和整体外貌与其他在欧洲各地发动袭击的“极右独行者”相似。

paras.en: "We have had attempts before, but now we can say that these kinds of attacks have become successful in Poland."
paras.zh: “我们以前曾尝试过，但现在我们可以说此类攻击在波兰已经取得了成功。”

articles.title: Train collision in Egypt kills 4 and injures 88 south of Cairo

paras.en: Train collision in Egypt kills 4 and injures 88 south of Cairo
paras.zh: 埃及开罗以南火车相撞事故造成4人死亡、88人受伤

paras.en: Emergency teams and cranes were dispatched to the scene to clear the wreckage and restore train services
paras.zh: 应急小组和起重机被派往现场清理残骸并恢复列车服务

paras.en: At least four people were killed and almost 90 others were injured when two trains collided Sunday south of the Egyptian capital, Cairo, authorities said.
paras.zh: 当局称，周日两列火车在埃及首都开罗以南相撞，造成至少 4 人死亡、近 90 人受伤。

paras.en: The crash occurred in the al-Ayyat district in Giza province, about 52 kilometers south of Cairo. A train travelling to the southwestern Fayoum province crashed into the rear of a train heading to the southern province of Aswan, according to the Transportation Ministry. One of the trains derailed, it said, but did not specify which.
paras.zh: 坠机事故发生在开罗以南约52公里处的吉萨省艾亚特地区。据交通部称，一列开往西南部法尤姆省的火车与开往南部阿斯旺省的火车尾部相撞。报道称，其中一列火车脱轨，但没有具体说明是哪列火车脱轨。

paras.en: The Health Ministry said at least four people were killed and 88 others were wounded. The injured were taken to nearby hospitals for treatment, it said.
paras.zh: 卫生部表示，至少 4 人死亡、88 人受伤。报道称，伤者已被送往附近医院接受治疗。

paras.en: People gather at the site of the derailed passenger train south of Cairo. (The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 人们聚集在开罗南部出轨旅客列车现场。 （美联社）

paras.en: President Abdel-Fattah el-Sissi said in a social media post that he ordered a prompt investigation into the crash to hold those responsible accountable.
paras.zh: 总统阿卜杜勒-法塔赫·塞西在社交媒体帖子中表示，他下令立即调查这起事故，追究责任人的责任。

paras.en: Emergency teams and cranes were dispatched to the scene to clear the wreckage and restore train services to their normal schedule as soon as possible, the Egyptian Railway Authority said.
paras.zh: 埃及铁路局表示，应急小组和起重机已被派往现场清理残骸，并尽快恢复火车服务正常运行。

paras.en: Last September, a train driver and his assistant were injured after two freight trains collided in the same district.
paras.zh: 去年9月，同一地区两列货运列车相撞，一名火车司机和他的助手受伤。

articles.title: Amid protests, France's rising debt costs threaten stability

paras.en: Deeply indebted, politically trapped in a standoff between extremes and led by a government without a parliamentary majority: These are the defining features of France's current predicament.
paras.zh: 负债累累、政治上陷入极端对峙、政府领导者没有议会多数：这些是法国当前困境的决定性特征。

paras.en: If, in response to nationwide protests, the government plans to provide €4 billion ($4.48 billion) in low-interest loans to renovate schools by 2030 and allocate a further €1 billion to universities by 2029, it is promising money the state simply does not have.
paras.zh: 如果为了应对全国性的抗议活动，政府计划在 2030 年之前提供 40 亿欧元（合 44.8 亿美元）的低息贷款用于翻修学校，并在 2029 年之前再向大学拨款 10 亿欧元，那么政府根本就没有资金。

paras.en: France's public debt stands at around 120% of gross domestic product (GDP). By comparison, Germany's debt-to-GDP ratio is roughly 65%, despite its €600 billion investment package for infrastructure and defense.
paras.zh: 法国的公共债务约占国内生产总值 (GDP) 的 120%。相比之下，尽管德国有 6000 亿欧元的基础设施和国防投资计划，但其债务与 GDP 之比约为 65%。

paras.en: Germany still enjoys the highest possible AAA credit rating. France, by contrast, is rated AA, A+ or Aa3, depending on the credit agency. While Germany's outlook is consistently rated as stable, several agencies have assigned France a negative outlook.
paras.zh: 德国仍然享有最高的AAA信用评级。相比之下，法国的评级为 AA、A+ 或 Aa3，具体取决于信用机构。尽管德国的前景一直被评为稳定，但一些机构却将法国的前景评为负面。

paras.en: As a result, the French government must pay higher interest rates on its borrowing than Berlin. The risk premium over German government bonds, known as the spread, is now at its highest level since the financial crisis. France pays nearly 1.6 percentage points more in interest than Germany on 10-year bonds.
paras.zh: 因此，法国政府必须支付比柏林更高的借款利率。德国政府债券的风险溢价（即利差）目前处于金融危机以来的最高水平。法国10年期债券的利息比德国高出近1.6个百分点。

paras.en: The spread acts as a kind of "fever gauge" for bond markets, explained Friedrich Heinemann, an economist at the Leibniz Center for European Economic Research (ZEW) in Mannheim.
paras.zh: 曼海姆莱布尼茨欧洲经济研究中心（ZEW）的经济学家弗里德里希·海涅曼（Friedrich Heinemann）解释说，这种利差就像债券市场的“发烧指标”。

paras.en: "This fever gauge then forces a change of course. If the spread rises too sharply, France's financing conditions come under pressure, and anyone in France who needs a loan has to pay higher interest rates. Banks then get into trouble, and the crisis escalates further," Heinemann told DW.
paras.zh: 海涅曼对德国之声表示：“这种发烧指标自然会迫使我们改变方向。如果利差上升得太快，法国的融资条件就会面临压力，法国任何需要贷款的人都必须支付更高的利率。银行就会陷入困境，危机进一步升级。”

paras.en: "This could then slide toward a financial crisis, which would finally send a clear signal to everyone: Things cannot continue like this unless you are prepared to risk a genuine economic collapse," he said.
paras.zh: “然后，这可能会滑向金融危机，这最终将向所有人发出一个明确的信号：除非你准备好冒真正的经济崩溃的风险，否则事情不能继续这样下去，”他说。

paras.en: Landry Charrier, a researcher at the University of Bonn's Center for Advanced Security, Strategic and Integration Studies, however, does not expect France's debt-fueled spending spree to end anytime soon.
paras.zh: 然而，波恩大学高级安全、战略和一体化研究中心研究员兰德里·查里尔预计，法国债务驱动的支出热潮不会很快结束。

paras.en: "French people are aware of the country's high public debt. But debt remains an abstract concept if its consequences are barely felt in everyday life. According to INSEE [the French national statistics agency — Editor's note], 56% of the population receive more in government benefits and services than they pay in taxes and social contributions. The majority therefore have a tangible interest in maintaining the status quo," Charrier told DW.
paras.zh: 查里尔告诉德国之声：“法国人都知道国家的高额公共债务。但如果在日常生活中几乎感受不到债务的后果，那么债务仍然是一个抽象的概念。根据INSEE（法国国家统计局——编者注）的数据，56%的人口从政府福利和服务中获得的利益超过了他们缴纳的税收和社会缴款。因此，大多数人对维持现状有着切实的兴趣。”

paras.en: For more than half a century, France has regularly spent more than it collects in tax revenue. The last time it balanced its national budget was in 1974.
paras.zh: 半个多世纪以来，法国的税收支出经常超过其收入。上一次平衡国家预算是在 1974 年。

paras.en: France last paid a similarly high-risk premium at the end of 2011, during the eurozone debt crisis. What is particularly striking is how quickly it has risen: Since June 2026, the spread over German government bonds has more than doubled.
paras.zh: 法国上次支付类似的高风险溢价是在2011年底欧元区债务危机期间。尤其引人注目的是其上升速度：自 2026 年 6 月以来，德国政府债券的利差已增加了一倍多。

paras.en: The main driver is not so much the general level of interest rates. Rather, it's the growing risk premium investors demand in response to high debt levels, political instability, large budget deficits and the recent unrest.
paras.zh: 主要驱动因素并不是利率的总体水平。相反，这是投资者为应对高债务水平、政治不稳定、巨额预算赤字和最近的动荡而要求的不断增长的风险溢价。

paras.en: The higher the interest rates, the larger the share of the national budget that must be devoted to debt servicing alone. France is expected to pay more than €79 billion in interest on its total public debt in 2026. That figure is projected to exceed €91 billion in 2027 and could reach between €125 billion and €132 billion by 2030.
paras.zh: 利率越高，国家预算中必须专门用于偿债的份额就越大。预计法国到 2026 年将为其公共债务总额支付超过 790 亿欧元的利息。这一数字预计到 2027 年将超过 910 亿欧元，到 2030 年可能达到 1,250 亿欧元至 1,320 亿欧元。

paras.en: These figures include the costs incurred by social security funds and local authorities. The central government's interest bill alone is currently estimated at €62.6 billion by the Agence France Tresor, a French Treasury agency.
paras.zh: 这些数字包括社会保障基金和地方当局产生的费用。法国财政部机构 Agence France Tresor 目前估计，仅中央政府的利息支出就达 626 亿欧元。

paras.en: In the coming years, France will have to refinance large amounts of outstanding bonds that were issued when interest rates were at historic lows. At the same time, the country's substantial budget deficit means it must take on additional debt.
paras.zh: 未来几年，法国将不得不为利率处于历史低位时发行的大量未偿还债券进行再融资。与此同时，该国巨额预算赤字意味着它必须承担额外的债务。

paras.en: The trend of rising interest costs is also affecting Germany. The ZEW's Heinemann has calculated that German interest payments are likely to increase sharply by the early 2030s.
paras.zh: 利息成本上升的趋势也正在影响德国。 ZEW 的海涅曼计算出，到 2030 年代初，德国的利息支付可能会大幅增加。

paras.en: "For the federal government alone, which has so far paid around €30 billion, the figure will triple within a few years as both debt and interest rates rise. And it won't stop there — it will exceed €90 billion. Reaching €100 billion in annual interest payments in the federal budget is then no longer far off," warned the economist.
paras.zh: 这位经济学家警告说：“仅就联邦政府而言，迄今为止已支付了约300亿欧元，随着债务和利率的上升，这个数字将在几年内增加两倍。而且它不会止步于此——将超过900亿欧元。联邦预算中每年支付的利息达到1000亿欧元就不再遥远了。”

paras.en: In France, however, economic realities seem to have little impact on political debate. Both the far-right National Rally (RN) and the far-left France Unbowed (LFI) are campaigning on costly promises.
paras.zh: 然而在法国，经济现实似乎对政治辩论影响不大。极右翼的全国集会 (RN) 和极左翼的法国不屈党 (LFI) 都在兑现代价高昂的承诺。

paras.en: RN leader Marine Le Pen, for example, wants to reinstate the retirement age of 62 while promising €140 billion in savings. Jean-Luc Melenchon, LFI's leader, has even suggested that government bonds held by the French central bank should be "thrown into the fire."
paras.zh: 例如，RN 领导人马琳·勒庞 (Marine Le Pen) 希望恢复 62 岁的退休年龄，同时承诺节省 1,400 亿欧元。 LFI领导人让-吕克·梅朗雄(Jean-Luc Melenchon)甚至建议将法国央行持有的政府债券“扔进火里”。

paras.en: "Nobody will ever notice they've disappeared," he has claimed.
paras.zh: “没有人会注意到他们已经消失了，”他声称。

paras.en: 'Fairy tales from the left and the right'
paras.zh: “左边和右边的童话”

paras.en: For Heinemann, this is "a good example of radical parties on both the right and the left simply telling economic fairy tales."
paras.zh: 对于海涅曼来说，这是“右翼和左翼激进政党只是简单地讲述经济童话的一个很好的例子”。

paras.en: Their common message, he said, is that "there is a way out of this mess that requires neither fiscal consolidation nor painful cuts."
paras.zh: 他说，他们的共同信息是“有一种摆脱困境的方法，既不需要财政整顿，也不需要痛苦的削减。”

paras.en: Charrier is convinced that many French people have yet to grasp the seriousness of the situation.
paras.zh: 查里尔相信，许多法国人尚未认识到局势的严重性。

paras.en: "The euro has made it easier for France to access cheap financing and has long softened the pressure to adjust," he pointed out.
paras.zh: “欧元使法国更容易获得廉价融资，并长期以来缓解了调整压力，”他指出。

paras.en: "In the past, currency devaluations [of the French franc — Editor's note] made economic imbalances immediately felt through declining purchasing power and rising prices. Today, that warning signal is missing. This has created the illusion that necessary adjustments can be postponed indefinitely," Charrier said.
paras.zh: “过去，[法郎——编者注]货币贬值导致购买力下降和物价上涨，导致经济失衡。如今，这一警告信号消失了。这造成了一种错觉，认为必要的调整可以无限期推迟，”查里尔表示。

paras.en: This article was originally written in German.
paras.zh: 本文最初是用德语写的。

articles.title: Ukraine: Russia hits Kyiv with airstrikes ahead of trilateral talks

paras.en: Russia launched strikes on Kyiv and surrounding areas overnight, Russian and Ukrainian authorities said on Saturday.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯和乌克兰当局周六表示，俄罗斯连夜对基辅及周边地区发动了袭击。

paras.en: Russia's Defense Ministry said the strikes hit the Northern Bridge and the Meridian Plant.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯国防部表示，袭击袭击了北桥和子午线工厂。

paras.en: Moscow said that the bridge was being used by the Ukrainian military to transport weapons and military equipment, while the plant is used to produce Flamingo cruise missiles.
paras.zh: 莫斯科表示，乌克兰军方使用这座桥运输武器和军事装备，而该工厂则用于生产火烈鸟巡航导弹。

paras.en: It said the strikes damaged several energy and industrial facilities in the Kyiv region, as well as an electricity substation in the neighboring Zhytomyr region and a cargo vessel in the Black Sea.
paras.zh: 据称，袭击损坏了基辅地区的多个能源和工业设施，以及邻近日托米尔地区的一座变电站和黑海的一艘货船。

paras.en: What have Ukrainian authorities said about the attacks?
paras.zh: 乌克兰当局对袭击事件有何评论？

paras.en: Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko confirmed the strikes on the Northern Bridge, adding that the Ukrainian capital found itself in an "extremely difficult" situation regarding power, heating and water supplies. Overnight temperatures dropped to 0 degrees Celsius (32 degrees Fahrenheit) in the city.
paras.zh: 基辅市长维塔利·克里琴科证实了北桥遭到袭击的消息，并补充说，乌克兰首都在电力、供暖和供水方面处于“极其困难”的境地。该市夜间气温降至 0 摄氏度（32 华氏度）。

paras.en: The Kyiv region's governor, Tymur Tkachenko, said energy facilities in three of its districts had been hit.
paras.zh: 基辅地区州长泰穆尔·特卡琴科表示，该地区三个地区的能源设施遭到袭击。

paras.en: Ukrainian authorities said that one person was killed and eight were wounded in the overnight attack.
paras.zh: 乌克兰当局表示，夜间袭击造成 1 人死亡、8 人受伤。

paras.en: In a statement on social media, president Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that Russia used 172 drones and 36 ballistic missiles during the attack.
paras.zh: 总统泽连斯基在社交媒体上发表声明称，俄罗斯在袭击中动用了 172 架无人机和 36 枚弹道导弹。

paras.en: He said that Russia was trying to "push Kyiv … and the entire country into a blackout" and repeated his call for increased support from the United States.
paras.zh: 他表示，俄罗斯正试图“让基辅……以及整个国家陷入停电”，并再次呼吁美国加大支持力度。

paras.en: Russia has stepped up airstrikes on Ukraine in recent months, targeting energy infrastructure and major cities, and more recently hitting bridges.
paras.zh: 近几个月来，俄罗斯加强了对乌克兰的空袭，目标是能源基础设施和主要城市，最近还袭击了桥梁。

paras.en: Strikes come ahead of Russia-Ukraine talks
paras.zh: 俄罗斯与乌克兰会谈前举行罢工

paras.en: The strikes come days before a fourth round of trilateral talks between Kyiv, Moscow and Washington in Abu Dhabi in the United Arab Emirates.
paras.zh: 这次袭击发生在基辅、莫斯科和华盛顿在阿拉伯联合酋长国阿布扎比举行第四轮三边会谈的几天前。

paras.en: Previous rounds of US-brokered talks have failed to achieve any breakthroughs, with territorial and security questions remaining major points of contention.
paras.zh: 美国斡旋的前几轮会谈未能取得任何突破，领土和安全问题仍然是主要争论点。

paras.en: On Friday, US President Donald Trump said the war could be close to being settled and that he envisioned a "big, beautiful agreement" with Moscow that involves "all of Europe."
paras.zh: 周五，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，战争可能接近解决，他设想与莫斯科达成一项涉及“整个欧洲”的“伟大而美好的协议”。

paras.en: Last Friday, a six-day local ceasefire in the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky in the southern Kherson region enabled the evacuation of some 800 residents.
paras.zh: 上周五，赫尔松南部地区被俄罗斯占领的奥列什基市实现了为期六天的局部停火，约 800 名居民得以撤离。

paras.en: The brief truce was brokered by US First Lady Melania Trump.
paras.zh: 短暂的休战是由美国第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普促成的。

articles.title: Israeli president tasks Gadi Eisenkot with forming government

paras.en: Israeli President Isaac Herzog has chosen Gadi Eisenkot to have the first opportunity to form a new Israeli government, according to a statement released by his office on Saturday evening.
paras.zh: 根据以色列总统办公室周六晚间发布的声明，以色列总统艾萨克·赫尔佐格已选择加迪·艾森科特作为组建以色列新政府的首要机会。

paras.en: The statement said Eisenkot was informed of Herzog's "intention to task him with forming a government" and would be invited to the president's residence, where a formal ceremony will take place on Sunday.
paras.zh: 声明称，艾森科特已获悉赫尔佐格“打算责成他组建政府”，并将受邀前往总统官邸，并于周日在那里举行正式仪式。

paras.en: What was the outcome from the Israeli election?
paras.zh: 以色列大选结果如何？

paras.en: The decision comes after a neck-and-neck race with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in Israel's October election.
paras.zh: 这一决定是在以色列十月份选举中与总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡（Benjamin Netanyahu）势均力敌后做出的。

paras.en: The Eisenkot-led bloc of Zionist parties, fashioned in opposition to Netanyahu, won 48 of the Israeli parliament's 120 seats in October's election, with Netanyahu's camp securing 53.
paras.zh: 艾森科特领导的反对内塔尼亚胡的犹太复国主义政党集团在 10 月份的选举中赢得了以色列议会 120 个席位中的 48 个席位，其中内塔尼亚胡阵营获得了 53 个席位。

paras.en: Israel's Arab parties secured a historic result with 19 parliament seats, with both camps initially promising not to rely on them to form a government ahead of the vote.
paras.zh: 以色列的阿拉伯政党取得了历史性的胜利，获得了 19 个议会席位，两个阵营最初都承诺在投票前不会依赖他们组建政府。

paras.en: Former Israeli military chief Eisenkot is the leader of the centrist Yashar party and heads an anti-Netanyahu alliance.
paras.zh: 以色列前军事首长艾森科特是中间派亚沙尔党的领导人，也是反内塔尼亚胡联盟的领导者。

paras.en: While Netanyahu ruled out working with Arab parties to gain a majority, both Arab majority lists had announced during the week that they would recommend Eisenkot as the next prime minister.
paras.zh: 尽管内塔尼亚胡排除了与阿拉伯政党合作以获得多数席位的可能性，但两个阿拉伯多数党名单都在本周宣布，他们将推荐艾森科特担任下一任总理。

paras.en: Political reliance on Arab parties is considered contentious in Israeli politics. However, governments have previously relied on Arab votes to secure a majority.
paras.zh: 在以色列政治中，对阿拉伯政党的政治依赖被认为是有争议的。然而，各国政府此前一直依靠阿拉伯人的选票来获得多数席位。

paras.en: The Israeli government led by Yitzhak Rabin relied on Arab parties' votes from the opposition until Rabin's assassination in 1995, while the Arab party Ra'am was part of the coalition led by Naftali Bennet and Yair Lapid between 2021 and 2022.
paras.zh: 伊扎克·拉宾领导的以色列政府一直依赖阿拉伯政党在野党的选票，直到1995年拉宾遇刺为止，而阿拉伯政党Ra'am则在2021年至2022年期间是纳夫塔利·贝内特和亚伊尔·拉皮德领导的联盟的一部分。

paras.en: The move is the first step toward what will almost certainly be complicated coalition talks.
paras.zh: 此举是迈向几乎肯定会很复杂的联合谈判的第一步。

paras.en: Should Eisenkot succeed in forming a government, he would take over as prime minister from Netanyahu, Israel's longest-serving premier, whose religious-nationalist coalition lost its majority in the election despite emerging as the largest bloc.
paras.zh: 如果艾森科特成功组建政府，他将从以色列任期最长的总理内塔尼亚胡手中接任总理，内塔尼亚胡的宗教民族主义联盟尽管成为最大的集团，但在选举中失去了多数席位。

paras.en: Although Eisenkot was runner-up, he managed to secure endorsements from leaders of Arab parties, which are opposed to Netanyahu.
paras.zh: 尽管艾森科特屈居亚军，但他还是获得了反对内塔尼亚胡的阿拉伯政党领导人的支持。

paras.en: Eisenkot faces a tricky path to forming a government, involving difficult constellations of Arab and ultra-Orthodox parties. He will have 28 days to secure the 61 votes needed to form a government.
paras.zh: 艾森科特面临着一条棘手的组建政府之路，其中涉及阿拉伯和极端正统政党的复杂群体。他将有 28 天的时间来获得组建政府所需的 61 票。

paras.en: Herzog can give Eisenkot a 14-day extension if he comes up short, before the mandate must be offered to another candidate.
paras.zh: 如果艾森科特达不到要求，赫尔佐格可以给他延长 14 天，然后才必须将任命权交给另一位候选人。

paras.en: If no candidate succeeds, Israel will likely head to a fresh election.
paras.zh: 如果没有候选人成功，以色列可能会举行新的选举。

articles.title: Fan hospitalised after falling through stand at Norwegian football match

paras.en: Several fans were injured during a football match in Norway when a panel in the stand for travelling supporters gave way.
paras.zh: 在挪威举行的一场足球比赛中，看台上的旅行支持者面板倒塌，导致多名球迷受伤。

paras.en: Fans fell through the hole at Tromso’s stadium and one was taken to hospital during their match against Bodo/Glimt on Sunday, both clubs said.
paras.zh: 两家具乐部均表示，在周日对阵博多/格里姆特的比赛中，特罗姆瑟体育场有球迷掉入洞中，其中一名球迷被送往医院。

paras.en: The top division game was stopped just before half-time when Bodo keeper Nikita Haikin called the referee’s attention to the incident behind the goal, where the away fans were standing in the pouring rain.
paras.zh: 顶级联赛的比赛在半场结束前暂停，博多门将尼基塔·海金提醒裁判注意球门后面的事件，当时客队球迷站在倾盆大雨中。

paras.en: “We have had a serious incident in the away stand in connection with the game between TIL and Bodo/Glimt. Preliminary information is that a person has fallen through the stands and is injured,” Tromso said in a statement.
paras.zh: 特罗姆瑟在一份声明中表示：“在 TIL 和 Bodo/Glimt 之间的比赛中，我们的客场看台发生了一起严重事件。初步信息显示，有人从看台上掉下来受伤。”

paras.en: “Up to five people fell through the stands and one was sent to hospital,” Bodo press officer Simen Pedersen told the Reuters news agency.
paras.zh: 博多新闻官员西门·佩德森 (Simen Pedersen) 告诉路透社：“多达五人从看台上摔下来，其中一人被送往医院。”

paras.en: The statement gave no details about the injuries.
paras.zh: 声明没有透露受伤情况的详细信息。

paras.en: “We stood and bounced to a supporter song, then the floor gave way; it cracked in two in the row in front of us,” Andrine Moen, a Bodo supporter who witnessed the accident, told local newspaper Verdens Gang (VG).
paras.zh: “我们站起来，随着一首支持者的歌曲弹跳起来，然后地板就塌陷了；我们前面的一排地板裂成了两半，”目睹了这起事故的博多支持者安德琳·莫恩 (Andrine Moen) 告诉当地报纸 Verdens Gang (VG)。

paras.en: “There were at least two people who fell through the floor, but we don’t know how far they fell or how many fell in total,” she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“至少有两人从地板上掉下来，但我们不知道他们掉了多远，​​也不知道总共掉了多少人。”

paras.en: Bodo fans were instructed to leave the away section, with Tromso fans asked to make space for them in other parts of the ground, VG reported.
paras.zh: 据VG报道，博多球迷被要求离开客场区域，特罗姆瑟球迷则被要求在球场的其他地方为他们腾出空间。

paras.en: Following consultations between the two teams, the Norwegian Football Federation (NFF), supporters and the police, the game resumed and Bodo’s Ola Brynhildsen scored twice to send his side top of the Eliteserien table, ahead of Viking Stavanger on goal difference.
paras.zh: 经过两支球队、挪威足协（NFF）、球迷和警方的协商后，比赛重新开始，博多队的奥拉·布林希尔德森梅开二度，帮助球队以净胜球优势领先于维京斯塔万格队，位居联赛积分榜榜首。

articles.title: India’s ‘cockroach’ movement seeks to restore culture of accountability

paras.en: India’s Cockroach Janta Party is a youth movement demanding political accountability, employment and fair elections.
paras.zh: 印度蟑螂简塔党是一个要求政治问责、就业和公平选举的青年运动。

paras.en: The founder of the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP), Abhijeet Dipke, says its goal is to restore the culture of accountability in the Indian government.
paras.zh: 蟑螂简塔党 (CJP) 的创始人阿比吉特·迪普克 (Abhijeet Dipke) 表示，该党的目标是恢复印度政府的问责文化。

paras.en: The movement, which started as online political satire, has become a major force demanding political and social change.
paras.zh: 该运动最初是在线政治讽刺，现已成为要求政治和社会变革的主要力量。

paras.en: The CJP burst onto the political scene in May, mobilising thousands of young people to protest against exam paper leaks, unemployment and the high cost of living. Weeks later, the education minister resigned.
paras.zh: CJP于5月突然出现在政坛，动员数千名年轻人抗议试卷泄露、失业和高生活成本。几周后，教育部长辞职。

paras.en: Now protesters have turned their attention to the chief election commissioner. They want him out.
paras.zh: 现在抗议者已将注意力转向首席选举专员。他们想要他出去。

paras.en: Opposition parties and the CJP accuse India’s electoral body of manipulating voter lists in favour of Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s governing Bharatiya Janata Party. The commission denies any wrongdoing. It says it was removing deceased, duplicate and ineligible voters.
paras.zh: 反对党和印度人民党指责印度选举机构操纵选民名单，以支持总理纳伦德拉·莫迪领导的执政党印度人民党。该委员会否认有任何不当行为。它表示正在剔除已故、重复和不合格的选民。

paras.en: The BJP has accused demonstrators of sowing chaos and trying to undermine democracy.
paras.zh: 印度人民党指责示威者制造混乱并试图破坏民主。

paras.en: Dipke says that’s not true. He says the CJP wants a better India – better education, more job opportunities, free and fair elections, and for the government to stop ignoring young people.
paras.zh: 迪普克说这不是真的。他说，印度人民党希望印度变得更好——更好的教育、更多的就业机会、自由和公平的选举，以及政府不要再忽视年轻人。

paras.en: He admits it’s a difficult fight. Several CJP leaders, including our guest, have been arrested.
paras.zh: 他承认这是一场艰难的战斗。包括我们的客人在内的几位 CJP 领导人已被捕。

paras.en: But Dipke says the movement will not be shaken.
paras.zh: 但迪普克表示，这一运动不会动摇。

articles.title: Photos: Diwali celebrations light up India and its global diaspora

paras.en: Diwali, the festival of lights, is being celebrated across India and among its vast diaspora, marking one of the most important days of the year for Hindus.
paras.zh: 印度各地及其广大侨民正在庆祝排灯节，这是印度教徒一年中最重要的日子之一。

paras.en: More than one billion people of different faiths take part in the celebrations in the world’s most populous nation, gathering for prayers, family reunions and the lighting of fireworks.
paras.zh: 超过十亿不同信仰的人参加了这个世界上人口最多的国家的庆祝活动，聚集在一起祈祷、家庭团聚和燃放烟花。

paras.en: The name Diwali comes from “Deepavali”, meaning “a row of lights”, and many families place clay oil lamps outside their homes to symbolise the triumph of light over darkness and knowledge over ignorance.
paras.zh: 排灯节这个名字来源于“Deepavali”，意思是“一排灯”，许多家庭在自家门外放置粘土油灯，象征光明战胜黑暗、知识战胜无知。

paras.en: The festival follows the Hindu lunar calendar and usually falls in late October or early November. This year, Diwali is marked on November 8.
paras.zh: 该节日遵循印度农历，通常在十月底或十一月初。今年的排灯节是 11 月 8 日。

paras.en: While Diwali is rooted in Hindu tradition, it is also observed by Sikhs, Jains and Buddhists, with regional origin stories that share a common theme – the victory of good over evil.
paras.zh: 虽然排灯节植根于印度教传统，但锡克教徒、耆那教徒和佛教徒也庆祝这一节日，其地区起源故事有一个共同的主题——正义战胜邪恶。

paras.en: Celebrations often include feasting, new clothes, rangoli floor designs, and the exchange of sweets and gifts with friends and neighbours.
paras.zh: 庆祝活动通常包括宴会、新衣服、兰戈里地板设计以及与朋友和邻居交换糖果和礼物。

articles.title: Russell Brand to learn sentence after being found guilty of rape and sexual assault
articles.author: Kate Bartlett

paras.en: Russell Brand to learn sentence after being found guilty of rape and sexual assault
paras.zh: 拉塞尔·布兰德 (Russell Brand) 因强奸和性侵犯罪名成立后将接受判刑

paras.en: Comedian Russell Brand faces a "significant" prison sentence, which a London court judge is set to hand down on Monday.
paras.zh: 喜剧演员拉塞尔·布兰德面临“重大”监禁，伦敦法院法官将于周一宣判。

paras.en: On Thursday the one-time MTV host turned Christian and spiritual influencer was found guilty on three counts of sexual assault and one of rape, after a four-week trial that garnered massive media attention.
paras.zh: 周四，经过为期四个星期的审判，这位曾经的 MTV 主持人转型为基督徒和精神影响者，被判犯有三项性侵犯罪和一项强奸罪，引起了媒体的广泛关注。

paras.en: Brand had denied all charges and said he never had sex without consent.
paras.zh: 布兰德否认了所有指控，并表示他从未在未经同意的情况下发生性行为。

paras.en: After the jury handed down the verdict, Judge Joel Bennathan told Brand, 51, that he faced a "significant custodial term."
paras.zh: 陪审团作出裁决后，法官乔尔·本纳森 (Joel Bennathan) 告诉 51 岁的布兰德，他面临“长期监禁”。

paras.en: Danny Shaw, a crime commentator and former BBC correspondent, posted on X that while the maximum sentence for rape in the UK is life, 10 years is the average sentence, and Brand was likely to receive between four to 13 years of prison time.
paras.zh: 犯罪评论员、前 BBC 记者丹尼·肖 (Danny Shaw) 在 X 上发帖称，虽然英国强奸罪的最高刑期为无期徒刑，但平均刑期为 10 年，布兰德可能会被判 4 至 13 年监禁。

paras.en: The trial examined seven historic charges against Brand, brought forward by six different women. He was found guilty on four of the charges: for raping a woman who'd been to one of his comedy shows in 2009, and sexually assaulting three others between 2004 and 2009. The locations of the sexual assaults were a bar, radio station and TV studio. Brand was also found not guilty of two counts of rape and one count of attempted indecent assault.
paras.zh: 审判审查了六名不同女性对布兰德提出的七项历史性指控。他被判犯有四项罪名：强奸一名曾在 2009 年观看他的喜剧节目的妇女，以及在 2004 年至 2009 年间对另外三人进行性侵犯。性侵犯的地点是一家酒吧、广播电台和电视演播室。布兰德还被判犯有两项强奸罪和一项未遂猥亵罪。

paras.en: Brand's lawyer asked the judge on Thursday to grant his client bail so that he could spend the weekend with his three children, which the judge denied. Instead the one-time celebrity darling spent his first weekend in a prison cell in London.
paras.zh: 布兰德的律师周四请求法官准予他的当事人保释，以便他可以与三个孩子共度周末，但法官拒绝了这一请求。相反，这位曾经的名人宠儿在伦敦的牢房里度过了他的第一个周末。

paras.en: He showed little emotion when the verdict was handed down, though his wife Laura — who has supported him throughout — quickly left the courtroom.
paras.zh: 判决下达后，他几乎没有表现出任何情绪，但一直支持他的妻子劳拉很快就离开了法庭。

paras.en: Many have called the verdict a significant milestone in the #MeToo movement, which has seen influential men held to account for using their power to abuse women.
paras.zh: 许多人称这一判决是#MeToo运动中的一个重要里程碑，在该运动中，有影响力的男性因利用权力虐待女性而被追究责任。

paras.en: Brand has also faced allegations of crimes in the United States. In 2023, a woman, named only as "Jane Doe," accused Brand of sexually assaulting her while she was working as a film extra during the making of the 2010 comedy movie "Arthur." That year, Brand married pop star Katy Perry, though the union lasted for just over a year before they divorced.
paras.zh: 布兰德在美国也面临犯罪指控。 2023 年，一名名叫“Jane Doe”的女性指控布兰德在她 2010 年喜剧电影《亚瑟》制作期间担任临时演员时对她进行了性侵犯。那一年，布兰德与流行歌星凯蒂·佩里结婚，尽管这段婚姻只维持了一年多就离婚了。

paras.en: Addressing the media last week, London police detective Andy Furphy said that Brand had "used his influence, status and fame to prey on women — as his profile grew, so too did his sense of entitlement."
paras.zh: 伦敦警探安迪·弗菲上周向媒体发表讲话时表示，布兰德“利用他的影响力、地位和名气来掠夺女性——随着他的知名度不断提高，他的权利意识也随之增强。”

paras.en: Camilla Long, a journalist for The Sunday Times — one of the first newspapers that investigated allegations of abuse against Brand — wrote in a column this weekend that "To sit in court 3 at Southwark crown court, hearing how Brand grabbed, pushed, groped and degraded his victims, was one of the most disgusting experiences of my life."
paras.zh: 《星期日泰晤士报》的记者卡米拉·朗（Camilla Long）是最早调查布兰德虐待指控的报纸之一，她在本周末的一篇专栏文章中写道，“坐在南华克皇家法院第三法庭，听到布兰德如何抓住、推搡、摸索和侮辱他的受害者，是我一生中最恶心的经历之一。”

paras.en: Long questioned how Brand got away with his behavior for so long, saying: "Never has a predator so loudly declared himself, yet been so roundly ignored."
paras.zh: 朗质疑布兰德为何能在这么长的时间里逍遥法外，他说：“从来没有一个掠夺者如此大声地宣称自己，但却被如此彻底地忽视。”

articles.title: After a successful trip to Uruguay, Pope Leo heads to Argentina
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: After a successful trip to Uruguay, Pope Leo heads to Argentina
paras.zh: 成功访问乌拉圭后，教皇利奥前往阿根廷

paras.en: FLORIDA, Uruguay — Pope Leo XIV wrapped up his visit to Uruguay on Sunday by praising the women who have passed the Catholic faith onto younger generations, as he highlighted the role the church has played since the founding of Latin America's most secular country.
paras.zh: 乌拉圭佛罗里达州—教皇利奥十四世周日结束了对乌拉圭的访问，赞扬了将天主教信仰传递给年轻一代的女性，他强调了自拉丁美洲最世俗的国家成立以来教会所发挥的作用。

paras.en: Leo traveled to the city of Florida, north of Montevideo, to mark an important Catholic feast day before heading to Argentina for the second leg of his South American tour. It's expected to be the most politically delicate stop, given the Catholic Church's sharp criticisms of the austerity program of libertarian President Javier Milei.
paras.zh: 利奥前往蒙得维的亚北部的佛罗里达市，庆祝一个重要的天主教节日，然后前往阿根廷进行南美之旅的第二站。鉴于天主教会对自由主义总统哈维尔·米莱的紧缩计划提出尖锐批评，预计这将是政治上最微妙的一站。

paras.en: For his final event in Uruguay, Leo celebrated the feast of the Virgin of the Thirty-three. According to tradition, 33 independence patriots acquired the Guaraní statue and had it with them when independence was declared from the Brazilian empire in Florida on Aug. 25, 1825.
paras.zh: 在乌拉圭的最后一场比赛中，利奥庆祝了三十三圣母的盛宴。根据传统，1825 年 8 月 25 日佛罗里达州宣布脱离巴西帝国独立时，33 名独立爱国者获得了瓜拉尼雕像并随身携带。

paras.en: Leo became the first pope in nearly four decades to visit Uruguay, in hopes of reminding its people that the Catholic Church is part of their very identity as a nation — even if, in subsequent decades, the country went on a deeply secular, and at times anticlerical, route.
paras.zh: 利奥成为近四十年来第一位访问乌拉圭的教皇，希望提醒人民，天主教会是他们国家身份的一部分——即使在接下来的几十年里，这个国家走上了一条极其世俗、有时甚至是反教权的道路。

paras.en: Pope thanks the mothers who passed on the faith
paras.zh: 教宗感谢传递信仰的母亲们

paras.en: In his homily, delivered in front of Florida's cathedral, Leo recalled the presence of the statue at the time of independence in reminding Uruguayans that "the history of peoples, too, cannot be fully understood without reference to God," and especially a mother.
paras.zh: 在佛罗里达大教堂前发表的讲道中，利奥回忆了独立时期这座雕像的存在，提醒乌拉圭人“如果不参考上帝，尤其是母亲，就无法完全理解各国人民的历史”。

paras.en: He thanked all the mothers and grandmothers who have passed the faith onto younger generations, and acknowledged their pain when their efforts didn't stick.
paras.zh: 他感谢所有将信仰传递给年轻一代的母亲和祖母，并承认他们的努力未能坚持下去所带来的痛苦。

paras.en: "You taught your children to pray, and today they no longer do so. You used to attend Mass together, and it has been years since they entered a church," he said. But he urged them to not despair.
paras.zh: “你教你的孩子们祈祷，但今天他们不再这样做了。你们曾经一起参加弥撒，他们已经好几年没有进入教堂了，”他说。但他敦促他们不要绝望。

paras.en: "Mothers and grandmothers: never tire of passing on the faith!"
paras.zh: “母亲们、祖母们：传承信仰永不疲倦！”

paras.en: Tens of thousands of people packed Florida's main square for the Mass under brilliant blue skies, some walking for several kilometers (miles) to reach the site. The city has a population of about 40,000 but the Vatican estimated 50,000 were on hand.
paras.zh: 成千上万的人聚集在佛罗里达州的主要广场上，在蔚蓝的天空下参加弥撒，有些人步行数公里（英里）到达现场。该市人口约 40,000，但梵蒂冈估计有 50,000 人。

paras.en: Fiama Pirez, an English professor, traveled from Montevideo for the Mass even though she could have seen Leo in the capital. She said she preferred a family outing to Florida so her mother could fulfill a dream to see a pope.
paras.zh: 英语教授菲亚玛·皮雷斯 (Fiama Pirez) 从蒙得维的亚赶来参加弥撒，尽管她本可以在首都见到利奥。她说她更喜欢全家去佛罗里达郊游，这样她的母亲就可以实现见到教皇的梦想。

paras.en: "I'm religious in my own way, and although I never strayed far from the Catholic faith, I'm rediscovering it today," she said.
paras.zh: “我以自己的方式信仰宗教，虽然我从未偏离天主教信仰太远，但今天我重新发现了它，”她说。

paras.en: A potentially delicate meeting with Milei
paras.zh: 与 Milei 的一次潜在微妙的会面

paras.en: In Buenos Aires, Milei is due to greet Leo at the airport before the two appear together for the traditional welcome ceremony and exchange of speeches. The Catholic Church has criticized Milei's austerity measures that have slashed social spending, and his embrace of artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 在布宜诺斯艾利斯，米莱将在机场迎接利奥，然后两人一起出席传统的欢迎仪式并交换讲话。天主教会批评米莱削减社会支出的紧缩措施以及他对人工智能的拥抱。

paras.en: Milei has staked his presidency on cutting social spending to overhaul Argentina's troubled economy and deliver a long-elusive budget surplus. He has called social justice "an aberration" that amounts to stealing, and mocked as "huge stupidity" the increasingly common complaint in Argentina that families squeezed by his austerity program can't make it to the end of the month.
