articles.title: Georgia dominates Ole Miss, moves closer to SEC championship game and College Football Playoff berth

paras.en: Maybe the only thing higher than the stakes for Saturday’s matchup between No. 2 Georgia and No. 12 Ole Miss was the level of mutual respect between Bulldogs coach Kirby Smart and Rebels coach Pete Golding.
paras.zh: 也许唯一比周六排名第二的佐治亚州和排名第12的密西西比大学之间的比赛赌注更高的是斗牛犬队教练柯比·斯马特和叛军队教练皮特·戈尔丁之间的相互尊重程度。

paras.en: "Pete has done a tremendous job," Smart said before the SEC showdown. Meanwhile, Golding called Smart and his staff "the gold standard in college football."
paras.zh: “皮特做得非常出色，”斯玛特在美国证券交易委员会摊牌前说道。与此同时，戈尔丁称斯玛特和他的员工是“大学橄榄球的黄金标准”。

paras.en: But once the game began, Georgia quickly turned the highly anticipated matchup into a one-sided affair. The Bulldogs jumped out to a 7-0 lead, carried a 28-0 advantage into halftime and extended it to 35-0 in the third quarter.
paras.zh: 但比赛一开始，乔治亚队很快就把这场备受期待的对决变成了一边倒的局面。斗牛犬队以7-0领先，半场以28-0领先，第三节将比分扩大至35-0。

paras.en: Georgia cruised to a 42-7 win over Ole Miss in Oxford on Saturday night, handing the Rebels their largest home loss since 2018. That year, Ole Miss fell 62-7 to Alabama, then the top-ranked team in the country under coach Nick Saban.
paras.zh: 周六晚上，佐治亚州在牛津以 42-7 战胜密西西比大学，这让叛军队遭遇了自 2018 年以来最大的主场失利。那一年，密西西比大学以 62-7 输给了阿拉巴马大学，当时阿拉巴马大学是教练尼克·萨班 (Nick Saban) 执教的全美排名第一的球队。

paras.en: Ole Miss fans’ frustration boiled over after officials called pass interference against the Rebels with just over five minutes left in the second quarter. Ole Miss trailed 21-0 when some fans began throwing trash and bottles onto the field.
paras.zh: 在第二节还剩五分钟多一点的时候，官员们称叛军队的传球受到干扰，密西西比大学球迷的沮丧情绪沸腾了。当一些球迷开始向球场扔垃圾和瓶子时，密西西比大学以 21-0 落后。

paras.en: Georgia quarterback Gunner Stockton threw four touchdown passes through the first three quarters. Ole Miss quarterback Trinidad Chambliss did not throw a touchdown and was intercepted once.
paras.zh: 佐治亚州四分卫枪手斯托克顿在前三节传出四次达阵。密西西比大学四分卫特立尼达·钱布利斯 (Trinidad Chambliss) 没有达阵，并被拦截一次。

paras.en: An 8-yard run by Ole Miss running back Shekai Mills-Knight with just under 11 minutes remaining finally put the Rebels on the board and cut Georgia’s lead to 35-7.
paras.zh: 距离比赛还剩不到 11 分钟时，Ole Miss 跑卫 Shekai Mills-Knight 冲出 8 码，叛军终于将比分追至 35-7。

paras.en: Since 2023, no two SEC programs had posted better records than Georgia and Ole Miss. Both teams also entered the game with highly productive quarterbacks, although their styles differed.
paras.zh: 自 2023 年以来，没有任何两个 SEC 项目的记录比 Georgia 和 Ole Miss 更好。尽管风格不同，两支球队也都拥有高效的四分卫。

paras.en: Georgia’s clock-eating rushing attack featured Nate Frazier, Dwight Phillips Jr. and Bo Walker, who had combined for 19 touchdowns entering Saturday. That production had eased the burden on Stockton, who had still been efficient while throwing for more than 1,600 yards and 17 touchdowns.
paras.zh: 佐治亚州的进攻由内特·弗雷泽 (Nate Frazier)、小德怀特·菲利普斯 (Dwight Phillips Jr.) 和博·沃克 (Bo Walker) 组成，他们在周六比赛中总共取得了 19 次达阵。这样的表现减轻了斯托克顿的负担，他仍然保持高效，传球超过 1,600 码，达阵 17 次。

paras.en: Frazier rushed for 107 yards against Ole Miss.
paras.zh: 弗雷泽在对阵 Ole Miss 的比赛中冲出了 107 码。

paras.en: Two of Georgia’s remaining games are against conference opponents. Next week, Missouri visits Athens. Ole Miss will travel to Norman for a matchup with Oklahoma in Week 11.
paras.zh: 乔治亚州剩下的两场比赛是对阵分区对手。下周，密苏里州将访问雅典。 Ole Miss 将在第 11 周前往诺曼与俄克拉荷马州进行比赛。

paras.en: The Associated Press contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 美联社对此报道作出了贡献。

articles.title: Three teens, adult charged with murder after woman finds her teenage son dead in abandoned home

paras.en: Three teenagers and an adult have been charged with murder in Georgia after a mother found her 15-year-old son shot to death inside an abandoned residence following Halloween night.
paras.zh: 乔治亚州万圣节之夜后，一名母亲发现她 15 岁的儿子在一处废弃住宅内被枪杀，三名青少年和一名成年人被指控谋杀。

paras.en: The Albany Police Department said investigators arrested 22-year-old Detravion Parke, as well as two 15-year-olds and a 16-year-old in connection with the death of Austin Payne, 15.
paras.zh: 奥尔巴尼警察局表示，调查人员逮捕了 22 岁的德特拉维昂·帕克 (Detravion Parke)，以及两名与 15 岁奥斯汀·佩恩 (Austin Payne) 死亡有关的 15 岁青少年和一名 16 岁青少年。

paras.en: All four suspects were charged with murder and transported to the Dougherty County Jail, according to police.
paras.zh: 据警方称，所有四名嫌疑人均被指控犯有谋杀罪，并被送往多尔蒂县监狱。

paras.en: Officers responded to the 800 block of Cameo Lane in Albany on Nov. 1, where they discovered Payne dead inside an abandoned home, police said. His mother found him by tracking his location via cellphone after he failed to return home on Halloween, according to WALB.
paras.zh: 警方称，11 月 1 日，警方赶赴奥尔巴尼 Cameo Lane 800 街区，发现佩恩死在一间废弃的房屋内。据WALB称，在他万圣节未能回家后，他的母亲通过手机追踪他的位置找到了他。

paras.en: Albany Police Chief Michael Persley said during a Nov. 2 news conference that Payne had contacted his mother after being shot.
paras.zh: 奥尔巴尼警察局长迈克尔·佩斯利 (Michael Persley) 在 11 月 2 日的新闻发布会上表示，佩恩在中枪后联系了他的母亲。

paras.en: "He did make a call to his mother that he had been shot," Persley said.
paras.zh: “他确实打电话给他的母亲，说他被枪杀了，”珀斯利说。

paras.en: According to WALB, investigators reviewed surveillance footage, cellphone records and witness statements to reconstruct the events leading up to Payne's death.
paras.zh: 据 WALB 称，调查人员审查了监控录像、手机记录和目击者证词，以重现导致佩恩死亡的事件。

paras.en: Witnesses told investigators that armed individuals approached a group walking with Payne, demanded their belongings and opened fire, the outlet reported.
paras.zh: 据该媒体报道，目击者告诉调查人员，武装人员接近与佩恩同行的一群人，索要他们的财物并开枪。

paras.en: Payne may have been targeted during an attempted robbery involving a handgun he had recently displayed on social media, according to WALB.
paras.zh: 据 WALB 称，佩恩可能在一次未遂抢劫中成为目标，他最近在社交媒体上展示了一把手枪。

paras.en: Payne's family has launched a GoFundMe fundraiser to help cover funeral expenses following his death.
paras.zh: 佩恩的家人发起了 GoFundMe 筹款活动，以帮助支付他去世后的丧葬费用。

paras.en: A relative said Payne would have turned 16 on Nov. 12.
paras.zh: 一位亲戚称佩恩将于 11 月 12 日满 16 岁。

paras.en: "Our family is trying to process this heartbreaking loss," the relative wrote.
paras.zh: 这位亲戚写道：“我们的家人正在努力应对这一令人心碎的损失。”

paras.en: The fundraiser also noted that Payne is survived by his mother and 17-year-old sister.
paras.zh: 筹款活动还指出，佩恩身后留下了他的母亲和 17 岁的妹妹。

paras.en: The Albany Police Department is asking anyone with additional information about the shooting to contact investigators at 229-431-2100.
paras.zh: 奥尔巴尼警察局要求任何了解有关枪击事件的更多信息的人请致电 229-431-2100 与调查人员联系。

articles.title: Marcus Freeman, Notre Dame silence doubters by knocking off top-ranked Miami, solidifying their CFP ranking

paras.en: After spending five days as the No. 1 team in the country, it was No. 11 Notre Dame that handed the Miami Hurricanes its first loss of the season in the highly anticipated showdown that has been circled for the past year.
paras.zh: 在连续五天成为全国排名第一的球队后，排名第 11 的圣母大学在去年备受期待的对决中让迈阿密飓风队遭遇了本赛季的首场失利。

paras.en: Is there an elite team in college football this season?
paras.zh: 本赛季大学橄榄球有精英队吗？

paras.en: We thought this would turn into an instant classic, based off the history between these two teams that goes back to the "Catholics vs. Convicts" showdown in the '80s.
paras.zh: 我们认为这会立即成为经典，因为这两支球队之间的历史可以追溯到 80 年代的“天主教徒与罪犯”对决。

paras.en: But, we also thought entering the week that Miami would have star wide receiver Malachi Toney on the field to help add to the drama between these two teams.
paras.zh: 但是，我们也认为进入本周迈阿密将有明星外接手马拉奇·托尼在场上，以帮助增加这两支球队之间的戏剧性。

paras.en: In reality, the Hurricanes did not score their first touchdown until there were nine minutes remaining in the third quarter, by which point Notre Dame had raced out to a 24-10 lead. But the floodgates finally opened in the fourth quarter, leading to a thrilling finish in South Bend.
paras.zh: 事实上，飓风队直到第三节还剩 9 分钟时才首次达阵，此时圣母队已经以 24-10 领先。但闸门终于在第四节打开，在南本德带来了激动人心的结局。

paras.en: It took a while, but Hurricanes and Fighting Irish delivered in fourth
paras.zh: 花了一段时间，但飓风和战斗爱尔兰队取得了第四名

paras.en: Were we about to see some of that college football madness that was missing from the actual game being played on the field?
paras.zh: 我们是否会看到一些在球场上实际比赛中缺失的大学橄榄球疯狂？

paras.en: A touchdown pass from Miami quarterback Darian Mensah cut Notre Dame’s lead to 24-17, prompting the Hurricanes’ sideline to erupt as coaches tried to keep their players’ emotions in check.
paras.zh: 迈阿密四分卫达里安·门萨 (Darian Mensah) 的达阵传球将圣母大学的领先优势缩小到 24-17，导致飓风队在场边爆发，教练试图控制球员的情绪。

paras.en: It was at this point that Notre Dame fought their way out of the corner after taking a barrage of punches you'd expect from the No. 1 team in the country. A Nolan James Jr. touchdown run put the Fighting Irish back up by two scores, and almost put away a Miami team who had gassed itself out over that eight-minute stretch.
paras.zh: 正是在这一点上，圣母大学在遭受了全国第一球队的一连串拳击后，从角落里挣脱了出来。小诺兰·詹姆斯的达阵得分让“战斗爱尔兰人”队以两分领先，几乎击败了在八分钟的比赛中已经疲惫不堪的迈阿密队。

paras.en: But given that this game had so much history, it was only fitting that it came down to one final pass. Darian Mensah’s throw to Elija Lofton in the end zone was swatted away at the last second, preserving Notre Dame’s 31-24 win and denying Miami a chance to tie the game.
paras.zh: 但考虑到这场比赛有着如此悠久的历史，它归结为最后一关是再合适不过的了。达里安·门萨 (Darian Mensah) 在达阵区向伊利亚·洛夫顿 (Elija Lofton) 传球在最后一秒被扑出，帮助圣母大学以 31-24 获胜，并剥夺了迈阿密扳平比分的机会。

paras.en: Why not? We've seen so much craziness in college football this season, that it was only fitting this one would come down to the final minute in South Bend.
paras.zh: 为什么不呢？本赛季我们在大学橄榄球比赛中看到了如此多的疯狂，所以这场比赛来到南本德的最后一分钟是再合适不过的了。

paras.en: "I'm happy for this university, I'm happy for our players," Marcus Freeman said postgame. "You know, there's a lot of support from Notre Dame nation and this is a special moment for them. We're a dang good football team, and they're a dang good football team.
paras.zh: “我为这所大学感到高兴，我为我们的球员感到高兴，”马库斯·弗里曼赛后说道。 “你知道，圣母大学得到了很多支持，这对他们来说是一个特殊的时刻。我们是一支非常好的足球队，他们也是一支非常好的足球队。

paras.en: "When it mattered the most, they executed. It got a little ugly in that second half, and we talked about this moment before the game, I said 'at some point in the game there's gonna be a struggle'. They battled through it and executed when it mattered the most."
paras.zh: “在最重要的时候，他们执行了。下半场的情况有点难看，我们在比赛前谈论了这一刻，我说‘在比赛的某个时刻，将会有一场斗争’。他们奋力克服，并在最重要的时候执行了。”

paras.en: For all the talk about not winning on big stages, Marcus Freeman found himself urging his team off the field so quarterback CJ Carr could put the game away with two first downs, finally quieting questions about Notre Dame’s ability to finish.
paras.zh: 对于在大舞台上无法获胜的所有讨论，马库斯·弗里曼发现自己敦促他的球队离开球场，这样四分卫 CJ 卡尔就可以通过两次首攻结束比赛，最终平息了人们对圣母大学能否完成比赛的质疑。

paras.en: What this means for Miami, with Notre Dame needing this 'must win' game
paras.zh: 这对迈阿密意味着什么，圣母大学需要这场“必须赢”的比赛

paras.en: One of the more lingering questions that will stir the pot of local sports talk radio stations over the next few days, and yes people still listen to the radio, will be what the CFP committee decides to do with the upcoming rankings that will be released on Tuesday night.
paras.zh: 在接下来的几天里，一个更悬而未决的问题将会搅动当地体育谈话广播电台，是的，人们仍然在听广播，这将是 CFP 委员会决定如何处理将于周二晚上发布的即将发布的排名。

paras.en: In the case of Notre Dame, they entered this game with the "must win" hanging over their heads, thanks to their strength of schedule and remaining opponents. Add that with the loss to BYU a few weeks ago, and the Cougars loss to Utah on Saturday, this was a game the Fighting Irish could not lose if they were hoping to participate in the college football playoff.
paras.zh: 就圣母大学而言，由于他们的赛程和剩余对手的实力，他们带着“必须获胜”的心态进入了这场比赛。另外，几周前输给杨百翰大学，周六美洲狮队输给犹他大学，如果爱尔兰人希望参加大学橄榄球季后赛，那么这场比赛就不能输。

paras.en: Now, if Notre Dame can avoid hitting the iceberg over the next three weeks against Boston College, SMU and Syracuse, they will find themselves in the postseason fighting for a national championship.
paras.zh: 现在，如果圣母大学能够避免在接下来的三周内对阵波士顿学院、南卫理公会大学和雪城大学，他们将在季后赛中为全国冠军而战。

paras.en: For Miami, there will be plenty of questions over the next few weeks. The Hurricanes will face a dangerous Duke team, Virginia Tech and Boston College to end the regular season, with their toughest opponent coming next week against the Blue Devils.
paras.zh: 对于迈阿密来说，未来几周将会有很多问题。飓风队将在常规赛结束时面对危险的杜克队、弗吉尼亚理工大学和波士顿学院，他们最强劲的对手下周将对阵蓝魔队。

paras.en: There will obviously be plenty of questions around this offense, with Malachi Toney not expected back until the ACC championship game at the earliest following his high-ankle sprain surgery that was performed this week after an injury sustained in practice.
paras.zh: 显然，这次进攻将会存在很多问题，马拉奇·托尼在训练中受伤后，本周进行了高位脚踝扭伤手术，预计最早要到 ACC 冠军赛才能复出。

paras.en: For all of the talk, though, Miami showed us who they were when their backs were against the wall tonight. No, the Hurricanes didn’t win, but they did prove that they could put up the points needed for the time being without Malachi Toney.
paras.zh: 不过，在所有的谈话中，迈阿密今晚向我们展示了他们在背水一战时的样子。不，飓风队没有获胜，但他们确实证明了他们可以在没有玛拉基·托尼的情况下取得暂时所需的分数。

paras.en: Can they keep it up? That's to be determined over the next month, especially when you factor in the type of emotions that came with this game.
paras.zh: 他们能坚持下去吗？这将在下个月确定，尤其是当你考虑到这款游戏带来的情绪类型时。

paras.en: The bigger story right now, though, is Notre Dame putting themselves in a spot to clinch a playoff berth over the next three weeks.
paras.zh: 不过，现在更大的故事是圣母大学将在接下来的三周内锁定季后赛席位。

paras.en: Tonight, the Fighting Irish gave the CFP committee all of the necessary ammunition needed to put them squarely in the top-10 on Tuesday night.
paras.zh: 今晚，战斗爱尔兰队为 CFP 委员会提供了所有必要的弹药，使他们能够在周二晚上跻身前十。

paras.en: Now, it's their job to not screw it up over the next three weeks.
paras.zh: 现在，他们的工作是在接下来的三周内不要搞砸。

articles.title: Cold blast brings springtime snow to alpine regions as temperatures plummet across Australia’s south-east
articles.author: Guardian staff

paras.en: Snow has fallen across parts of NSW, Victoria and Tasmania as an unseasonal cold blast whips through Australia’s south-east.
paras.zh: 随着一股反常的寒风席卷澳大利亚东南部，新南威尔士州、维多利亚州和塔斯马尼亚州的部分地区降雪。

paras.en: Thredbo, Perisher and Mount Hotham all recorded falls, while snow also fell on Kunanyi/Mount Wellington in Hobart.
paras.zh: 斯雷德伯 (Thredbo)、佩里舍 (Perisher) 和霍瑟姆山 (Mount Hotham) 均出现降雪，霍巴特的库纳尼 (Kunanyi)/威灵顿山 (Mount Wellington) 也出现降雪。

paras.en: The snow had been forecast by the Bureau of Meteorology (BoM), and though uncommon, it is not entirely unusual – many of the places hit by snow in the past 24 hours also recorded a fall in November 2022.
paras.zh: 气象局 (BoM) 曾预测此次降雪，虽然不常见，但也并非完全不寻常——过去 24 小时内降雪的许多地方在 2022 年 11 月也出现了降雪。

paras.en: The falls brought a rush of posts on social media from those puzzled by the unseasonal spring weather.
paras.zh: 瀑布在社交媒体上引发了人们对反季节春季天气感到困惑的大量帖子。

paras.en: “You will not believe this, it’s springtime in Australia, in November, and it’s snowing,” Madeleine McVie, a retail manager at Thredbo, posted on Instagram on Saturday afternoon.
paras.zh: Thredbo 零售经理 Madeleine McVie 周六下午在 Instagram 上发帖称：“你不会相信这一点，十一月是澳大利亚的春天，而且还下雪。”

paras.en: “Like, not just a little bit. It’s fully snowing.”
paras.zh: “就像，不只是一点点。已经下满雪了。”

paras.en: McVie posted another clip on Sunday morning of her riding empty chairlifts through the park as the snow continued to fall.
paras.zh: 周日早上，麦克维发布了另一段视频，视频中她乘坐空荡荡的缆车穿过公园，雪还在继续下着。

paras.en: Kingston Crows cricket club in Tasmania posted an image of the Kingston Beach Oval on Saturday that showed it coated in hailstones.
paras.zh: 塔斯马尼亚的金斯顿乌鸦板球俱乐部周六发布了一张金斯顿海滩椭圆形球场的照片，显示它被冰雹覆盖。

paras.en: The BoM said a weather system, filled with cold air moving north from towards Antarctica, had caused the wintery chill with apparent temperatures much cooler than forecast maximums. South-westerly winds were also causing the apparent or “feels like” temperature to be lower.
paras.zh: 气象局表示，充满冷空气从南极洲向北移动的天气系统导致了冬季寒冷，表观气温比预测的最高气温低得多。西南风也导致表观温度或“感觉”温度降低。

paras.en: At midday, Adelaide, Melbourne, Hobart, Canberra and Sydney all had temperatures that felt cooler than 13C.
paras.zh: 中午，阿德莱德、墨尔本、霍巴特、堪培拉和悉尼的气温均低于 13 摄氏度。

paras.en: The highest temperature at that time was in Adelaide, with a top of 17.5C that felt like 12.3C, with Canberra the lowest (a maximum of 12.9C that felt like 5.3C).
paras.zh: 当时气温最高的是阿德莱德，最高温度为17.5℃，感觉为12.3℃，堪培拉最低（最高12.9℃，感觉为5.3℃）。

paras.en: Brisbane, Perth and Darwin, meanwhile, were all enjoying temperatures in the 20s or 30s.
paras.zh: 与此同时，布里斯班、珀斯和达尔文的气温都在二十多度或三十多度。

paras.en: Warmer temperatures are forecast for Monday, and all capital cities are expected to reach at least 20C by Tuesday.
paras.zh: 预计周一气温将升高，预计到周二所有首府城市气温将至少达到 20 摄氏度。

paras.en: It may be one of the last cold snaps of the year – the BoM, as well as the UN and other bodies, have warned of the likely effects of a “jaw dropping” supercharged El Niño.
paras.zh: 这可能是今年最后的寒流之一——英国央行、联合国和其他机构都警告称，“令人瞠目结舌”的厄尔尼诺现象可能会带来影响。

paras.en: The climate crisis, caused by pollution from fossil fuels, is already supercharging extreme weather and killing people. The El Niño is expected to ratchet up the effects even further, and has already begun to affect regions across the planet as weather patterns are altered.
paras.zh: 由化石燃料污染引起的气候危机已经加剧了极端天气并造成人员死亡。预计厄尔尼诺现象将进一步加剧影响，并且随着天气模式的改变，厄尔尼诺现象已经开始影响全球各地。

paras.en: The southern hemisphere summer is predicted to be hotter and drier as a result of the huge El Niño, meaning greater wildfire risk and droughts in Australia and southern Africa.
paras.zh: 由于巨大的厄尔尼诺现象，预计南半球夏季将变得更加炎热和干燥，这意味着澳大利亚和南部非洲的野火风险和干旱将更大。

articles.title: Uyghurs facing deportation by Thailand say they will be ‘like slaves’ in China
articles.author: Amy Hawkins

paras.en: The deportation of two more Uyghurs to China from Thailand would put their lives in grave danger, activists have said, with one of the men saying he would be “like a slave” if he was sent back.
paras.zh: 活动人士表示，将另外两名维吾尔人从泰国驱逐到中国将使他们的生命面临严重危险，其中一名男子表示，如果他被遣返，他将“像奴隶一样”。

paras.en: Last year, Thai authorities forcibly deported 40 Uyghur men to China despite pleas from the men themselves and the UN.
paras.zh: 去年，泰国当局不顾40名维吾尔族男子本人和联合国的请求，强行将他们驱逐到中国。

paras.en: The US and Canada had reportedly offered to resettle them, but Bangkok appeared to want to avoid upsetting Beijing. The UN has said the returnees’ whereabouts remain unknown.
paras.zh: 据报道，美国和加拿大已提出重新安置他们，但曼谷似乎想避免惹恼北京。联合国表示，返回者的下落仍然不明。

paras.en: Now, two more men fear becoming the latest victims of Beijing’s repressive crackdown against the largely Muslim ethnic group, condemned by the UN as a potential crime against humanity.
paras.zh: 现在，又有两名男子担心成为北京对这个以穆斯林为主的少数民族进行镇压的最新受害者，联合国谴责这种镇压是潜在的反人类罪。

paras.en: The girlfriend of one of the men said her boyfriend, whose name is being withheld for security reasons, told the Guardian he wanted to go “anywhere else but China”.
paras.zh: 其中一名男子的女友表示，她的男友告诉《卫报》，他想去“除了中国以外的任何地方”。出于安全原因，姓名被隐去。

paras.en: Human rights groups said two Uyghur men were at risk of deportation after recently being transferred to an immigration detention centre and they feared Thai authorities may once again give in to pressure from Beijing.
paras.zh: 人权组织表示，两名维吾尔男子最近被转移到移民拘留中心后面临被驱逐出境的风险，他们担心泰国当局可能会再次屈服于北京的压力。

paras.en: Elaine Pearson, Asia director at Human Rights Watch, called for the men to be allowed to travel to a safe third country. “Previous Thai governments have kept Uyghurs in inhumane detention for years and then complied with Beijing’s demands to send them to China, where they were forcibly disappeared,” she said.
paras.zh: 人权观察组织亚洲部主任伊莱恩·皮尔森呼吁允许这些人前往安全的第三国。 “前泰国政府多年来一直对维吾尔人进行不人道的拘留，然后按照北京的要求将他们送往中国，并在那里强迫他们失踪，”她说。

paras.en: The men had been serving a seven-year prison sentence for offences related to an attempted escape from immigration detention in January 2020. They were part of a group of more than 200 Uyghur men, women and children who were apprehended by Thai police in 2014 near the border with Malaysia after they fled from China.
paras.zh: 这些男子因 2020 年 1 月试图越狱而被判处七年徒刑。他们是 2014 年逃离中国后在马来西亚边境附近被泰国警方逮捕的 200 多名维吾尔族男女和儿童中的一员。

paras.en: Since 2014, women and children in the group have been released to Turkey, while the men have been deported to China, in separate batches, attracting criticism from the United Nations and the US secretary of state, Marco Rubio.
paras.zh: 自2014年以来，该组织中的妇女和儿童被分批释放到土耳其，而男子则被分批驱逐到中国，引起了联合国和美国国务卿马可·卢比奥的批评。

paras.en: Uyghurs, a Turkic minority mainly from the Xinjiang region in China, have been subjected to decades of oppressive and discriminatory treatment from the Chinese authorities. This has included the incarceration of hundreds of thousands of people in detention camps aimed at stamping out their cultural identity.
paras.zh: 维吾尔人是主要来自中国新疆地区的突厥少数民族，几十年来一直遭受中国当局的压迫和歧视性待遇。这包括将数十万人关押在拘留营中，目的是消除他们的文化认同。

paras.en: Beijing has defended its policies in Xinjiang as being aimed at poverty alleviation and counter-terrorism.
paras.zh: 北京为其新疆政策辩护，称其目的是扶贫和反恐。

paras.en: In July, Marzeyya Kasem’s (who asked to be referred to by her Islamic alias) boyfriend wrote to her in a letter that he would be “like a slave” if he was sent back to China. “Sometimes I thought why I’m a human being. What I do wrong against China … no want to go back to China,” he wrote. She shared the letter with a Thai rights group.
paras.zh: 7月，Marzeyya Kasem（要求用她的伊斯兰化名）的男友在一封信中写信给她，称如果他被送回中国，他将“像奴隶一样”。 “有时我想为什么我是一个人。我对中国做错了什么......不想回到中国，”他写道。她与泰国人权组织分享了这封信。

paras.en: The two men facing imminent deportation reportedly pleaded their case to Thailand’s office of the National Human Rights Commission on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 据报道，这两名即将被驱逐的男子周三向泰国国家人权委员会办公室认罪。

paras.en: Relatives of Uyghurs have said the Chinese government was “paranoid about Uyghurs going to a safe country in large numbers and living together”, and preferred to have them deported.
paras.zh: 维吾尔人的亲属表示，中国政府“对维吾尔人大量前往安全国家并生活在一起感到偏执”，并宁愿将他们驱逐出境。

paras.en: It is not clear whether China has issued a formal extradition request for the two men. But Chaipruak Doungprapat, Thailand’s national security council chief, told reporters that the men, along with three other Uyghurs who are still in prison, had arrest warrants outstanding in China.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚中国是否已向这两人发出正式引渡请求。但泰国国家安全委员会主席猜普拉克·敦普拉帕 (Chaipruak Doungprapat) 告诉记者，这些人以及其他三名仍在监狱中的维吾尔人，在中国尚未收到逮捕令。

paras.en: Some have questioned whether criminal warrants could be credible considering that at least one of them, Kasem’s boyfriend, was a minor when he left China. “If they are really wanted for a crime in China, why didn’t China immediately issue a [Interpol] red notice [when they were detained in 2014]?” asked Kasem.
paras.zh: 一些人质疑刑事逮捕令是否可信，因为其中至少有一个人，即卡西姆的男友，在离开中国时还是未成年人。 “如果他们确实因在中国犯罪而被通缉，为什么中国不立即发布[国际刑警组织]红色通缉令[当他们在2014年被拘留时]？”卡塞姆问道。

paras.en: Kasem believes that because Thailand was criticised for last year’s mass deportation, this time the authorities were trying to establish a more credible legal basis for the move.
paras.zh: 卡森认为，由于泰国去年因大规模驱逐出境而受到批评，此次当局试图为此举建立更可信的法律依据。

paras.en: A spokesperson for China’s foreign affairs ministry said: “The cooperation between China and Thailand in combating cross-border illegal and criminal activities such as smuggling is consistent with the laws of the two countries, international law and international practice.”
paras.zh: 中国外交部发言人表示：“中泰两国在打击走私等跨境违法犯罪活动方面的合作符合两国法律、国际法和国际惯例。”

paras.en: A spokesperson for Thailand’s foreign affairs ministry declined to comment.
paras.zh: 泰国外交部发言人拒绝置评。

paras.en: - Additional research by Rebecca Ratcliffe
paras.zh: - 丽贝卡·拉特克利夫的补充研究

articles.title: Hot fridges, a fake nuclear alert and a $6bn heist: are we in the foothills of a hacking epidemic?
articles.author: Dan Milmo and Aisha Down

paras.en: Alex Pearce was doing the morning rounds at his fruit and vegetable wholesale business in London on Monday last week when he noticed something odd.
paras.zh: 上周周一，亚历克斯·皮尔斯 (Alex Pearce) 早上在伦敦的水果和蔬菜批发店巡视时，发现了一些奇怪的事情。

paras.en: The defrost light on refrigeration unit 2 was on, and the panel reading was 150C. Unit 4 was the same.
paras.zh: 制冷机组 2 上的除霜灯亮起，面板读数为 150C。第 4 单元是相同的。

paras.en: As he approached his biggest unit, its defrost light also blinked on.
paras.zh: 当他接近最大的设备时，它的除霜灯也闪烁了。

paras.en: It was at this point that Pearce thought: is this a cyber-attack? He walked over to the box connecting the units to the internet and yanked out the cable.
paras.zh: 就在这时，皮尔斯想到：这是网络攻击吗？他走到将设备连接到互联网的盒子前，拔出了电缆。

paras.en: On the same day, retailers in Belgium, Estonia, Ireland, Finland, Luxembourg, the Netherlands and Sweden reported similar problems, with refrigerators and freezers in some shops soaring to as high as 50C (122F).
paras.zh: 同一天，比利时、爱沙尼亚、爱尔兰、芬兰、卢森堡、荷兰和瑞典的零售商也报告了类似问题，一些商店的冰箱和冰柜温度飙升至50摄氏度（122华氏度）。

paras.en: “If it had happened on a Saturday morning, when I don’t tend to be here, it could ultimately have led to a fire,” Pearce said.
paras.zh: 皮尔斯说：“如果这件事发生在周六早上，当时我不在家，最终可能会导致火灾。”

paras.en: But it is not just Pearce and a disparate group of retailers, as well as French blood banks, that have been suffering.
paras.zh: 但遭受苦难的不仅仅是皮尔斯和其他不同的零售商群体，还有法国血库。

paras.en: The hacking attack was one of three over a number of days. On 30 October, the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange, Binance, was robbed of $6.3bn (£4.7bn) in a record heist and on 1 November hackers targeted Ukraine’s emergency alert app, sending people in Kyiv a fake nuclear strike alert.
paras.zh: 这次黑客攻击是几天来发生的三起黑客攻击之一。 10 月 30 日，全球最大的加密货币交易所币安在创纪录的抢劫中被盗 63 亿美元（47 亿英镑）；11 月 1 日，黑客瞄准了乌克兰的紧急警报应用程序，向基辅民众发送了虚假的核打击警报。

paras.en: The official message after the fridge attacks is: expect more disruption. We are in the “foothills” of a new hacking landscape, the head of the UK’s National Cyber Security Centre said this week.
paras.zh: 冰箱袭击后的官方信息是：预计会有更多破坏。英国国家网络安全中心负责人本周表示，我们正处于新的黑客格局的“山麓”。

paras.en: Referring to flaws in IT systems that are being exposed by AI technology, the NCSC boss, Richard Horne, said: “There are so many vulnerabilities out there that … you could say are waiting to be exploited.”
paras.zh: 在谈到人工智能技术暴露的 IT 系统缺陷时，NCSC 老板 Richard Horne 表示：“那里存在如此多的漏洞……你可以说正在等待被利用。”

paras.en: He added: “The most serious risk we face in the short term is just a huge rise in the volume of incidents … and I think you could probably point to the last few months and say we’ve started to see that.”
paras.zh: 他补充道：“我们短期内面临的最严重的风险只是事件数量的大幅增加……我认为你可能会指出过去几个月的情况，并说我们已经开始看到这一点。”

paras.en: Websites around the world were temporarily taken out of service as a precaution last month when AI technology from the ChatGPT developer OpenAI helped discover a flaw in PHP, a computer language used to build much of the world wide web. French supermarket fridges were also attacked last month in what could have been a trial run for the more expansive foray this week.
paras.zh: 上个月，作为预防措施，世界各地的网站暂时停止服务，当时 ChatGPT 开发商 OpenAI 的人工智能技术帮助发现了 PHP（一种用于构建大部分万维网的计算机语言）的缺陷。法国超市的冰箱上个月也遭到攻击，这可能是本周更广泛攻击的试运行。

paras.en: To Azeem Azhar, a tech entrepreneur and commentator, the way AI models were discovering flaws that assailants could harness recalled China’s Covid ground zero. This was, he said, a “Wuhan moment”.
paras.zh: 对于科技企业家兼评论员 Azeem Azhar 来说，人工智能模型发现攻击者可以利用的缺陷的方式让人回想起中国的新冠归零地。他说，这是“武汉时刻”。

paras.en: Azar’s assertion headlined a Substack post that also quoted the cybersecurity executive Matthew Prince, who said last month: “We’re going to have a couple of years where every single week it’s going to feel like the sky is falling.”
paras.zh: 阿扎尔的断言成为 Substack 帖子的标题，该帖子还引用了网络安全高管马修·普林斯 (Matthew Prince) 的话，他上个月表示：“未来几年，我们每周都会感觉天塌下来了。”

paras.en: Not long afterwards, Pearce’s defrost lights went on.
paras.zh: 不久之后，皮尔斯的除霜灯亮了。

paras.en: There are two factors underpinning the NCSC warnings: geopolitics and AI. At least one expert has said the fridge attacks bear Russian hallmarks, while the Binance hack has been attributed to the North Korean state, and Russia is naturally a suspect in the Ukraine incident.
paras.zh: NCSC 的警告有两个因素支撑：地缘政治和人工智能。至少一位专家表示，冰箱袭击事件具有俄罗斯的特征，而币安黑客事件则被归咎于朝鲜国家，而俄罗斯自然是乌克兰事件的嫌疑人。

paras.en: The NCSC said last week that AI-powered malicious software was “highly likely” to be used in hacking attacks against the UK’s power stations, airports and hospitals by 2028. AI would help attackers with tasks such as scouting targets, locating weaknesses in IT networks and writing malicious code, the organisation said.
paras.zh: NCSC 上周表示，到 2028 年，人工智能驱动的恶意软件“极有可能”被用于针对英国发电站、机场和医院的黑客攻击。该组织表示，人工智能将帮助攻击者完成诸如侦察目标、定位 IT 网络弱点和编写恶意代码等任务。

paras.en: But there are caveats. The NCSC’s director of operations, Paul Chichester, said the cold storage hackers “really didn’t need” to use AI to discover the fridge flaws because they were already out there, including default access passwords that were published in one fridge operating company’s manuals.
paras.zh: 但也有一些警告。 NCSC 运营总监 Paul Chichester 表示，冷藏黑客“真的不需要”使用人工智能来发现冰箱的缺陷，因为这些缺陷已经存在，包括一家冰箱运营公司手册中公布的默认访问密码。

paras.en: Sophos, a leading cybersecurity firm, said it had not seen any major incidents among its clients related to the PHP glitch, although – like others in the industry – it had seen a significant number of attempts to take advantage of the vulnerability.
paras.zh: 领先的网络安全公司 Sophos 表示，尚未在其客户中发现任何与 PHP 故障相关的重大事件，尽管与业内其他公司一样，它已经看到大量利用该漏洞的尝试。

paras.en: And one expert said we had been here before. Ciaran Martin, the founding chief executive of NCSC, played down the “Wuhan moment” comparison. This was not the first time the world had faced a concerted threat, he said, pointing to the NotPetya and WannaCry cyber-attacks in 2017, which have been blamed on Russia and North Korea respectively, and a surge in ransomware attacks in 2021. North Korea, hobbled by sanctions and starved of cash, has a well-established reputation as a crypto hacker.
paras.zh: 一位专家说我们以前来过这里。 NCSC 的创始首席执行官夏兰·马丁 (Ciaran Martin) 淡化了“武汉时刻”的比较。他表示，这并不是世界第一次面临协同威胁，并指出 2017 年的 NotPetya 和 WannaCry 网络攻击分别被归咎于俄罗斯和朝鲜，以及 2021 年勒索软件攻击的激增。朝鲜因制裁而陷入困境，缺乏现金，作为加密货币黑客享有盛誉。

paras.en: “It’s a bad run, but it’s not unprecedented,” Martin said. “The idea that we are having a Wuhan moment is not true. We are having one of those waves of incidents that happen every few years.”
paras.zh: “这是一次糟糕的表现，但这并不是史无前例的，”马丁说。 “认为我们正在经历‘武汉时刻’的想法并不正确。我们正在经历每隔几年就会发生的一波事件。”

paras.en: Nonetheless, AI is exposing vulnerabilities. This is the term for a flaw in an IT system that a hacker can exploit, a door that is ajar and unnoticed or ignored by its owner. Since April, when the AI startup Anthropic released its Mythos model, which has a startling ability to flag IT flaws, the amount of vulnerabilities found by leading tech companies has soared eight-fold.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，人工智能还是暴露了漏洞。这是一个术语，指的是 IT 系统中可以被黑客利用的缺陷，即一扇半开且未被其所有者注意到或忽视的门。自 4 月份人工智能初创公司 Anthropic 发布其 Mythos 模型以来，该模型具有惊人的标记 IT 缺陷的能力，领先科技公司发现的漏洞数量猛增了八倍。

paras.en: Attacks have not increased by the same volume, however. The cybersecurity expert Tal Be’ery has speculated that criminal hackers are struggling to make money from these flaws, as shown by a recent decline in revenues from ransomware attacks.
paras.zh: 然而，攻击并没有增加同样的数量。网络安全专家塔尔·贝里 (Tal Be’ery) 推测，犯罪黑客正在努力从这些缺陷中赚钱，最近勒索软件攻击带来的收入下降就表明了这一点。

paras.en: “It seems that currently the surge in vulns [vulnerabilities] does not translate to a surge in breaches,” Be’ery wrote last month.
paras.zh: “目前看来，漏洞[漏洞]的激增并没有转化为违规行为的激增，”Be’ery 上个月写道。

paras.en: The fridge targeting is carried out by attacking the companies that provide operating systems for commercial refrigeration units. These systems are connected to the internet, giving the hackers a remote access route to the ultimate victims. The Danish firm Danfoss, one of the affected system providers, said most of the affected equipment was old and no longer received security updates. It said it had “long recommended” customers install updates or replace obsolete software.
paras.zh: 冰箱目标是通过攻击为商用制冷设备提供操作系统的公司来实现的。这些系统连接到互联网，为黑客提供了到达最终受害者的远程访问路径。受影响的系统提供商之一丹麦丹佛斯公司表示，大多数受影响的设备都很旧，不再收到安全更新。该公司表示，“长期建议”客户安装更新或更换过时的软件。

paras.en: The NCSC, part of the GCHQ spy agency, said the hacks were a reminder of the vulnerability of everyday objects with internet access, from smart speakers to broadband routers. Ollie Whitehouse, NCSC’s chief technology officer, said this week it was “quite clear” that such devices could be “susceptible” to hackers. Manufacturers need to invest more in making their products secure and consumers need to be willing to pay more for the most robust products – and to keep updating them.
paras.zh: GCHQ 间谍机构下属的 NCSC 表示，这些黑客攻击提醒人们，从智能扬声器到宽带路由器等可接入互联网的日常物品都存在漏洞。 NCSC 首席技术官奥利·怀特豪斯 (Ollie Whitehouse) 本周表示，“非常明显”此类设备可能“容易”受到黑客攻击。制造商需要投入更多资金来确保其产品的安全，消费者需要愿意为最强大的产品支付更多费用，并不断更新它们。

paras.en: A key flaw targeted by hackers, including in the fridge attacks, is “end of life” versions of products that are no longer being produced by companies or receiving glitch-eradicating software updates.
paras.zh: 黑客针对的一个关键缺陷（包括冰箱攻击）是公司不再生产或不再接收故障消除软件更新的产品的“生命周期终止”版本。

paras.en: Referring to the prospect of more attacks on internet-connected domestic devices, Whitehouse said: “To be worried, I think, is [too] strong. But we need to be more mindful, definitely.”
paras.zh: 在谈到对联网家用设备发动更多攻击的前景时，怀特豪斯表示：“我认为，担心太强烈了。但我们绝对需要更加谨慎。”

paras.en: Pearce said he now realised his fridge monitoring system, by the US firm Copeland, which was installed in 2018, would need updating.
paras.zh: Pearce 表示，他现在意识到美国公司 Copeland 于 2018 年安装的冰箱监控系统需要更新。

paras.en: “Have we learned a lesson? Yes,” he said. “There is a vulnerability we probably should have been aware of, but luckily the ramifications for us were not severe.”
paras.zh: “我们吸取了教训吗？是的，”他说。 “我们可能应该意识到存在一个漏洞，但幸运的是，它对我们造成的影响并不严重。”

paras.en: The need for mindfulness is heightened by the nation state threat. Criminal gangs carry out ransomware attacks, where a victim’s computer files are encrypted and assailants demand a cryptocurrency “ransom” to unlock them. But there is a cyber frontline where nation states operate too. Geopolitics, exemplified by Russia’s hybrid warfare campaign against Europe, have made this conflict grey zone a particular source of concern.
paras.zh: 民族国家的威胁加剧了对正念的需求。犯罪团伙实施勒索软件攻击，受害者的计算机文件被加密，攻击者要求加密货币“赎金”来解锁它们。但民族国家也有一个网络前线。地缘政治（以俄罗斯针对欧洲的混合战争为例）使这一冲突灰色地​​带成为特别令人担忧的问题。

paras.en: Last month, the UK government launched the Be Ready campaign, urging people to stock up on three days’ worth of food and up to nine litres of bottled water in case of a weather, cyber or other serious emergency. Wes Streeting, the defence secretary, said the country needed to prepare for the threat of “state-sponsored terrorism” targeting everyday infrastructure.
paras.zh: 上个月，英国政府发起了“做好准备”运动，敦促人们储备三天的食物和最多九升瓶装水，以防天气、网络或其他严重紧急情况。国防部长韦斯·斯特里廷表示，美国需要为针对日常基础设施的“国家支持的恐怖主义”威胁做好准备。

paras.en: One expert said he believed the fridge attacks, for all the simplicity of the weaknesses they exploited, showed Russian traits. Xavier Bellekens, the chief executive of the cybersecurity firm Lupovis, said his startup set up “honeypot” traps involving the same fridge controllers targeted by the Europe attackers. The techniques used by the lured hackers included using internet service providers that were particularly tolerant of malicious activity – a tactic linked with previous malicious activity carried out by Russians.
paras.zh: 一位专家表示，他相信冰箱袭击事件尽管利用了很简单的弱点，但仍显示出俄罗斯的特征。网络安全公司 Lupovis 的首席执行官泽维尔·贝尔肯斯 (Xavier Bellekens) 表示，他的初创公司设置了“蜜罐”陷阱，涉及欧洲攻击者针对的相同冰箱控制器。引诱黑客使用的技术包括使用对恶意活动特别宽容的互联网服务提供商——这一策略与俄罗斯人之前实施的恶意活动有关。

paras.en: “Are we certain they are Russian groups? We are not. But elements of this point in that direction,” he said.
paras.zh: “我们确定他们是俄罗斯组织吗？我们不是。但这一点的要素指向那个方向，”他说。

paras.en: On the frontline of the grey war, there is no shock at recent events. Experts and officials in Finland said the fridge attacks were not a surprise, but part of a pattern they had seen growing for years.
paras.zh: 在灰色战争的前线，最近发生的事件并不令人震惊。芬兰的专家和官员表示，冰箱袭击事件并不令人意外，而是他们多年来看到的不断增长的模式的一部分。

paras.en: Finland shares a 1,340km (832 mile) border with Russia. Since the 2022 Ukraine invasion, cyber-attacks of all kinds have escalated. Last year, the country’s national cybersecurity centre recorded nearly 21,000 incidents – targeting a population of fewer than 6 million people. In 2022 it was about 13,000 incidents.
paras.zh: 芬兰与俄罗斯有 1,340 公里（832 英里）的边界。自 2022 年乌克兰入侵以来，各种网络攻击不断升级。去年，该国国家网络安全中心记录了近 21,000 起事件，目标人口不到 600 万。 2022 年，事故数量约为 13,000 起。

paras.en: This year, hackers managed to compromise up to 50,000 Finnish government mobile phones; last year, they took down the website of the country’s ministry of defence.
paras.zh: 今年，黑客成功入侵了多达 50,000 部芬兰政府手机；去年，他们关闭了该国国防部的网站。

paras.en: It is a trend across Europe and Nato countries but is especially pronounced in nations that border Russia.
paras.zh: 这是欧洲和北约国家的一种趋势，但在与俄罗斯接壤的国家尤其明显。

paras.en: However, Russia was not the only reason cyber threats were increasing, said Samuli Bergström, the vice-president of WithSecure, a Helsinki-based cybersecurity company. AI was boosting attacks as well and he echoed the warnings about internet-connected appliances.
paras.zh: 然而，赫尔辛基网络安全公司 WithSecure 的副总裁 Samuli Bergström 表示，俄罗斯并不是网络威胁增加的唯一原因。人工智能也在加剧攻击，他回应了有关互联网连接设备的警告。

paras.en: “These attackers are mostly opportunistic,” Bergström explained. “When they see something that is facing the internet, they will probably attack it. [If you have a device] connected to the internet, you have to assume that it will be attacked, sooner or later.”
paras.zh: “这些攻击者大多是机会主义者，”伯格斯特伦解释道。 “当他们看到某个东西面向互联网时，他们可能会攻击它。[如果你有一个设备]连接到互联网，你就必须假设它迟早会受到攻击。”

paras.en: Bergström and others also emphasised that Russian state actors were not the only culprits – or even, necessarily, the most sophisticated ones.
paras.zh: 伯格斯特伦等人还强调，俄罗斯国家行为者并不是唯一的罪魁祸首 — — 甚至不一定是最老练的罪魁祸首。

paras.en: There is a vast, unseen economy of hackers in the world. Some are activists. Some are mercenaries, in it for money. A good number of them have links to states, such as Russia and Iran. But this affiliation could be loose, which makes it difficult for officials to concretely attribute a motive to a given attack.
paras.zh: 世界上存在着巨大的、看不见的黑客经济。有些是活动家。有些是雇佣兵，为了钱。其中很多与俄罗斯和伊朗等国家有联系。但这种联系可能是松散的，这使得官员们很难具体归因于特定袭击的动机。

paras.en: What does this mean for Europe? The world’s cyberthreat actors are growing more sophisticated and more resourced – better able to spot vulnerabilities, more capable of exploiting them. These advances invite doomsday speculation: could an entire nation’s power grid flicker out in -mid-winter, or could commerce grind to a halt?
paras.zh: 这对欧洲意味着什么？世界上的网络威胁攻击者正变得越来越老练，资源也越来越丰富——能够更好地发现漏洞，更有能力利用它们。这些进步引发了世界末日般的猜测：整个国家的电网是否会在仲冬时出现故障，或者商业是否会陷入停滞？

paras.en: Finland – and most European nations – have plans in place for disrupted payment systems, or an attack on the grid. But cyberthreats are not the same as kinetic war.
paras.zh: 芬兰和大多数欧洲国家都制定了针对支付系统中断或电网攻击的计划。但网络威胁与动态战争不同。

paras.en: Bombing a power station could take out an electricity grid for months, or even longer, given the years-long wait to buy transformers. Cyber-attacks won’t necessarily have the same effect. Software is more quickly patched; it is usually possible to disconnect a device from the internet.
paras.zh: 考虑到购买变压器的等待时间长达数年，轰炸发电站可能会导致电网瘫痪数月甚至更长时间。网络攻击不一定会产生同样的效果。软件修补速度更快；通常可以将设备与互联网断开连接。

paras.en: The goal – at least for state actors – in mounting these cyber-attacks could be more psychological than anything, some officials said. Turning fridges into ovens, or compromising a blood bank, is dramatic; it sears itself into the memory. But those vulnerabilities are likely to now be patched. There is no guarantee that a criminal group might be able to mount that exact attack again.
paras.zh: 一些官员表示，发动这些网络攻击的目的——至少对国家行为者来说——可能更多的是出于心理目的。把冰箱变成烤箱，或者危及血库，都是戏剧性的；它深深烙印在记忆中。但这些漏洞现在可能已得到修复。无法保证犯罪团伙能够再次发动同样的攻击。

paras.en: Still, there are many vulnerabilities, and legacy systems, left for malevolent actors to exploit. These attacks “are more frequent, and they continue to happen”, said Bergström.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，仍有许多漏洞和遗留系统可供恶意行为者利用。伯格斯特罗姆说，这些攻击“更加频繁，而且还在继续发生”。

paras.en: Pearce has not reattached the internet cable but said his Langridge Organic business was otherwise unaffected. He said even after the French fridge attacks last month, he did not expect his company to be next.
paras.zh: 皮尔斯尚未重新连接网线，但表示他的 Langridge Organic 业务未受影响。他表示，即使在上个月法国冰箱袭击事件发生后，他也不认为他的公司会成为下一个。

paras.en: “Hacking for the sake of being disruptive is a strange concept to most people.”
paras.zh: “对于大多数人来说，为了破坏而进行黑客攻击是一个奇怪的概念。”

articles.title: Israel's president tasks opposition leader Eisenkot with forming government

paras.en: Israel's president says he will task opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot with forming a new coalition government.
paras.zh: 以色列总统表示，他将责成反对党领袖加迪·艾森科特组建新的联合政府。

paras.en: Isaac Herzog has been holding talks with political parties after neither Eisenkot's bloc nor that of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu secured a majority in Israel's parliament, known as the Knesset, following last week's election.
paras.zh: 在上周的选举后，艾森科特的集团和总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的集团都未能在以色列议会（即以色列议会）中获得多数席位，艾萨克·赫尔佐格一直在与各政党进行会谈。

paras.en: Eisenkot will now have 28 days to try to form a new administration, with a potential 14-day extension.
paras.zh: 艾森科特现在有 28 天的时间尝试组建新政府，并可能延长 14 天。

paras.en: "Now is the time to form a national emergency government. I will do everything to ensure we are worthy," the former military chief wrote on X.
paras.zh: 这位前军事首长在X上写道：“现在是组建国家紧急政府的时候了。我将尽一切努力确保我们有资格。”

paras.en: No political party in Israel has ever won an outright majority, meaning all governments have been coalitions.
paras.zh: 以色列没有一个政党赢得过绝对多数，这意味着所有政府都是联合政府。

paras.en: Netanyahu's right-wing Likud party and its far-right and ultra-Orthodox Jewish allies won 53 seats in the 120-seat Knesset, while Eisenkot's centrist Yashar party and three other Jewish opposition parties in his bloc won 48.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡的右翼利库德集团及其极右翼和极端正统犹太盟友在议会120个席位中赢得了53个席位，而艾森科特的中间派亚沙尔党和他所在集团的其他三个犹太反对党赢得了48个席位。

paras.en: Two Arab-led alliances, the United Arab List and the Joint List, together won an unprecedented 19 seats following a surge in turnout among Arab voters.
paras.zh: 随着阿拉伯选民投票率的激增，两个阿拉伯领导的联盟——阿拉伯联合名单和联合名单——史无前例地共同赢得了 19 个席位。

paras.en: That positions them as potential kingmakers. However, all but one of the Jewish parties pledged before the polls not to work with them to form a government.
paras.zh: 这使他们成为潜在的拥王者。然而，除了一个犹太政党外，所有犹太政党在投票前都承诺不会与他们合作组建政府。

paras.en: Herzog said that, after consulting all parties during the week, he would give Eisenkot the first chance to form a government.
paras.zh: 赫尔佐格表示，在本周与各方协商后，他将给予艾森科特第一次组建政府的机会。

paras.en: A statement from the president's office said he had informed both Eisenkot and Netanyahu of the decision.
paras.zh: 总统办公室的一份声明称，他已将这一决定告知艾森科特和内塔尼亚胡。

paras.en: Following consultations with delegations from the incoming Knesset members, Eisenkot received 67 recommendations for the premiership and Netanyahu 46, the statement said.
paras.zh: 声明称，在与即将上任的议会议员代表团进行磋商后，艾森科特收到了 67 项总理职位建议，内塔尼亚胡收到了 46 项建议。

paras.en: The president has broad discretion to pick someone they believe has the best chance of building a coalition and does not have to choose the leader of the party with the most seats.
paras.zh: 总统拥有广泛的自由裁量权，可以选择他们认为最有可能建立联盟的人，而不必选择拥有最多席位的政党的领导人。

paras.en: The election results had implied three possible options for the formation of a government: a national unity administration involving both Netanyahu and Eisenkot, a right-wing coalition involving Netanyahu and defectors from Eisenkot's bloc, or an Eisenkot-led government supported by the Arab parties.
paras.zh: 选举结果暗示了组建政府的三种可能选择：内塔尼亚胡和艾森科特共同参与的民族团结政府，内塔尼亚胡和艾森科特集团叛逃者组成的右翼联盟，或由阿拉伯政党支持的艾森科特领导的政府。

paras.en: Eisenkot and every member of his bloc bar one has previously refused to enter government with Arab parties, but there has been speculation that an agreement could be reached.
paras.zh: 艾森科特和他的集团中除一名成员外的每一位成员此前都拒绝与阿拉伯政党一起进入政府，但有人猜测可能会达成协议。

paras.en: He could also attempt to reach a deal with ultra-Orthodox parties, but that too would be difficult.
paras.zh: 他还可以尝试与极端正统派政党达成协议，但这也很困难。

paras.en: There is precedent for a unity government. In 2020, following three deadlocked elections, Netanyahu and his centrist rival Benny Gantz agreed a power-sharing deal in which the leadership rotated between the two.
paras.zh: 联合政府是有先例的。 2020年，在三场陷入僵局的选举之后，内塔尼亚胡和他的中间派竞争对手本尼·甘茨达成了一项权力分享协议，领导层由两人轮流担任。

paras.en: During his consultations with the parties, Herzog had said that to prevent another round of elections and to build a stable government, he expected "factions and their representatives to understand that, in the current reality, not every commitment and promise can be fulfilled".
paras.zh: 赫尔佐格在与各党派磋商时表示，为了防止另一轮选举并建立一个稳定的政府，他希望“各派别及其代表明白，在当前现实中，并非所有承诺和诺言都能兑现”。

paras.en: In the period 2019 to 2022, one of the most politically fractured in Israeli politics, there were five separate elections as Netanyahu and his rivals struggled time and again to co-operate.
paras.zh: 2019年至2022年是以色列政治最分裂的时期之一，内塔尼亚胡和他的对手一次又一次地努力合作，期间举行了五次单独的选举。

articles.title: What we know so far after Krakow gun attack

paras.en: At least six people were killed and more than a dozen others injured when a gunman suspected to have ties to the far-right opened fire in central Krakow, the second largest city in Poland.
paras.zh: 一名疑似与极右翼分子有联系的枪手在波兰第二大城市克拉科夫市中心开枪，造成至少六人死亡、十几人受伤。

paras.en: Three bodies were found at his home when it was searched by police. Here is everything we know so far.
paras.zh: 警方搜查其家时，发现三具尸体。这是迄今为止我们所知道的一切。

paras.en: The attack began shortly before 15:00 local time (14:00 GMT) in Krakow's Main Market Square, the bustling central point of the city which is popular with tourists.
paras.zh: 袭击于当地时间 15:00（格林威治标准时间 14:00）前不久在克拉科夫的主集市广场开始，该广场是该市繁华的中心点，深受游客欢迎。

paras.en: Police said a man drove into the square before beginning to fire "at random people from his car".
paras.zh: 警方称，一名男子开车进入广场，然后开始“从车内随机开枪”。

paras.en: Footage from the scene shows scenes of panic as people fled, with the sound of gunfire clearly heard.
paras.zh: 现场视频显示，人们四散逃离，枪声清晰可闻。

paras.en: A passing tram was shot at during the apparently random attack, shattering windows but no passengers were injured.
paras.zh: 一辆路过的电车在这起看似随机的袭击中遭到枪击，窗户被震碎，但没有乘客受伤。

paras.en: Armed officers raced to the scene and engaged in a gunfight with the suspect, who was shot within three minutes of the attack beginning, preventing a further massacre, officials said.
paras.zh: 官员称，武装警察赶到现场并与嫌疑人发生枪战，嫌疑人在袭击开始后三分钟内被枪杀，避免了进一步的屠杀。

paras.en: A 25-year-old man who was arrested remains in hospital after having surgery for a gunshot wound.
paras.zh: 一名被捕的 25 岁男子因枪伤接受手术后仍在医院。

paras.en: Distressing footage authenticated by BBC Verify shows the moment a police officer confronts the suspect on the ground before firing his weapon several times.
paras.zh: 经 BBC Verify 认证的令人痛心的镜头显示，一名警察在地上与嫌疑人对峙，然后多次开枪。

paras.en: The officer then falls to the ground, apparently having been injured himself.
paras.zh: 这名警官随后倒地，显然自己也受伤了。

paras.en: Shop windows in the square have signs of damage, seemingly from bullets, with glass shards scattered along the floor.
paras.zh: 广场上商店的窗户有损坏的迹象，似乎是被子弹击中的，玻璃碎片散落在地板上。

paras.en: City officials have urged people who live in the city and tourists to stay away from the area while an investigation continues.
paras.zh: 市政府官员敦促该市居民和游客在调查继续期间远离该地区。

paras.en: The suspect's car, found at the intersection of Dietla and Stradomska streets, was checked for possible explosive devices, police said, but none were found. Residents of nearby buildings had been evacuated while the operation was under way.
paras.zh: 警方称，在 Dietla 街和 Stradomska 街的交叉口发现了嫌疑人的汽车，并检查了是否有爆炸装置，但没有发现任何东西。行动进行期间，附近建筑物的居民已被疏散。

paras.en: How many people have died and been injured?
paras.zh: 有多少人死亡和受伤？

paras.en: Six people - four women and two men - are confirmed to have been killed, including a British national. Three victims are Polish and two have not been identified.
paras.zh: 确认有六人（四名女性和两名男性）被杀，其中包括一名英国国民。三名受害者是波兰人，其中两人身份不明。

paras.en: Sixteen people, including five foreigners, two police officers and the attacker, were taken to hospital. The interior ministry later said they were from Austria, Britain, Germany, Portugal and Russia.
paras.zh: 包括五名外国人、两名警察和袭击者在内的十六人被送往医院。内政部后来表示，他们来自奥地利、英国、德国、葡萄牙和俄罗斯。

paras.en: Poland's Prime Minister Donald Tusk later named the injured officers as Senior Constable Jakub Kulik and Senior Constable Artur MoraÅski.
paras.zh: 波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克后来将受伤警员命名为高级警员雅库布·库利克和高级警员阿图尔·莫拉斯基。

paras.en: One of the police officers was described as being in a "very critical condition" by a Polish government minister after being shot three times while arresting the attacker. The officer is undergoing surgery, he added.
paras.zh: 波兰政府部长称其中一名警察在逮捕袭击者时中弹三枪，目前情况“非常危急”。他补充说，这名警官正在接受手术。

paras.en: Polish authorities have not confirmed the names and ages of the other victims.
paras.zh: 波兰当局尚未确认其他受害者的姓名和年龄。

paras.en: Tusk said three bodies - two women and one man - were found at the gunman's house when it was searched after the attack.
paras.zh: 图斯克说，袭击发生后，在枪手的家中搜查时发现了三具尸体——两女一男。

paras.en: What do we know about the suspect and motive?
paras.zh: 我们对嫌疑人和动机了解多少？

paras.en: Police have identified the attacker as a 25-year-old Polish man but have not confirmed his name.
paras.zh: 警方已确认袭击者是一名 25 岁的波兰男子，但尚未确认他的姓名。

paras.en: The suspect was wearing "military-style attire" and had a military-grade weapon, according to a police spokesperson. However, authorities said he was not a soldier.
paras.zh: 警方发言人称，嫌疑人穿着“军装”并持有军用级武器。然而，当局表示他不是军人。

paras.en: "Many pieces of weapons and ammunition were found in his vehicle", the spokesperson added.
paras.zh: 发言人补充说：“在他的车里发现了许多武器和弹药。”

paras.en: Polish media has reported the suspect had a firearms permit and may have obtained the weapons from his family home.
paras.zh: 波兰媒体报道称，嫌疑人持有枪支许可证，并可能从他的家中获得了这些武器。

paras.en: A minister has said early investigations indicate he was inspired by "far-right ideologies". The minister also described him as an "ultra-nationalist" without giving further details.
paras.zh: 一名部长表示，早期调查表明他受到“极右意识形态”的启发。这位部长还称他为“极端民族主义者”，但没有提供更多细节。

paras.en: His home in Ostrowiec ÅwiÄtokrzyski, a city around 200km (125 miles) from Krakow, has been searched with support from counter-terrorism police.
paras.zh: 他位于距离克拉科夫约 200 公里（125 英里）的奥斯特罗维茨奥维托克日斯基 (Ostrowiec Åwiätokrzyski) 的家，在反恐警察的协助下遭到搜查。

paras.en: The shooting happened in one of the largest medieval squares in Europe, a busy location which is also a popular tourist destination.
paras.zh: 枪击事件发生在欧洲最大的中世纪广场之一，这是一个繁忙的地点，也是一个受欢迎的旅游目的地。

paras.en: Jonathan Balshaw from Ipswich was there with his Polish girlfriend Dominika. The couple were outside St Mary's Basilica, in the corner of the square, when the shooting started.
paras.zh: 来自伊普斯威奇的乔纳森·巴尔肖 (Jonathan Balshaw) 和他的波兰女友多米尼卡 (Dominika) 也在那里。枪击事件发生时，这对夫妇正在圣玛丽大教堂外广场的一角。

paras.en: Jonathan said: "We ran down the side of the church and through the side door and hid with several other people until the gunfire died down.
paras.zh: 乔纳森说：“我们跑下教堂的一侧，穿过侧门，和其他几个人一起躲起来，直到枪声平息。

paras.en: "A lot of shots were fired, more than 20 with it sounding like multiple different firearms - there were two distinctly different noises."
paras.zh: “开了很多枪，超过 20 声，听起来像是多种不同的枪械——有两种截然不同的声音。”

paras.en: Caitlin Shasby from Newcastle arrived in Krakow yesterday with her friend Jon for a long weekend.
paras.zh: 来自纽卡斯尔的凯特琳·沙斯比昨天与她的朋友乔恩抵达克拉科夫度过一个长周末。

paras.en: She said they heard shots from their hotel room but were not sure what was happening until their hotel rang them and told them to "stay in our rooms until further notice".
paras.zh: 她说，他们听到酒店房间里传来枪声，但不确定发生了什么，直到酒店给他们打电话并告诉他们“留在我们的房间里，直到另行通知”。

paras.en: What has the reaction been in Poland and internationally?
paras.zh: 波兰和国际社会的反应如何？

paras.en: After travelling to Krakow, Prime Minister Donald Tusk said : "Until now in Poland we haven't had such drastic cases of terrorism...that's what we have to call this cruel attack on people's lives here in Krakow."
paras.zh: 访问克拉科夫后，总理唐纳德·图斯克表示：“到目前为止，波兰还没有发生过如此严重的恐怖主义案件……这就是我们对克拉科夫人民生活的残酷袭击的说法。”

paras.en: Krakow Mayor Åukasz GibaÅa has signed an order declaring a period of mourning in the city which will last until Wednesday, 11 November.
paras.zh: 克拉科夫市长 Åukasz GibaÅa 签署了一项命令，宣布该市进行哀悼期，该哀悼期将持续到 11 月 11 日星期三。

paras.en: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham said: "I'm shocked and saddened by the appalling shooting in KrakÃ³w today."
paras.zh: 英国首相安迪·伯纳姆表示：“我对今天克拉科夫发生的令人震惊的枪击事件感到震惊和悲伤。”

paras.en: "My thoughts are with the families of those who have lost their lives, everyone injured and all those affected by this senseless violence. The United Kingdom stands in solidarity with the people of Poland," he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“我的心与那些丧生者的家人、受伤的人和所有受到这种毫无意义的暴力影响的人同在。英国与波兰人民站在一起。”

paras.en: British foreign secretary Ed Miliband said on social media the UK government "deeply mourns" those who died in the "appalling attack".
paras.zh: 英国外交大臣埃德·米利班德在社交媒体上表示，英国政府“深切哀悼”那些在“骇人听闻的袭击”中丧生的人。

paras.en: US ambassador to Poland Tom Rose described it as a "savage and murderous attack".
paras.zh: 美国驻波兰大使汤姆·罗斯形容这是一次“野蛮而凶残的袭击”。

paras.en: The EU's top diplomat, Kaja Kallas, said the shooting was "a tragedy that will be felt far beyond Poland".
paras.zh: 欧盟最高外交官卡亚·卡拉斯表示，枪击事件是“一场远远超出波兰范围的悲剧”。

paras.en: President Volodymyr Zelensky of neighbouring Ukraine called the shooting "shocking."
paras.zh: 邻国乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基称此次枪击事件“令人震惊”。

paras.en: "On behalf of the Ukrainian people, and personally, I extend my sincere condolences to the families and loved ones of the victims," he wrote on social media.
paras.zh: 他在社交媒体上写道：“我代表乌克兰人民和我个人向遇难者家属和亲人表示诚挚的哀悼。”

articles.title: Houthis say at least 33 killed in Saudi air strike

paras.en: Media linked to the Houthi movement in Yemen say at least 33 people, including women and children, have been killed in air strikes by Saudi Arabia.
paras.zh: 与也门胡塞运动有关的媒体称，至少 33 人在沙特阿拉伯的空袭中丧生，其中包括妇女和儿童。

paras.en: There has been no comment from the Saudi-led coalition backing the internationally recognised government in Yemen.
paras.zh: 支持国际公认的也门政府的沙特领导的联盟尚未发表评论。

paras.en: Live video footage on Al Masirah - a television station run by the Houthis - has shown rescuers pulling bodies out of the rubble of several buildings in al-Shariyah, a town to the east of the capital, Sanaa.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装运营的电视台 Al Masirah 的现场视频显示，救援人员从首都萨那东部城镇 al-Shariyah 的几栋建筑废墟中拉出尸体。

paras.en: The bodies of young children can be seen among those dug out from the ruins.
paras.zh: 从废墟中挖出的尸体中可以看到幼儿的尸体。

paras.en: The television station has also shown a number of injured people being carried on stretchers to hospital.
paras.zh: 电视台还播放了一些伤者被担架抬往医院的画面。

paras.en: Saba news agency, which is also run by the Houthis, said the attack was carried out by Saudi Arabia on Saturday. It added that 39 people had been injured.
paras.zh: 同样由胡塞武装管理的萨巴通讯社称，周六的袭击是沙特阿拉伯发动的。它补充说，有39人受伤。

paras.en: The Saudis have led a coalition that has been fighting the Houthis for more than a decade in support of Yemen's internationally recognised government.
paras.zh: 沙特领导的联盟十多年来一直与胡塞武装作战，以支持国际公认的也门政府。

paras.en: The war in Yemen had been dormant for several years but reignited as a result of the Iran war.
paras.zh: 也门战争已沉寂数年，但因伊朗战争而重新燃起。

paras.en: A truce began to fall apart when Saudi Arabia struck the airport in Sanaa - which is controlled by the Houthis - to prevent an Iranian plane landing there.
paras.zh: 当沙特阿拉伯袭击胡塞武装控制的萨那机场以阻止伊朗飞机降落时，休战协议开始破裂。

paras.en: The Tehran-backed Houthis subsequently targeted Abha airport in Saudi Arabia, then began hitting Saudi ships that have been using the Red Sea off the coast of Yemen as an alternative oil export route to the Strait of Hormuz.
paras.zh: 德黑兰支持的胡塞武装随后袭击了沙特阿拉伯的艾卜哈机场，然后开始袭击沙特船只，这些船只一直在也门海岸附近的红海作为通往霍尔木兹海峡的替代石油出口路线。

paras.en: Major fighting has since resumed in Yemen between the Houthis and forces fighting for the Saudi-backed government of Yemen.
paras.zh: 此后，也门胡塞武装和沙特支持的也门政府的武装力量之间又重新爆发了大规模战斗。

paras.en: On Friday, an attack on a market in Taiz province, which has been the focus of much of the recent fighting, is reported to have killed 30 people.
paras.zh: 周五，塔伊兹省的一个市场遭到袭击，据报道，该袭击已造成 30 人死亡，该袭击一直是近期战斗的焦点。

paras.en: The Houthis accused the Saudis of carrying out the strike, while government forces accused the Houthis of having fired a missile at the site.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装指责沙特发动了这次袭击，而政府军则指责胡塞武装向该地点发射了导弹。

paras.en: The United Nations says more than 1,600 people have been killed and more than 300,000 displaced since fighting resumed.
paras.zh: 联合国表示，自战斗重新爆发以来，已有超过 1,600 人丧生，超过 30 万人流离失所。

paras.en: The Saudis have regularly bombed Houthi positions, while the group has fired multiple missiles at targets inside Saudi Arabia, including airports and oil facilities.
paras.zh: 沙特经常轰炸胡塞武装阵地，该组织还向沙特阿拉伯境内的目标发射多枚导弹，包括机场和石油设施。

paras.en: Hours before the strike that hit al-Shariyah, the Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted a missile heading towards Riyadh.
paras.zh: 在袭击 al-Shariyah 的袭击发生前几个小时，沙特领导的联军表示拦截了一枚飞向利雅得的导弹。

paras.en: A Houthi leader, Mahdi al-Mashat, has vowed that the group will take revenge for the latest attacks in Yemen.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装领导人迈赫迪·马沙特誓言，该组织将为也门最近发生的袭击事件进行报复。

articles.title: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian

paras.en: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian
paras.zh: 卓越的非公路制动和摩擦性能均来自意大利

paras.en: SK Wellman, a company specializing in the production of brake and frictions components for off-highway, has a lively DNA. A historical reality in Orzinuovi (Bs), where the plant is still located, over the years it has undergone transformations and changes that have contributed to making it what it is today: an evolved company, able to grow in loyalty to the local Italian territory and to innovate its sector with creativity and flexibility worldwide. Today, as part of the CentroMotion Group and its Carlisle Brake & Friction division, SK Wellman is a leader in its segment, recognized and chosen by major brands in earthmoving, agricultural and construction machinery. Engineer Alessandro Gamba, Global Director of Friction Engineering, tells us about the ongoing growth.
paras.zh: SK Wellman 是一家专门生产非公路用制动和摩擦部件的公司，拥有活跃的基因。工厂仍位于 Orzinuovi (Bs) 的历史现实中，多年来，它经历了转型和变化，从而使其成为今天的样子：一家不断发展的公司，能够不断发展对意大利当地领土的忠诚度，并在全球范围内以创造力和灵活性创新其行业。如今，作为 CentroMotion 集团及其 Carlisle 制动与摩擦部门的一部分，SK Wellman 已成为该领域的领导者，受到土方、农业和建筑机械领域主要品牌的认可和选择。摩擦工程全球总监工程师 Alessandro Gamba 向我们介绍了持续增长的情况。

paras.en: "S.K. Wellman S.R.L. has 340 employees and a turnover of 127 million by 2023," Gamba begins. In the last five years, a strong push has come from the market but above all from the characteristics of SK, such as creativity, innovation, flexibility, which, in the final analysis, are the result of the greatest wealth of this company: people". They are the ones who make the Brescia-based company an authentic and tenacious company, to the point of being able to export not only their products successfully, but also their skills and design skills to the other plants of the Carlisle Brake & Friction division. The year 2023, which has just ended, confirms a positive performance in turnover for sales revenues alone, recording a slight decrease of -5% compared to the previous exceptional 2022 financial year; A year, the latter, probably unrepeatable for many realities of the Brescia and non-Brescia economy. In fact, 2023 was undoubtedly the year of change that helped people develop a greater ability to manage uncertainty, accepting and dealing with unexpected situations with more resilience.
paras.zh: “S.K. Wellman S.R.L. 拥有 340 名员工，到 2023 年营业额将达到 1.27 亿美元，”Gamba 开始说道。在过去的五年里，强大的推动力来自于市场，但最重要的是来自 SK 的特点，如创造力、创新性、灵活性，归根结底，这些都是这家公司最大财富的结果：“人”。正是他们使这家位于布雷西亚的公司成为一家真正的、顽强的公司，以至于不仅能够成功出口他们的产品，而且能够将他们的技能和设计技能出口到卡莱尔制动和摩擦部门的其他工厂。刚刚结束的 2023 年，仅销售收入就实现了积极的表现，与上一个出色的 2022 财年相比，略有下降 -5%；对于布雷西亚和非布雷西亚经济的许多现实来说，后者可能是不可重复的一年。事实上，2023 年无疑是变革的一年，帮助人们培养了更强的能力来管理不确定性，以更强的韧性接受和处理意外情况。

paras.en: "At the base of success there is a matrix organization developed thanks to group governance - explains the engineer -: a verticality driven on all functions and skills, able to define and guide processes on a global scale and generate best practices. And that's not all," adds Gamba, "we are one of the companies with the lowest level of turnover, and this allows us to transfer the experience of those who have been with us for a long time to young people, on whom we particularly focus. Added to this is a company population of 15 different nationalities, whose strong collaboration creates a truly serene working climate," says the HR Manager. It is no coincidence that the direction of growth is particularly social responsibility.
paras.zh: 工程师解释说：“成功的基础是通过集团治理形成的矩阵组织：所有职能和技能的垂直驱动，能够在全球范围内定义和指导流程并产生最佳实践。而这还不是全部，”Gamba 补充道，“我们是人员流动率最低的公司之一，这使我们能够将长期与我们在一起的人的经验传授给我们特别关注的年轻人。除此之外，公司人口还来自 15 个不同的国家，他们的强有力的合作创造了真正宁静的工作氛围，”人力资源经理说道。成长的方向尤其是社会责任并非巧合。

paras.en: "Among the main projects of SK Wellman and Carlisle - he observes - stands out Enactus, an international non-profit organization that, thanks to its activity, involves university students in the creation of sustainable entrepreneurial projects, helping to bridge the gap between university and business; and then Treedom, which involves the company's commitment to planting 1,600 trees in three years, involving its stakeholders in the project". Two more rare gems for the metalworking industry? A level of accidents at work that borders on zero, and the centrality of talent development. Towards excellence and beyond.
paras.zh: 他指出，“SK Wellman 和 Carlisle 的主要项目中，最突出的是 Enactus，这是一家国际非营利组织，通过其活动，让大学生参与创建可持续创业项目，帮助缩小大学和企业之间的差距；然后是 Treedom，该公司承诺在三年内种植 1,600 棵树，并让利益相关者参与到该项目中”。金属加工行业还有两颗稀有宝石吗？工作事故率接近于零，人才发展处于中心地位。迈向卓越并超越。

paras.en: Source: Il Corriere della Sera – edizione Lombardia
paras.zh: 资料来源：《晚邮报》——伦巴第版

paras.zh: 请参观位于印度大诺伊达/德里 NCR 印度博览中心 bauma CONEXPO INDIA 2024 15 号展厅 F01 号展位的 Carlisle Brake & Friction。印度 bauma CONEXPO 将于 2024 年 12 月 11 日至 14 日举行。
